AI.method: (1) 基于BEM+Newton-Raphson方法生成12,450条粘弹性Hertz接触轨迹,覆盖加载/卸载速率(10⁻¹~10³)、保载时间(10⁻³~3)、压痕深度(0~100)和Tabor参数(0.2~3.2),模量比固定k=0.1;(2) 引入固定测量步长(FMS)表示,通过样条插值将变长BEM轨迹映射为固定长度序列(N=120,加载50+保载20+卸载50点);(3) 设计两类输入特征:纯数据驱动(时间+压痕)与物理引导(时间+压痕+因果速度+边缘检测);(4) 架构搜索:6类序列模型家族(M1~M6,含LSTM、TCN、Transformer等)×3种Tabor条件化机制(拼接、FiLM、门控)=18种模型,使用Adam优化器(学习率10⁻⁴)、MSE损失和早停策略训练。
AI.result: 最佳模型M1-concat(LSTM 256→128+拼接Tabor条件化)实现:测试集MSE=5.0×10⁻⁴,MAE=9.2×10⁻³,DTW-RMSE=1.48×10⁻²;剥离力中位误差≈2.2%,滞回面积中位误差≈1.1%,剥离时间误差<1%;测试协议中位推理时间0.16秒(较BEM快约3个数量级);在完全弛豫短程粘附极限下成功复现Persson-Brener裂纹扩展理论预测的有效表面能量;物理引导特征使验证MSE降低约7倍;架构简洁性(LSTM基线)优于更复杂设计。
AI.conclusion: LSTM基线架构配合拼接式Tabor条件化在粘弹性粘附接触轨迹预测中达到最佳综合性能,证明核心挑战在于加载历史的清晰编码和粘附状态描述符的显式注入,而非架构复杂度。物理引导输入特征(因果速度+边缘检测)显著降低学习负担。代理模型适用于控制导向的实时应用(抓取、爬行、操控),但局限在于:训练数据基于单一SLS本构模型,无法外推到材料性质显著不同的体系;误差集中于快速卸载和近不稳定轨迹;建议未来扩展数据集覆盖困难工况并推广至更宽频谱粘弹性模型。

title: DAIS: Dependency-Aware Intermediate QA Supervision for Complex Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision exposes intermediate rationales, but flat rationale targets usually optimize a single reasoning sequence and provide limited supervision on how local conclusions should support later decisions. We introduce Dependency-Aware Intermediate QA Supervision (DAIS), a training-time framework that converts filtered teacher rationales into stage-level QA records. Each intermediate record predicts a local answer conditioned on the previous states needed for that decision, while the final-answer record keeps the original task format; evaluation therefore uses only the original input and optional context. Across GDPR, AIACT, MedQA, and FOLIO with multiple Qwen backbones, DAIS improves average final-answer accuracy over answer-only, flat chain-of-thought, and independent-QA baselines. On policy-compliance benchmarks, it achieves a largest gain of 5.6% and an average gain of 4.2% over the strongest non-DAIS baseline. Controlled ablations show that valid previous-state conditioning contributes beyond longer targets or additional intermediate text, supporting dependency-conditioned intermediate QA as a lightweight auxiliary supervision signal for standard final-answer inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAIS（Dependency-Aware Intermediate QA Supervision），一种训练时的监督微调框架，将教师思维链推理过程分解为带有依赖关系感知的阶段级问答记录，用于辅助监督模型的复杂推理能力，最终在标准直接推理设置下提升最终答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT监督方法将推理过程作为单一扁平序列优化，缺乏对局部结论如何支持后续决策的显式监督。作者希望验证"依赖条件化的中间问答记录"是否能作为比扁平CoT更好的训练监督信号。
AI.method: DAIS通过以下流程构建训练数据：(1) 收集并过滤教师CoT推理；(2) 将推理分解为2-5个本地子任务并对齐推理片段；(3) 归纳数据集级子任务模式(schema)；(4) 将每个子任务改写为问答状态，后面子任务接收前面子任务的序列化输出作为上下文；(5) 保留原始最终答案记录。评估时仅使用原始输入，无需中间状态或外部分解模块。
AI.result: 在GDPR、AIACT、MedQA、FOLIO四个基准上，使用四个Qwen骨干模型，DAIS在16个基准-模型设置中的15个取得最佳平均准确率。政策合规基准上最大提升5.6%（AIACT），平均提升4.2%。消融实验表明有效的前置状态条件化贡献超过了目标长度、排序标记或独立QA暴露等表面因素。
AI.conclusion: DAIS作为轻量级辅助监督信号，能在标准最终答案推理设置下提升复杂推理任务的准确率。有效的前置状态条件化是关键贡献因素，超越了简单的目标长度增加或中间文本暴露。但该方法不证明模型在推理时忠实执行了依赖图，且受限于SFT设置、生成监督工件的噪声以及评估范围。

title: SciCodePile: A 128GB Corpus and Executable Benchmark for Challenging Scientific Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at general-purpose code generation, yet how well they handle scientific code remains an open question. Existing datasets and benchmarks are limited in scale, domain coverage, or executable verification, leaving the true gap between current LLMs and reliable scientific code generators inadequately assessed. To address these limitations, we present SciCodePile, the largest scientific code corpus to date, constructed from 37,737 public repositories and collectively comprising 128GB of code that spans multiple computational science disciplines. From this corpus, we further curate an executable benchmark of 200 tasks, each equipped with a sandboxed execution environment and an automated test harness for functional verification. We evaluate 15 LLMs from both open-source and closed-source families on three tasks: prefix-to-suffix completion, fill-in-the-middle infilling, and executable code generation. Results show that scientific code generation remains highly challenging: The best CodeBLEU reaches only 38.13 and 38.37 on the two completion tasks, while the strongest model achieves just 12.30\% Pass@1 on the executable benchmark, underscoring how far current models remain from reliable scientific code generation. To demonstrate the training utility of SciCodePile, we further show that continued pretraining on our corpus improves CodeBLEU by $\times$2.84 on scientific code completion, and instruction tuning on our data improves Pass@1 by $\times$4.79 on the executable benchmark. All code and data are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SciCodePile是目前最大的科学代码语料库（128GB，来自37,737个公开仓库），并附带一个包含200个任务的可执行基准测试，用于评估LLM在科学代码生成方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有科学代码数据集和基准在规模、领域覆盖或可执行验证方面存在不足，无法准确评估当前LLM与可靠科学代码生成器之间的真实差距。科学代码的正确性需要满足领域特定语义、复杂数值逻辑和项目级依赖，远超通用编程能力的要求。
AI.method: 采用三阶段构建框架：(1) 通过retrieve-then-filter管道，从198个种子关键词扩展至213个查询，结合LLM辅助的词汇扩展与质量相关性过滤，从1,311,568个候选仓库中筛选出37,737个高质量科学仓库；(2) 从仓库中导出四种对齐的数据格式：F1（125GB原始代码文件）、F2（README摘要）、F3（50万个函数指令实例）、F4（2万个问题-解决方案对）；(3) 基于纯Python函数构建200个任务的HumanEval风格可执行基准，每个任务配备沙箱执行环境和自动测试框架。在15个开源和闭源LLM上评估前缀到后缀补全（PTS）、中间填充（FIM）和可执行代码生成三项任务。
AI.result: 结果显示科学代码生成仍极具挑战性：在PTS和FIM补全任务上，最佳CodeBLEU分别为38.13和38.37；在可执行基准上，最强模型GPT-5.4-mini仅达到12.30% Pass@1和15.50% Pass@5。所有StarCoder2模型在可执行基准上接近0%，主要因语法错误失败。训练效用方面，在F1上对GPT-2（124M）进行持续预训练使CodeBLEU提升2.84倍；在F3/F4上对Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B进行指令微调使Pass@1从1.90%提升至9.10%（4.79倍）。
AI.conclusion: SciCodePile是目前最大的科学代码语料库，其多格式对齐设计和可执行测试驱动的评估方法揭示了当前LLM在科学代码生成方面的显著不足，为训练可靠的科学代码生成模型提供了有效资源。未来工作需扩展领域覆盖、扩大可执行基准规模，并利用更多仓库上下文生成正确的科学代码实现。

title: Parallel Noising in Neural Markov Logic Networks
summary: Neural Markov Logic Networks (NMLNs) are a flexible neurosymbolic relational model. Previous work has shown that, although NMLNs achieve strong performance as generative models for small relational structures, they underperform diffusion-based generative graph models on larger structures. In this paper, we strengthen NMLNs along two main dimensions: (i) we increase the expressive capacity of their potential functions using graph neural networks, and (ii) we develop a new training and inference algorithm inspired by parallel-tempering Markov chain Monte Carlo methods, which we name parallel noising. Together, these enhancements enable NMLNs to attain strong performance in graph generation relative to general diffusion-based generative graph models. Furthermore, they allow NMLNs to match the performance of specialized text-based recurrent models when generating small molecular structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NMLN*模型，通过两个关键改进增强了神经马尔可夫逻辑网络（NMLN）：（1）使用图神经网络（GNN）作为全局势函数替代原有基于片段的局部势函数；（2）提出了一种新的训练与推理算法"并行加噪"（Parallel Noising, PN），借鉴并行退火MCMC思想，用数据空间的腐蚀层级替代温度层级进行复制交换采样。在分子图生成基准测试中，NMLN*显著优于原有NMLN和通用扩散模型（如DiGress），在小分子生成上可与专用文本循环模型相媲美。
AI.motivation: 现有NMLN存在两大瓶颈：（1）基于片段的局部势函数表达能力有限，捕获长程关系结构需增大片段宽度k，导致O(n^k)的片段数量爆炸，且受限于无量词、有限变量的逻辑表达力（如无法表达"无孤立顶点"等全局图性质）；（2）推理依赖Gibbs采样，在学到的势函数接近确定性约束时混合极差，因为尖锐多模态能量景观中的局部移动易被拒绝或陷入窄盆。直接的并行退火方案又面临温度阶梯难以调优的问题——训练过程中有效能量尺度漂移导致交换接受率恶化。因此需要一种对时变目标分布更鲁棒的复制交换方案。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心组件：(1) 全局GNN势函数——将可能世界ω转换为带标签的图（节点标签对应一元谓词/原子类型，边标签对应二元谓词/键类型），通过关系特定的R-GCN消息传递（10层、隐藏维度128、ReLU激活），汇聚所有中间层表示后经三层MLP映射为标量能量。(2) 并行加噪（PN）采样器——固定伯努利腐蚀率阶梯0≤ν_N<…<ν_1≤1，每级运行NMLN，在级内做Gibbs更新、相邻级间按标准复制交换Metropolis比（式(6)）交换状态；目标级设为ν_N=10⁻³的轻微腐蚀分布。训练时对每级i在腐蚀数据q_i=p_data·K_{νi}上最大化似然，负相位用持续PN链采样（类持续对比散度），各噪声级独立参数。理论分析：Proposition 1证明PN是精确采样器；Proposition 2表明期望交换接受率等于相邻目标分布的重叠度；Proposition 3给出d·|ν-ν'|的分布无关TV距离上界；Proposition 4说明势函数加常数不影响接受率。附录A.3在时变双阱布尔模型、A.4在像素n-queens任务上展示PN相比固定温度阶梯PT对尖锐/确定性约束更鲁棒。
AI.result: 在ChEMBL、QM9、ZINC250k、MOSES四个分子基准上用2M样本的召回曲线评估。关键结果：(1) NMLN*（GNN+PN, N=5级, R=100副本）在ChEMBL 10/15/20上大幅超越DiGress（离散和连续版本）以及DeepSet-NMLN基线；(2) 消融实验显示GNN势函数本身带来显著提升（s.3 vs s.1/s.2），并行加噪在此基础上进一步带来增益（s.4/s.5对比表明单纯增加Gibbs链数并不奏效，PN优于等计算量的多链Gibbs）；(3) 小分子（9、10重原子）上NMLN*超过领域专用SMILES/SELFIES循环模型（MoleculeRNN变体、PaccMann）；(4) 不同噪声级的有效性与有效性指标显示低噪声级几乎产生完全有效分子，高噪声级几乎无效，验证了层级结构的合理性；(5) 玩具实验：时变双阱目标下PT滞后于真实目标，PN跟踪更紧密；像素n-queens上PN持续降低攻击对数，PT较早平台化。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过NMLN*解决了NMLN的两大实际瓶颈——片段势函数的表达力限制和Gibbs推理在近确定性约束下的混合困难。GNN全局能量捕获长程结构；并行加噪作为精确复制交换采样器，腐蚀定义的阶梯不依赖能量尺度，对训练中目标分布的漂移天然鲁棒。实验上NMLN*在通用图生成的扩散基线以及分子专用模型面前均表现强劲，尤其在小分子上首次让一般性的神经符号关系模型匹配了领域专用模型的性能。这项工作将并行退火思想从温度重标定推广到数据空间腐蚀，为带有尖锐组合约束的离散能量模型提供了一条实用的推理路径。

title: Incomplete Observations Boost Evolutionary Performance in Ocean Modeling
summary: Data-driven methods have revolutionized ocean modeling, yet current approaches rely heavily on complete reanalysis datasets, imposing computational constraints and limiting model performance to that of the training data. Here, we present a generative state-space model and an optimization framework that enable learning directly from sparse and noisy observations. The model is essentially a hidden Markov model with a continuous state space, where oceanic physical quantities are treated as hidden states and measurements as observations, enabling a unified representation of ocean fields and observational data. Both the initial-state and state-transition modules are implemented as neural networks to capture the complexity and temporal evolution of ocean states, while the emission module is formulated as a masked Gaussian distribution. To train the model from sparse observations, we derive an optimization framework based on the expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm. The framework alternately reconstructs high-fidelity ocean fields via Langevin dynamics and optimizes deep neural networks to capture temporal evolution. Theoretical analysis shows that the framework maximizes the likelihood of observations under the generative model. For efficiency, we assume that ocean-state evolution follows a stationary, ergodic, and Markovian stochastic process and adopt only length-two state sequences during optimization. Experiments on CMIP6 simulation data and FY-3D satellite data demonstrate high-fidelity reconstruction and accurate prediction, showing that sparse observations can directly improve the model's representation of ocean-state dynamics. This work offers a scalable pathway for next-generation Earth system models to learn directly from sparse, incomplete real-world observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种生成式状态空间模型（Generative State-Space Model）和基于期望最大化（EM）算法的优化框架，使AI海洋模型能够直接从稀疏、不完整的观测数据（如卫星轨道扫描数据）中学习海洋动力学，摆脱对完整再分析数据集的依赖。
AI.motivation: 当前数据驱动的AI地球系统模型（如Pangu-Weather、GraphCast等）几乎完全依赖完整的再分析数据集（如ERA5、GLORYS、ECCO）进行训练。这种依赖带来两个根本性限制：（1）再分析数据集的计算成本限制了时空分辨率，导致亚中尺度等重要动力过程难以解析；（2）AI模型的性能上限受限于再分析数据本身的精度，使其只能作为传统数值模型的"仿真器"而非独立的"模拟器"。核心科学问题是：能否打破对再分析数据的依赖，使AI模型直接从稀疏、含噪的不完整观测中学习？
AI.method: 本文采用以下关键技术方法：(1) **概率生成式状态空间建模**：将海洋物理场视为隐藏状态𝐬，稀疏观测视为观测值𝐨，建立隐马尔可夫模型框架；(2) **深度生成网络架构**：初始状态模型采用改进的StyleGAN2-ADA（引入深度可分离卷积解决风格调制在DWConv上的数学抵消问题），状态转移模型采用带噪声注入的随机U-Net，观测模型采用掩码高斯分布；(3) **基于EM的迭代优化框架**：E步在潜在空间通过Langevin动力学采样重构完整的海洋场，M步以重构结果为监督信号更新网络参数；(4) **关键技术策略**：提高潜在自由度（层间多通道噪声注入）、采用Tanh激活函数（原点处梯度最大）、使用高斯先验（提供连续梯度反馈消除空间不连续伪影）。假设海洋状态演化满足平稳、遍历、马尔可夫性，仅使用T=1的长度二状态序列进行优化。
AI.result: 在CMIP6 BCC-CSM2-MR模拟数据（OSSE实验，约67%空间掩码）和FY-3D MWRI北极真实卫星观测数据上进行验证。结果显示：(1) **模拟数据定量结果**：最终模型相比预训练基线，初始状态s₀重建的RMSE降低28.13%、MAE降低34.30%、SSIM从0.9014提升至0.9355；一步预测s₁的RMSE降低27.09%、MAE降低33.45%、SSIM从0.9138提升至0.9496；(2) **纯预测能力**：在以真值s₀作为输入的一步预测实验中，最终模型仍优于基线（RMSE从0.9263降至0.7431），证明EM框架使转移模型本身学到了更准确的物理演化规律；(3) **真实卫星数据**：在FY-3D北极海冰观测中，最终模型相比基线恢复了更清晰的冰缘、热梯度及精细结构（如冰丝、碎冰），并展现了跨时间的动力学一致性（如冰的旋转运动和下漂），避免了时间闪烁问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立了可从稀疏不完整观测中端到端学习的生成式状态空间建模框架，实验证明AI模型能够通过"自举"（bootstrapping）过程从自身的不完美重构中精炼对物理动力学的理解。EM范式有效解决了"状态重构"与"模型学习"之间的循环依赖问题。这为下一代AI地球系统模型开辟了一条新路径——摆脱对再分析数据集的依赖，直接从真实世界的噪声观测中学习，有望在数据稀缺区域（深 ocean、极地）构建独立、强大的物理过程模拟器。存在的局限包括：Langevin动力学采样的计算成本较高，未来可通过变分推断或蒸馏扩散求解器加速；保证严格的质量和能量守恒仍是挑战，未来需融合物理约束。

title: Breaking the Homogeneity Assumption: Specialized Multi-Generator Adversarial Learning for Rare Failure Detection in Predictive Maintenance
summary: Supervised learning models in the predictive maintenance field are regularly trained on highly imbalanced industrial datasets: machine failures occur rarely but have a disproportionate effect on operations. In addition to the clear class disparity, failure data are typically non-homogeneous, with different failure modes arising from distinct physical processes and exhibiting a multimodal distribution across minorities and classes. Traditional imbalance-management methods, e.g., undersampling, SMOTE-based interpolation, or cost-sensitive learning, typically assume that the minority population is homogeneous. This means their effectiveness is severely limited in the multifaceted conditions encountered in industrial practice. This paper determines the possibility of a failure-type-conscious generative augmentation program to improve the identification of infrequent failures in predictive maintenance systems. An experimental design that is leakage-safe is used to compare five imbalance-handling methods: cost-sensitive learning, random undersampling, SMOTE oversampling, single-generator GAN augmentation, and a specialized multi-generator GAN architecture that has independent generators that are asked to learn individual failure subtypes. Precision/Recall-oriented measures are used to quantify model performance; the main evaluation measure is the PR-AUC. Experiments conducted on the AI4I 2020 predictive maintenance dataset indicate that the proposed multi-generator GAN framework produces more realistic minority samples, yielding higher PR-AUC and recall scores compared to traditional resampling methods and individual-generator GAN augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对预测性维护中工业数据高度不平衡且少数类故障呈多模态分布的问题，提出了一种基于多生成器GAN（每个生成器专门学习一种故障子类型）的数据增强框架。实验表明，该方法在AI4I 2020数据集上相比传统重采样方法和单生成器GAN，能生成更真实的少数类样本，并获得更高的PR-AUC和召回率。
AI.motivation: 在预测性维护场景中，机器故障虽然罕见但影响巨大，导致数据集存在严重的类别不平衡问题。更棘手的是，故障数据通常具有非齐次性（non-homogeneous），不同的故障模式源于不同的物理过程，呈现出跨少数类与类别的多模态分布。传统的类别不平衡处理方法（如欠采样、SMOTE过采样、代价敏感学习）均假设少数类群体是同质化的，这使其在复杂多变的工业实际场景中效果大打折扣。因此，亟需一种能够感知故障类型（failure-type-conscious）的生成式增强方案来提升对罕见故障的识别能力。
AI.method: 本文采用防止数据泄露（leakage-safe）的实验设计，在AI4I 2020预测性维护数据集上对比了五种不平衡处理方法：(1) 代价敏感学习；(2) 随机欠采样；(3) SMOTE过采样；(4) 单生成器GAN数据增强；(5) 本文提出的多生成器GAN架构（Multi-generator GAN），其中每个生成器被独立训练以学习特定的故障子类型分布。评估指标主要采用面向精确率/召回率的PR-AUC，同时辅以精确率、召回率等指标对模型性能进行量化。
AI.result: 在AI4I 2020预测性维护数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的多生成器GAN框架能够生成比传统重采样方法和单生成器GAN增强方法更为真实（realistic）的少数类样本；该方法在主要评估指标PR-AUC上表现最优，同时取得了更高的召回率（recall），验证了针对故障子类型分别建模的生成式增强策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论：在故障类型多样且数据分布多模态的预测性维护场景中，传统的同质化不平衡处理方法存在明显局限；采用故障类型感知的生成式数据增强（即多生成器GAN架构）为每个故障子类型独立建模，能够显著提升罕见故障的识别性能。该研究为工业预测性维护中的不平衡学习问题提供了一种有效的新思路。

title: Reasoning Before Translation: Enhancing Legal Machine Translation with Structured Reasoning
comment: Code available at this https URL
summary: Neural machine translation (NMT) in the legal domain is a linguistically and conceptually demanding task, primarily due to the complexity of legal language and the high level of precision it requires. The recent emergence of reasoning-capable language models opens new possibilities for tackling such challenges. They add to a set of other previously proposed techniques to enhance the translation quality, which includes supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. In this work, we perform a comparison between these various approaches. More particularly, we evaluate small language models such as Qwen3.5 4B, Qwen3.5 9B, and Gemma 3 12B enhanced with various re-training paradigms and compare their performances against frontier reasoning models. We focus on the Swiss legal system, which -- with its unique multilingual statutes -- offers a particularly challenging testbed for reasoning-augmented models. Our results show that the quality of small ``base'' models can be greatly enhanced, and that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can be applied to NMT in the legal domain and surpasses the translation quality of supervised fine-tuning. The performance of enhanced small models is close to the one of state-of-the-art reasoning models yet remains inferior. We also note that re-training paradigms yield diminishing returns as model size increase. The code and models are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文针对瑞士法律领域神经机器翻译任务,系统比较了三种融合推理能力的训练范式:提示大型推理模型、对小型语言模型进行监督微调(SFT)以及使用可验证奖励的强化学习(RL/GRPO)。核心发现是:RL 显著优于 SFT,且 Reasoning SFT 反而会降低翻译质量;经 RL 增强的小模型(如 Gemma 3 12B)虽仍略逊于前沿大模型,但以少 100 倍参数量接近其性能。
AI.motivation: 法律领域机器翻译因专业术语复杂、句法结构冗长、对术语精确性与法律意义保真度要求极高,极具挑战性。瑞士同时使用德、法、意、罗曼什四种官方语言,其多语种法律体系构成了检验推理增强模型的理想测试场景。同时,大型专有模型在数据隐私、部署成本和本地推理方面存在限制,促使研究者探索通过 SFT 和 RL 等再训练范式提升小型开源模型在法律翻译上的表现。
AI.method: 研究在 SwiLTra-Bench 的 SwissLawTranslations 子集上进行,采用 18.1k 测试句对(剔除罗曼什)。设计三组对比实验:(1) Experiment I 提示大型推理模型(OpenAI o3/o4-mini/o3-mini、DeepSeek-R1、Mistral-Small)作为基线;(2) Experiment II 对 Qwen3.5 4B/9B 和 Gemma 3 12B 进行 SFT,分为 Simple SFT(仅训练翻译)和 Reasoning SFT(加入 DeepSeek-R1 生成的中间推理步骤),使用 LoRA(r=16,α=32)、Alpaca 风格指令微调、温度为 0 的 vLLM 生成;(3) Experiment III 使用 GRPO 进行强化学习,设计两类可验证奖励:格式奖励(`<think>` 和 `<translation>` 标签正确顺序)和翻译质量奖励(以 ChrF 直接作为连续奖励),组大小 G=4,学习率 2e-5,单轮训练。同时利用 DeepSeek-R1 为 40k 句对生成中间推理,并基于 ChrF 中位数过滤得到 19,979 条高质量样本作为新数据集发布。评测采用 ChrF、METEOR、COMET、MetricX 四种指标,并补充 240 条样本的人工评估以验证相关性。
AI.result: 1) 前沿模型中,o3 综合最佳(ChrF 64.87, COMET 85.92),Mistral-Small-2503 性价比最高;o4-mini 在译入英语时尤其突出。2) 三种小型模型上,RL 在所有指标上一致超越 SFT 及基础模型,Gemma 3 12B + RL 取得最佳小型模型成绩(ChrF 57.32, COMET 83.08),性能逼近前沿的 o4-mini。3) Reasoning SFT 反而劣于 Simple SFT,尤其在 Qwen3.5 4B 上退化明显;Simple SFT 仅略低于基础模型。4) RL 带来的提升随模型增大呈递减趋势(Qwen3.5 4B +2.47 vs. Gemma 3 12B +0.59)。5) 人工评估显示 COMET 与专家评分相关性最高(r=0.24)。6) 不同语言对上趋势稳定,fr→it 因语言亲缘关系最强,而 fr→it 恰是前沿模型表现最好的方向,也是小模型差距最大的方向。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出三个主要结论:(a) SFT 与 RL 均能提升翻译质量,但对小模型效果尤为显著;(b) RL 的提升幅度大于 SFT;(c) Reasoning SFT 并不一致地优于 Simple SFT;(d) 模型规模起重要作用,Gemma 3 12B + GRPO 为评估范围内最佳小型模型。整体而言,RL 增强的小型开源模型能以显著更少的参数量(100× 差距)接近前沿商业模型,且具有隐私、成本与可复现性优势,是法律机器翻译的可行方案。未来工作将聚焦于更优奖励设计、训练策略及推理与训练成本的权衡。论文同时发布了 40k 含推理步骤的法律翻译数据集与 GRPO 训练配方,为后续研究提供基础资源。

title: MIRA-Ev:A Benchmark for Granular Evidence Detection and Relational Reasoning in Clinical Exams
summary: Clinical NLP evaluation remains dominated by multiple-choice question answering (MCQA), which scores only final-answer accuracy and cannot detect when a model reaches the correct diagnosis while grounding it in irrelevant, absent, or contradictory evidence. We introduce MIRA-Ev, a clinical argument mining benchmark built on Spanish Médico Interno Residente (MIR) licensing-exam cases, re-annotated by expert clinicians with span-level premises, claims, and directed support/attack relations, and released in parallel Spanish (native), English, and Basque versions, the first clinical argumentation resource in Basque. MIRA-Ev organizes evaluation into a three-tier task hierarchy: evidence sentence retrieval, argumentative component extraction, and relation classification.

AI.tldr: MIRA-Ev是首个基于西班牙MIR医师执照考试的多语种（西班牙语、英语、巴斯克语）临床论证挖掘（Argument Mining）基准，通过专家医生对span级别的premise（前提）、claim（主张）及support/attack（支持/攻击）关系进行重新标注，将临床推理评估解耦为三层级任务：证据句子检索、论证组件抽取、关系分类，揭示当前MCQA评估范式无法检测模型是否基于正确证据得出正确答案的关键缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前临床NLP评估以多选题问答（MCQA）为主导，仅评分最终答案准确性，无法识别模型虽得出正确诊断但其依据为无关、缺失或矛盾证据的失败模式。此外，临床论证挖掘资源在非英语（尤其是低资源语言如巴斯克语）中严重匮乏，形成数据稀缺与隐私约束的"双重瓶颈"。本文旨在填补该差距，将MCQA数据重构为结构化的证据-关系任务，独立评估答案正确性与推理有效性。
AI.method: 1. 数据来源：基于西班牙官方MIR考试题（来自CasiMedicos），剥离既有标注与医生解释，保留原始病例（病史、症状、临床问题与4-5个候选选项）。2. 专家标注：由临床医生对254个病例进行词级（word-level）span标注，区分premise（症状、体征、实验室检查值）与claim（诊断结论/假设），并标注premise与claim之间的有向support/attack关系。3. 多语种构建：西班牙语为原生语料，平行发布英语与巴斯克语版本。4. 任务层级：（i）证据句子检索——句子级二分类；（ii）论证组件抽取——BIOES序列标注，识别sub-sentential的premise/claim；（iii）关系分类——判断directed support/attack关系。5. 评估指标：采用严格匹配（字符级边界对齐）与宽松匹配（Jaccard指数，IoU≥0.5）双标准。6. 基准模型：使用EriBERTa双语编码器建立流水线基线，并通过token classification、BIOES tagging、entity-marker encoding三种方法分别处理三层任务。
AI.result: 语料统计：254个病例（128训练/24开发/102测试），共1168个premise、1175个claim、1407条support关系、1355条attack关系，约20%的证据span为sub-sentential级别。基准结果（EriBERTa流水线）：（1）Task 1证据检索——准确率74.81%，macro F1为73.48%，Relevant类F1=79.42优于Not-Relevant类（F1=67.54）；（2）Task 2组件抽取——严格匹配macro F1=62.63，宽松匹配F1=68.02；Claim抽取F1达98.23（因选项直接对应claim，存在结构性捷径），而Premise严格F1仅27.03、宽松F1为37.80；（3）Task 3关系分类——性能最低，严格macro F1=7.58，宽松F1=10.61；Attack关系（F1=8.84严格）优于Support关系（F1=6.32严格）。关键发现：（i）Claim高性能源于结构设计而非真实抽取能力，在premise/claim角色反转的子集中模型严重退化，暴露其依赖位置启发式（默认选项为claim）的缺陷；（ii）严格与宽松匹配差距显著，表明模型已捕获语义但被边界噪声惩罚；（iii）Task 3性能低下主要源于上游抽取错误的级联传播，而非关系分类本身的失败。
AI.conclusion: MIRA-Ev通过三层级评估体系与严格/宽松双重匹配指标，揭示了当前临床NLP模型的两个核心瓶颈：（1）边界灵活性不足——严格的字符级匹配将微小的span边界偏差转化为显著的评估惩罚，掩盖了模型的真实语义理解能力；（2）否定与复杂推理的脆弱性——Support关系检测持续弱于Attack关系，反映出模型在处理否定与比较逻辑上的普遍缺陷。此外，模型对位置启发式的依赖（默认选项为claim）表明其尚未真正从内容与上下文推断论证角色。研究强调，此类架构在临床真实部署前需大量人类监督，以避免因negation处理或边界错误导致的临床决策风险。

title: Assessment in Team Problem-Solving Exercises in Computing Education
comment: Full paper accepted for the main track of the IEEE FIE 2026 conference
summary: This full paper in the research-to-practice track presents methods for assessing student teams in tabletop exercises (TTXs). TTXs enable learner teams to prepare for workplace tasks and practice crisis responses, such as resolving cybersecurity incidents. While assessment is essential for determining how well teams achieve learning objectives, the complex, open-ended nature of TTXs often leads to delayed or incomplete feedback. TTX learning platforms can record teams' actions and communication; yet, leveraging these data to assess performance is underexplored. To address this gap, we compared two post-TTX team assessment methods -- clustering and large language models (LLMs) -- using an original dataset from 81 participants across two countries. We evaluated these methods against instructor-assigned scores based on standardized rubrics. Clustering grouped teams that approached TTX tasks similarly, enabling instructors to deliver faster, targeted feedback to teams within a cluster. This method was valid and reliable, with low computational requirements. LLMs used the standardized rubrics to assess teams' communication. While GPT-4o frequently disagreed with instructor scores, GPT-5.2 demonstrated considerably lower error. The researched methods have been integrated into INJECT, an open-source TTX learning platform, to support scalability and teaching practice. To encourage community adoption, we publicly share all datasets, software tools, and a full-fledged TTX scenario.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对网络安全桌面推演(TTX)中团队表现评估的难题,提出了两种自动化评估方法:基于聚类的方法(按行为相似性分组团队)和基于大语言模型的方法(用标准化评分量表评估团队书面沟通)。基于捷克和爱沙尼亚两国81名参与者共24个团队的数据,研究发现聚类方法有效可靠、计算成本低且能保护隐私,而LLM评估中GPT-4o与教师评分差异显著,更新的GPT-5.2虽有所改善但仍未达到人类评分水平。所有方法已集成到开源INJECT平台并公开发布。
AI.motivation: 桌面推演(TTX)作为网络安全教育中日益重要的实践教学方式,常因任务复杂、开放性强导致教师评估延迟数天甚至数周,削弱了教学反馈的时效性和教育效果。现有TTX学习平台虽能记录团队行为和沟通数据,但如何利用这些数据进行自动化评估仍是未充分探索的空白,亟需可靠的方法来替代耗时的人工评估,以实现快速、有针对性的反馈。
AI.method: 研究采用两种自动化评估方法进行对比:(1)基于DBSCAN的无监督共识聚类(50次迭代平均),使用里程碑ID、时间戳和工具使用等IXP日志特征,按行为相似性分组团队,通过聚类内RMSE与所有可能分组的基线RMSE比较进行评估;(2)基于LLM(对比GPT-4o和GPT-5.2)的方法,将NICE网络安全框架和标准化写作评分量表整合到提示词中,对团队书面目击事件响应邮件按三个标准(简洁性、适合受众、语法正确性)进行0-2分评分。基准为两位专家教师依据相同量表的人工评分。数据来源于捷克EXF(数据泄漏)和爱沙尼亚PHI(钓鱼攻击)两次TTX中13+10共23个团队在INJECT Exercise Platform上的活动日志和邮件内容。
AI.result: 聚类方法在两次TTX中均优于基线(EXF:RMSE 0.45 vs 0.53;PHI:RMSE 0.79 vs 1.12),聚类能在2分钟内于普通笔记本上完成,有效识别出行为模式相似的团队(如高分平衡型、高分程序型、低分型和平均技术型团队);LLM方面,两位教师间评分差异RMSE为0.32(16%),GPT-4o与教师评分的平均RMSE为1.10(55%),几乎等同于随机水平,而GPT-5.2降至0.71(35%),改进显著但仍不够对齐人类判断。LLM还存在情绪分析偏差、对外部服务依赖等局限。
AI.conclusion: 聚类方法有效、可靠、计算轻量且保护隐私,适合作为TTX团队评估的实用工具,可帮助教师快速向同聚类团队提供针对性反馈;而通用LLM在领域特定的TTX沟通评估中表现不佳,需谨慎使用并由人工审核。研究方法已集成到开源INJECT平台,数据集、代码、练习场景全部公开发布以推动社区采纳。未来工作可探索聚类与LLM的集成框架、使用网络安全专用LLM(如CyLLM)以及引入音视频数据进行多模态评估。研究为TTX评估文献贡献了课堂实证证据,并强调了在领域特定场景中LLM适用性的局限性。

title: Beyond Score Prediction: LLM-Based Essay Scoring and Feedback Generation via Reinforcement Learning with Rubric Rewards
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely applied to automated essay scoring (AES) and automated feedback generation (AFG). However, existing studies rely primarily on prompt engineering or supervised fine-tuning, while systematic research on reinforcement learning (RL) post-training and automated evaluation of feedback quality remains limited. We propose RLAES, a unified LLM framework that jointly optimizes essay scoring and feedback generation through RL. To make feedback quality measurable, interpretable, and usable for training, we introduce Rubric-based Feedback Evaluation (RFE), an essay-grounded feedback evaluation framework comprising 166 fine-grained binary rubric items and an LLM-as-judge. Building on RFE, we propose Adaptive Gated Feedback Optimization (AGFO), which activates rubric-based feedback rewards on demand during RL, reducing evaluation overhead while improving feedback quality. We also propose Adjacent Contrastive Reasoning (ACR) to improve ordinal score calibration by explicitly contrasting adjacent score levels. Experimental results show that the RFE framework captures essay-feedback consistency, exhibits strong pairwise discriminative power, and closely aligns with expert preferences. On the ASAP benchmark, RLAES-AGFO achieves the best scoring performance among LLM-based methods (QWK = 0.803), while maintaining feedback quality comparable to GPT-5.5 and avoiding the feedback degradation observed under score-only RL. Code and datasets are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLAES框架，通过强化学习联合优化自动作文评分（AES）和自动反馈生成（AFG）。核心贡献包括：基于166项二元评分项的反馈评估框架RFE、按需激活反馈奖励的自适应门控优化方法AGFO，以及用于序数评分校准的相邻对比推理策略ACR。在ASAP基准上，RLAES-AGFO取得LLM方法中最佳QWK（0.803），反馈质量与GPT-5.5相当。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在AES和AFG上主要依赖提示工程或监督微调（SFT），强化学习后训练的系统性研究不足；同时，AFG缺乏可扩展、细粒度且可作为RL奖励信号的反馈质量评估方法，导致反馈优化难以开展。另一个问题是序数评分中相邻分数级别的混淆（adjacent confusion）缺乏显式建模。
AI.method: 1) RFE框架：从ASAP教师反馈出发，经LLM改写与多智能体（5个不同LLM）迭代细化，构建覆盖Coverage、Evidence、Faithfulness、Safety四维度、166项二元评分项的反馈评估清单，配合LLM-as-judge输出标量奖励。2) AGFO：基于GRPO的RL后训练，以得分奖励+反馈奖励为总奖励；通过周期性门控机制（周期n、阈值τ）按需调用LLM-as-judge，降低评估开销。3) ACR：在最终评分前显式回答"为何不应给相邻较低/较高分"，利用锚定-调整启发式进行局部边界判别，缓解相邻分数混淆。
AI.result: 在ASAP基准（5折交叉验证）上，RLAES-AGFO平均QWK=0.803，为LLM方法中最优；RFE在pairwise判别力、与专家偏好一致性上表现良好；RLAES-AGFO反馈质量与GPT-5.5相当，且避免了仅使用得分奖励RL时的反馈退化。ACR在纯提示工程下带来显著提升（DeepSeek-V4-Pro QWK从0.430→0.462，Qwen3.7-Max从0.446→0.473），但在RL后训练中增益较小（+0.003）。消融实验显示，跨prompt联合训练带来不超过0.005的QWK下降。
AI.conclusion: RLAES-AGFO成功将LLM在AES/AFG上的方法从提示工程和SFT拓展到RL后训练，实现了评分与反馈的联合优化，且评估开销可控。局限在于依赖LLM裁判（存在偏好差异导致的奖励失配风险），且实验仅覆盖prompt-specific的英文ASAP数据集。未来工作应探索跨prompt、跨领域、多语言场景及联合评分-反馈的替代优化策略。

title: The Price of Reasoning: Cost-Quality Tradeoffs in Reinforcement Learning for Neural Machine Translation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been established as a viable paradigm for the post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs), including downstream tasks, such as Neural Machine Translation (NMT). With the latest research indicating that RLVR could be the preferred training method for translating legal documents due to the induced reasoning capabilities, it raises the question whether it is really attributed to the reasoning or more generally to the training paradigm. We investigate the importance of including the model's reasoning trace in the generated responses during both training and inference by systematically omitting it from one of the phases. Our experiments show that including the reasoning, specifically during inference, has a positive effect on the overall translation quality. Furthermore, we recognise that the reasoning leads to an increase in output tokens, hence we study the cost-quality tradeoff between the increased computational demands and the improved translation quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）框架下训练大语言模型进行法律文档机器翻译时，推理痕迹（reasoning trace）在训练和推理阶段的重要性，并分析了计算成本与翻译质量的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 最新研究表明，RLVR 因其引发的推理能力而成为翻译法律文档的首选训练方法。但论文提出疑问：翻译质量的提升究竟归因于"推理能力"本身，还是更普遍地归因于这种训练范式？为厘清这一根本问题，需要系统性研究推理痕迹在训练与推理各阶段的作用。
AI.method: 采用系统性消融实验方法：在 RLVR 框架下，针对法律文档神经机器翻译（NMT）任务，分别在训练阶段和推理阶段系统性地省略模型的推理痕迹（即从生成响应中移除推理过程），通过对比不同配置下的表现来评估推理痕迹的作用。同时进行成本-质量的权衡分析，研究因推理导致的输出 token 增加所带来的计算开销与翻译质量提升之间的关系。
AI.result: 实验表明，在推理阶段包含推理痕迹对整体翻译质量具有积极正向的影响。论文同时观察到，推理痕迹会显著增加输出 token 的数量，因此在计算成本（推理时延与算力消耗）与翻译质量之间存在明确的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 推理痕迹（而非仅仅是 RLVR 训练范式本身）在推理阶段对提升法律文档翻译质量起关键作用；但其带来的质量提升需要与增加的输出 token 成本进行权衡，提示在实际部署中需根据具体场景在质量与效率之间取得平衡。

title: Inference-Time Steering for Cross-Lingual Factual Consistency in LLMs
comment: 8 pages (21 in total), 2 figures, 4 tables. Original manuscript for a Guided Research project conducted at the Technical University of Munich, detailing the complete methodology, full data pipeline, and comprehensive experimental results. A related, condensed subset of this work was subsequently adapted and published at the StereACuLT 2026 workshop
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable multilingual fluency, their internal knowledge representations remain disproportionately biased toward high-resource languages. This leads to cross-lingual factual inconsistency, where they shift their empirical answer distributions based solely on the prompt language. We investigate whether these biases can be mitigated at inference time, forcing an English-prompted model to answer as if it were queried in target languages (German, Spanish, Bulgarian), and evaluate four intervention strategies: zero-shot contextual steering (persona prompting), internal representation manipulation via Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), and lightweight weight modification via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) trained on benchmark-derived factual data as well as conceptual generalization data. To assess alignment, we curate a multilingual factual dataset alongside a novel generalization benchmark comprising culturally rooted queries to determine whether factual interventions transfer to broader target-centric preferences. Experiments on Gemma 3 12B Instruct reveal persona prompting to be the strongest overall intervention, balancing efficacy, safety, and out-of-domain generalization. While CAA yields sharp inconsistency benchmark shifts, it is configuration-sensitive and risks knowledge degradation. DPO-based adapters offer permanent, yet narrower and less transferable gains. These findings suggest that cross-lingual inconsistency is at least partly a selection problem, and that simple contextual interventions may outperform more invasive methods for robust, transferable alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在推理时如何缓解跨语言事实不一致问题，强制以英语提示的模型像被目标语言（德语、西班牙语、保加利亚语）查询一样作答。比较了四种干预策略：零样本角色提示、对比激活添加（CAA）、针对事实数据的直接偏好优化（DPO）以及针对概念泛化数据的DPO。实验基于Gemma 3 12B Instruct模型，结果显示角色提示在效果、安全性和跨域泛化方面综合表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型具备多语言能力，但其内部知识表征偏向高资源语言，导致跨语言事实不一致——即模型仅根据提示语言改变其经验性答案分布。这一偏差影响模型的多语言可靠性和事实一致性，因此亟需在推理阶段以轻量级方式缓解该问题，使模型能基于目标语言的文化语境给出更合适的回答。
AI.method: 研究设计了一个多语言事实数据集和一个包含文化扎根查询的新型泛化基准。比较四种推理时干预方法：(1) 零样本上下文引导（角色提示），通过让模型扮演目标语言使用者来实现；(2) 对比激活添加（CAA），通过操纵模型内部表征进行干预；(3) 基于事实数据训练DPO适配器进行轻量级权重修改；(4) 基于概念泛化数据训练的DPO适配器。在Gemma 3 12B Instruct上评估各方法在跨语言事实一致性和文化泛化方面的表现。
AI.result: 实验结果揭示了各方法的权衡关系：角色提示（persona prompting）作为整体最强干预，在效果、安全性和域外泛化方面表现最为均衡；CAA能产生显著的事实不一致性基准偏移，但对配置敏感，存在知识退化风险；基于DPO的适配器虽能提供永久性改进，但增益范围较窄且跨任务迁移性较差。结果表明跨语言不一致至少部分是一种"选择问题"，而非纯粹的知识缺失。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现简单的上下文干预（角色提示）在稳健且可迁移的对齐方面可能优于更具侵入性的方法（如表征操纵或权重修改）。跨语言不一致问题至少部分是模型选择层面的问题，而非完全源于知识缺失。这为多语言LLM的对齐研究提供了实践指导：在处理跨语言事实一致性问题时，应优先考虑轻量级、可解释的上下文干预方法，而非更复杂的内部机制修改。

title: Prompt Design at Scale: How Format, Instruction Count, and Context Length Shape Instruction Adherence and Hallucination in Large Language Models
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Practitioners make three prompt-design decisions with almost no controlled evidence behind them: how to format instructions and context (markdown, plain text, prose, or tabular), how many simultaneous instructions a system prompt can carry before compliance degrades, and how much context a model can hold before recall and honesty degrade. We report two controlled experiments crossing all three factors on one held, contamination-free synthetic corpus (the "Book of Veyra," 8,780 uniquely-named entities, deterministically regenerable from a fixed seed), evaluated across five models. Experiment 1 (960 calls/model) measures instruction-following decay as rule count N grows from 10 to 160, crossed with four formats and system-prompt vs. user-turn placement. Perfect-response rate collapses to zero by N=80 for every model, format, and placement. Placement produces effects at least as large as format at N=160 in most models, but the direction is model-specific. No model shows a reliable markdown advantage; one 35B model favors plain text instead. Experiment 2 (5,520 calls/model) measures recall accuracy, false-premise sycophancy, and absent-fact fabrication across a 2k-to-512k-token context ladder in the same four formats. Recall stays near ceiling through 64-128k tokens, then degrades sharply and format-dependently: one model's accuracy spread reaches 48 points at 128k tokens. Fabrication never occurs (0/5,760 probes), and sycophancy stays negligible (<=8.3%). What rises sharply near each model's context ceiling is outright refusal to answer (0% to 79-90%), distinct from sycophancy or fabrication. Neither pre-registered format ordering holds, and token overhead (+22% to +37% over plain text) further changes which format is preferable where accuracy spread is genuine. We release the full harness, corpus generator, and raw results (VeyraBench): this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文通过两项受控实验,系统性地交叉检验了提示词的三个设计维度——格式(markdown/纯文本/散文/表格)、指令数量(10–160条)和上下文长度(2k–512k token)——对大语言模型指令遵循能力和幻觉行为的影响。研究基于一个合成的、零污染的"Ve yra之书"语料库(8,780个唯一命名实体),在5个模型上展开测试。核心结论是:格式效应无法与规模脱离讨论;不存在普遍最优的格式;真正在长上下文边界上升的失败模式是拒绝回答而非幻觉。
AI.motivation: 实践者在设计LLM提示词时常面临三个核心决策——如何格式化指令和上下文、单个提示词能承载多少条指令、模型能有效处理多长上下文——但几乎没有受控实验证据支撑这些决策。已有研究要么在固定规模下研究格式敏感性,要么研究指令数或上下文长度的扩展而不变动格式,从未在统一语料上同时交叉检验这三者。本文认为这种分离式研究是错误的,主张格式必须在指令数量和上下文长度的规模维度上联合评估。
AI.method: 研究采用单一设计原则:同一内容以四种格式(markdown、纯文本、散文、表格)渲染,并沿各自的规模轴推至失效。实验1(每个模型960次调用)测量指令遵循衰减曲线:N∈{10,20,40,80,120,160}条可编程验证规则,交叉四种格式和系统提示词vs.用户轮次的放置位置,每格20次试验。实验2(每个模型5,520次调用)在2k–512k token的上下文阶梯上测量召回准确性、错误前提的谄媚性,以及未陈述事实的编造,采用recall/false-premise/absent三类探针,每模型、每级、每格式20题×3重复。两个长上下文模型(Sonnet 5、Gemini Flash)测试至512k,其余三个测试至128k。同时使用固定20题的anchor set实现跨rung的横向比较控制。
AI.result: 主要发现:(1)完美回答率在N=80时对所有模型、格式和放置位置都跌至零,呈现硬性下限效应而非渐近衰减;(2)格式无可靠赢家:Qwen 35B在5/6个N层级上反而偏好纯文本而非markdown,最大差距达4.8个百分点;(3)放置位置效应与格式效应相当甚至更大(四个模型中),但方向因模型而异:用户轮次对Claude Haiku和Qwen 35B有帮助(+6.6pp、+5.1pp),对Gemini Flash和Qwen 27B有害(-8.7pp、-1.8pp);(4)Gemini Flash在N≥40时散文和表格格式出现特定的模型-格式交互崩溃;(5)召回在64–128k token前保持接近天花板,之后急剧下降且依赖格式——Claude Haiku在128k的格式间差距高达48.4pp(纯文本仅38.3%);(6)编造率始终为零(0/5,760探针),谄媚性始终≤8.3%;(7)真正急剧上升的是拒绝回答率(0%→79–90%),这是与幻觉不同的第三种失败模式;(8)格式的token开销差异显著(比纯文本高22%–37%),在存在真实准确性差距时,成本调整可能逆转格式优劣排序;(9)两种预注册的结构假设(任一结构有帮助 vs. 表格结构特别有效)均未成立,同一格式在不同模型/层级上可能从最优变为最差。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心论断是:格式效应与其符号方向均无法脱离规模进行预测。指令遵循在N=80处出现地板效应,与格式无关;放置位置作为格式研究中常被忽略的变量,有时产生与格式相当甚至更大的影响;召回准确性的下降与模型各自的有效上下文上限相关而非绝对token数;预注册的结构假设无一成立;长上下文压力下的真实失败模式是拒绝回答,而非传统幻觉基准所关注的编造或谄媚。实践启示包括:不存在可默认的最优格式需自行测试;放置位置是低成本可调杠杆;约40条指令是重新设计而非微调的临界点;在上下文边界附近应监控拒绝率而非仅监控幻觉;仅在存在真实准确性差距时才有必要进行成本调整分析。作者发布完整工具链、语料生成器和原始结果(VeyraBench),支持字节级精确复现。

title: Benchmarking Generalization in Financial Statement Fraud Detection: robust evaluation and novel tasks
summary: Financial statement fraud detection (FSFD) is crucial for market integrity but faces challenges from increasingly sophisticated schemes and under-utilized textual data in financial reports. Existing methods often rely on random data splits, leading to overoptimistic performance estimates that do not reflect real-world generalization to new companies or future periods. To address this recurring problem with the state of the art, we propose a robust FSFD framework leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to integrate both structured financial data and unstructured textual information from financial reports. We provide a more realistic evaluation through a novel and challenging benchmark task called Company-Isolated FSFD (CI-FSFD). We construct and make publicly available a comprehensive U.S. company dataset combining financial statements, summarized MD&A text, and fraud labels. Our approach achieves the best performance on the challenging CI-FSFD task, demonstrating the critical value of textual data and robust evaluation for reliable financial fraud detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型(LLM)的财务报表欺诈检测(FSFD)框架，整合结构化财务数据与非结构化文本信息(如MD&A摘要)，并通过新的"公司隔离(Company-Isolated)"评估基准(CI-FSFD)提供更贴近真实场景的鲁棒性评估。
AI.motivation: 现有FSFD方法普遍采用随机数据划分(random splits)，导致性能评估过于乐观，难以泛化到未见过的新公司或未来时期；同时，大量财务报表中的文本数据未被充分利用，且欺诈手段日益复杂，亟需更现实可靠的检测方案。
AI.method: 1. 构建并公开发布一个综合性的美国公司数据集，融合财务数据、MD&A文本摘要及欺诈标签；2. 提出基于LLM的多模态融合框架，同时处理结构化(财务指标)与非结构化(文本)特征；3. 设计新的评估基准CI-FSFD，按公司进行隔离划分，以避免同一公司数据泄露；4. 利用LLM整合两种模态信息进行欺诈分类。
AI.result: 该方法在具有挑战性的CI-FSFD任务上取得最佳性能，验证了在更现实、更严格的评估设置下仍能保持优势，同时证明了文本数据与稳健评估对可靠财务欺诈检测的关键价值。
AI.conclusion: 文本数据对财务欺诈检测具有重要补充价值，而公司隔离的评估方式更能反映真实泛化能力；研究为未来FSFD研究提供了更可靠的数据集与基准，对市场诚信监管具有实践意义。

title: Toward Auditable Fraud Detection: Combining Graph Features, Model Explanations, and Agentic Case Investigation
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. Code available at this https URL
summary: Fraud detection systems must scale with rising transaction volume while remaining explainable and reviewable. We study a layered pipeline on the PaySim dataset that combines a gradient-boosted classifier, graph-derived structural features, an autoencoder-based anomaly signal, TreeSHAP explanations, and a bounded LLM investigation agent applied to cases the classifier scores uncertainly. Before any model comparison, we identify and remove a simulator-specific balance shortcut that would otherwise inflate baseline performance. After this correction, neither the graph features nor the anomaly signal improves Average Precision on the full test set. Both, however, rank fraud better within the subset of cases receiving intermediate baseline scores. In a controlled experiment with injected multi-account fraud rings, engineered structural features recover all injected test transactions, while the tabular baseline misses roughly a quarter of them. The investigation agent underperforms direct thresholding of the classifier it relies on, reaching 65.0% accuracy against 71.7% on a balanced 60-case sample, despite having access to model explanations, graph context, and retrieved reference cases. Of the eight decisions the agent changed, six replaced correct classifier outputs with errors, and it produced a coherent written rationale in each case. An exploratory disagreement-based escalation rule flagged two of these agent errors for human review without flagging any correct decision. We conclude that each component of a layered fraud system contributes only under specific conditions, and that a plausible rationale from an investigation agent is not evidence of a better decision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个基于 PaySim 数据集的分层欺诈检测流水线，整合了梯度提升分类器、图结构特征、自编码器异常信号、TreeSHAP 解释和受限的 LLM 调查代理。研究发现，在去除仿真器特有的余额捷径后，图特征和异常信号并未提升整体 Average Precision，但在中间分数子集和注入的多账户欺诈环实验中有价值；LLM 调查代理的表现（65.0%）反而不如直接阈值化分类器（71.7%），且其给出的合理化解释并不能证明决策更优。
AI.motivation: 金融机构面临大量需要调查的交易警报（误报约占反金融犯罪团队 27% 的工时），同时欺诈手段日益自动化（包括代理 AI 的使用），需要在规模化检测与可解释性、可审查性之间取得平衡。然而，分层系统中各组件（分类器、图特征、异常信号、LLM 调查代理）的独立贡献及其适用条件尚不清晰，特别是代理是否真正改善底层分类器的决策，以及如何利用分类器与代理的分歧来决定人工审查的升级。
AI.method: 在 PaySim 数据集上构建分层流水线：(1) 首先识别并移除仿真器特有的余额捷径（origin 端余额字段）；(2) 使用 XGBoost（300 棵树，深度 6）作为基础分类器；(3) 图特征包括工程化结构特征（节点度、唯一发送者数）和 node2vec 嵌入（仅在多次出现的账户子图上学习）；(4) 自编码器仅在合法交易上训练，以重构误差作为异常信号；(5) 使用 TreeSHAP 解释分类器；(6) 构建受限 LLM 调查代理（Llama 3.3 70B），仅作用于分类器分数在 [0.2, 0.8] 区间的 60 个平衡样本（30 欺诈/30 合法），可访问四个工具获取交易详情、SHAP 归因、图上下文和检索参考案例；(7) 设计基于分歧的升级规则（代理与分类器不一致且分类器分数 ≥0.65 或 ≤0.35 时升级人工审查）；(8) 注入 40 个合成欺诈环（每环 5 账户 6 交易）进行控制实验。主要评估指标为 Average Precision。
AI.result: （1）去除仿真器余额捷径后，完整测试集上 Hard baseline（AP=0.7677）优于所有增强变体；图特征和异常信号并未提升整体性能。（2）在基线定义的困难子集（103,165 笔交易，含 184 笔欺诈）中，自编码器增强模型 AP 最高（0.0138），但绝对值仍很低。（3）控制实验中，注入 39 笔测试欺诈环交易，Hard baseline 召回率 76.9%（30/39），图增强模型检测全部 39 笔，但原始 PaySim 欺诈召回率略降（0.8923→0.8838）。（4）代理正确决策 39/60（65.0%），分类器阈值化 43/60（71.7%）；8 次分歧中仅 2 次纠正了分类器错误，6 次将正确决策改为错误，代理每次都给出了连贯的书面理由。（5）探索性升级规则在 60 例中升级 2 例（均为代理错误），未误升任何正确决策，自动决策覆盖率 96.7%，选择性准确率 67.2%。
AI.conclusion: 分层欺诈系统中各组件仅在特定条件下贡献价值：图特征在存在重复多账户结构时有价值，异常信号在中间分数子集中排序欺诈更优，但两者在整体测试集上并未改善基线。可信的书面理由并不等同于更好的决策——LLM 调查代理虽能产生连贯解释，却系统性地将正确分类器决策替换为错误判断，主要因过度依赖参考案例距离。基于分类器-代理分歧的升级规则可作为选择性风险控制机制，但需在独立数据上验证。整体而言，附加检测信号和调查代理需要明确的操作角色、目标场景评估和显式的自动化边界，且最关键的下一步是在真实交易数据和时序划分下进行验证。

title: GUIDED Network-Agnostic Feature Initialization for Spatial Transferability in GNN-based Models
summary: The Traffic Assignment Problem is a fundamental but computationally expensive component of transportation planning. While Graph Neural Networks have emerged as fast, data-driven surrogates, their practical deployment is severely constrained by a spatial generalization gap. Standard models rely on transductive feature initializations that tie travel demand to fixed network topologies, preventing seamless transfer to new urban environments. To overcome this structural limitation, this research proposes a network-agnostic initialization layer, termed Geometrically Unconstrained Inductive Demand EmbeDding (GUIDED). By injecting travel demand as a scalar attribute on auxiliary virtual links rather than as specific node features, this modular framework standardizes the input space regardless of network scale. Extensive experimental evaluation across multiple urban topologies demonstrates that a Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network (HetGAT) model integrated with the proposed GUIDED layer maintains state-of-the-art predictive accuracy on single-network tasks, while demonstrating superior robustness to out-of-distribution demand patterns and maintaining a distinct performance advantage over the baseline even under severe data scarcity. Notably, the proposed feature initialization enables highly parameter-efficient domain adaptation for inter-network transfer learning without artificial input homogenization, establishing a robust foundation for truly inductive models. At the same time, the optimized scatter operations of the initialization layer yield an approximate 50% reduction in training time per epoch compared to the baseline approach. Furthermore, while demonstrated on vehicular traffic, this fundamental abstraction of spatial topology provides a versatile blueprint for generalized origin-destination spatial problems, such as freight logistics and multimodal network optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GUIDED（Geometrically Unconstrained Inductive Demand EmbeDding），一种网络无关的特征初始化层，将出行需求作为标量属性注入到辅助虚拟链路上，而非绑定到固定节点特征上。该方法解耦了输入特征维度与网络物理规模的关联，使 GNN 代理模型能够跨不同城市拓扑进行空间迁移。
AI.motivation: GNN 代理模型在交通分配问题（TAP）中面临"空间泛化鸿沟"：现有模型采用转导式特征初始化，将出行需求矩阵直接映射到与特定网络规模绑定的节点特征中，导致模型结构性地无法迁移到新城市拓扑。这限制了交通规划中的情景分析、容量扩展及基础设施改造等实际部署需求。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含物理节点、实际边和虚拟 OD 边的异构图；2) GUIDED 两阶段初始化：第一阶段通过 MLP（线性变体）或 RBF 扩展将虚拟边上的标量需求投影为高维嵌入；第二阶段通过排列不变求和分别聚合节点的入向和出向虚拟边嵌入，构成统一维度的初始节点嵌入；3) 将该模块化层集成到现有 HetGAT 架构中形成 GUIDED-HetGAT（含 lin 和 rbf 两个变体）；4) 采用由 V/C 损失、流量损失和守恒损失组成的物理信息 L1 复合损失进行训练。
AI.result: 在 Anaheim 和 Chicago 等多个真实城市网络上的实验表明：GUIDED-HetGAT 在单网络任务上保持最先进预测精度；对分布外需求模式表现出更强的鲁棒性；在严重数据稀缺场景下仍具性能优势；无需人工输入同质化即可实现参数高效的跨网络迁移学习；初始化层的优化 scatter 操作使每轮训练时间较基线减少约 50%。
AI.conclusion: GUIDED 框架通过将全局需求信息抽象为局部图聚合问题，从根本上解耦了输入空间与网络规模，为真正归纳式的 GNN 代理模型奠定了基础。该方法虽以机动车交通为验证场景，但其对空间拓扑的抽象具有通用性，可推广至货运物流和多模式网络优化等广义起讫点空间交互问题。

title: The safety failures we are not instrumenting: a perspective on hidden safety-critical challenges in modern AI systems
comment: Email by the arXiv Support Team: "Dear Gjergji, Thank you for your patience. Your appeal was accepted. You are welcome to resubmit this work at your convenience to cs.CY (cs.AI, cs.HC) Regards, arXiv Support"
summary: Current AI safety discourse still focuses disproportionately on visible failures, including obvious harms, dramatic misuse, and hypothetical catastrophic scenarios. That focus is incomplete. In deployed systems, many of the most consequential failures are quieter: plausible rather than spectacular, distributed across components rather than localized in a single output, and normalized by workflows before they are recognized as hazards. We argue that a central safety challenge in modern AI systems is increasingly not only whether a model emits a harmful response, but whether the broader socio-technical system preserves the conditions under which errors remain visible, contestable, containable, and recoverable. We propose a five-layer framework for diagnosing these hidden risks: (1) epistemic integrity, concerning whether evidence and uncertainty are represented honestly enough to support calibrated reliance; (2) control integrity, concerning whether authority, permissions, and action boundaries remain robust under attack and optimization; (3) temporal integrity, concerning whether safety holds across sessions, memory updates, and deployment drift; (4) organizational integrity, concerning whether institutions retain the capacity to audit, assign responsibility, and intervene effectively; and (5) ecosystem integrity, concerning whether AI systems preserve rather than erode the information environment on which future oversight depends. Across these layers, we identify under-recognized risk patterns, including overreliance, uncertainty and legitimacy laundering in retrieval, prompt injection, reward hacking, memory poisoning, evaluation deception, fictional human oversight, synthetic evidence pollution, and model collapse. We conclude with design and governance recommendations and a research agenda for shifting AI safety from model-centric evaluation toward socio-technical reliability.

AI.tldr: 该论文是一篇观点性文章，指出当前AI安全研究过度关注"可见"的安全失败（如明显有害输出、滥用场景、灾难性假设），却忽视了更具系统性危害的"隐性"安全失败。作者提出一个五层框架（认知完整性、控制完整性、时间完整性、组织完整性、生态完整性），用于诊断和治理这些被低估的、隐蔽的系统级风险。
AI.motivation: 当前AI安全话语过度聚焦于可见的、局部的模型输出失败，忽视了那些"看似合理、跨组件分布、随时间累积、并会侵蚀纠错机制"的隐性失败模式。这些失败更难被察觉，却在部署中更具系统性危害。论文的动机在于将AI安全的分析重心从模型输出层转移至更广泛的社会技术系统层，强调安全不仅是模型的属性，更是整个部署栈的涌现属性。
AI.method: 方法层面，论文采用系统性综述与框架构建的方法，提出五层完整性诊断框架：(1) 认知完整性——证据与不确定性的忠实表征；(2) 控制完整性——在对抗与优化压力下权限与行动边界的稳健性；(3) 时间完整性——跨会话、记忆更新与部署漂移中的安全性保持；(4) 组织完整性——机构审计、追责与有效干预的能力；(5) 生态完整性——信息环境的保护而非侵蚀。同时，构建了一个实用控制表（表1），将每类隐性挑战与其隐藏原因、可行的控制措施及可测量的仪表化指标对应起来。此外，提出八项操作性议程（设计可证成的信任、分离建议与权限、记忆作为特权边界、轨迹级评估、真实人类监督、近失事件学习、信息共享空间保护、纵向社会技术审计）与12项研究优先方向。
AI.result: 论文识别并系统化了十类被低估的隐性风险模式，包括过度依赖（overreliance）与校准债务、检索中的合法性与不确定性洗白、提示注入、奖励黑客、记忆投毒、评估欺骗、虚构的人类监督、合成证据污染以及模型崩溃。每类风险均配套具体的设计与治理建议，例如：将指令权威架构性分离于模型外部、实施分级代理（graduated agency）、将持久记忆视为特权安全边界、用结构化安全论证替代单一基准评估、监控审查实质能力而非完成率、监测检索来源的合成污染比例等。核心结论是：安全的分析单元不应仅是孤立模型输出，而是社会技术系统持续保持错误可见、可争议、可遏制、可恢复的能力。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论强调，最危险的AI系统往往不是那些明显失效的系统，而是那些表面上"称职"却在暗中削弱怀疑精神、瓦解权限边界、跨时间存储不安全状态、并将责任扩散至多方的系统。安全的操作标准应是使错误保持"可见、可争议、可遏制、可恢复"，而非追求零错误。AI安全研究应从以模型为中心的评估转向社会技术可靠性（socio-technical reliability），从静态基准转向纵向社会技术审计，从单轮评估转向轨迹级评估，从名义上的人类在环转向有实际审查能力的人类监督，并保护支撑未来监督的信息环境。文章最后警示：AI能力发展速度与人类及机构审查能力发展速度之间的不对称本身即是一项安全风险。

title: Riemannian Deep Learning:Modules, Networks, and Geometries
comment: PhD thesis, University of Trento. The presentation has revised some typos in the previous published papers
summary: Deep neural networks on manifold-valued representations have attracted growing interest, but many basic components remain tied to specific manifolds, rely on Euclidean approximations, or require costly and numerically fragile geometric operations. This thesis develops a unified framework for Riemannian deep learning from three complementary perspectives: reusable neural modules, manifold-specific network architectures, and the design of underlying geometries. It generalizes batch normalization from Euclidean spaces and individual manifolds to broad classes of Lie groups and gyrogroups, and extends multinomial logistic regression from Euclidean space to SPD manifolds and then to general Riemannian manifolds. It further develops neural networks for several important geometric representations, including an unconstrained model of hyperbolic space, Busemann-based hyperbolic learning, and full-rank correlation matrices. Finally, it introduces adaptive and computationally efficient Riemannian metrics on SPD manifolds, including learnable Log-Euclidean geometries and fast, stable Cholesky-based geometries. The proposed methods are supported by theoretical analysis and validated through numerical experiments and applications in vision, signal processing, graph learning, and genomics.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于黎曼深度学习的博士论文，提出统一框架，从可复用神经模块、特定流形网络架构和底层几何设计三个互补视角展开研究，涵盖批量归一化、多项式逻辑回归、双曲空间、SPD流形等多个组件的理论扩展与实际应用。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在流形值表示（manifold-valued representations）上的应用日益受到关注，但许多基本组件仍局限于特定流形、依赖欧几里得近似或需要计算成本高、数值不稳定的几何操作。现有方法缺乏通用性和统一性，亟需一个能够跨多种几何结构复用的深度学习框架。
AI.method: 从三个互补视角构建统一框架：1) 可复用神经模块——将批量归一化从欧几里得空间推广到李群（Lie groups）和陀螺群（gyrogroups），将多项式逻辑回归从欧几里得空间推广到SPD流形及一般黎曼流形；2) 流形特定架构——开发双曲空间的无约束模型、基于Busemann的双曲学习、全秩相关矩阵网络；3) 底层几何设计——提出自适应且计算高效的SPD流形黎曼度量，包括可学习的对数欧几里得几何和基于Cholesky分解的快速稳定几何。方法辅以理论分析与数值实验验证。
AI.result: 理论层面：成功将多种欧几里得深度学习组件推广到广泛的黎曼流形类别。实践层面：所提方法在视觉、信号处理、图学习和基因组学等多个领域的应用中得到验证，表现出在计算效率、数值稳定性方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: 该论文通过统一三个互补视角，为黎曼深度学习建立了一个通用框架，解决了现有方法在通用性、计算效率和数值稳定性方面的局限性，扩展了深度学习在非欧几里得几何表示上的应用能力。

title: Off-Context GRPO: Learning to Reason on Hard Problems using Privileged Information
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in large language models. Yet, typical RLVR approaches fail on difficult problems: when a model cannot generate any correct solutions, it receives \textit{zero} learning signal. Providing privileged guidance during training, such as solution prefixes, can help overcome this learning cliff by steering the model towards {correct solutions with non-zero reward}. {We call these rollouts \textit{off-context}: they are generated from a training prompt that contains privileged guidance, while the target objective is defined by the original prompt without that guidance.} {We introduce} Off-Context GRPO (OC-GRPO), a minimally modified variant of GRPO that uses guided rollouts but applies an importance-corrected objective to steer the update back toward the original unguided objective, avoiding the mismatch that destabilizes uncorrected guided training. Empirically, our algorithm achieves a 3.9\% absolute improvement (13.8\% relative gain) over vanilla GRPO on average across standard mathematical reasoning benchmarks with negligible additional cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Off-Context GRPO (OC-GRPO)，这是 GRPO 算法的一个最小修改变体。它通过在训练时使用特权引导（如解题前缀）生成"非上下文（off-context）"的 rollout 来克服 RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）中的"学习悬崖"问题，即模型在难题上无法产生任何正确答案导致零学习信号。OC-GRPO 采用重要性采样修正，将引导的 rollout 重新加权回原始无引导的目标函数，避免了未修正引导训练中常见的目标不匹配问题。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上的数学推理基准测试中，平均比 vanilla GRPO 提升 3.9%（相对增益 13.8%），且计算开销可忽略不计。在小模型（1.5B、3B）上，引导基线方法表现甚至不如 vanilla GRPO，而 OC-GRPO 始终保持增益，表明反向泛化能力依赖于模型容量，离上下文修正在小模型上更为关键。
AI.motivation: 在 RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）中，GRPO 等算法在难题上会遭遇"学习悬崖"问题：当模型对某问题无法生成任何正确解时，所有 rollout 的奖励均为零，组内方差坍缩，梯度恒为零，模型无法从该问题中学习。现有解决方案（如 POPE、BREAD、PrefixRL）通过在 prompt 中注入特权引导（如解题前缀或提示）来恢复学习信号，但存在"非上下文（off-context）"问题：rollout 在引导 prompt 下采样，而更新却针对无引导目标，导致目标不对齐或梯度偏倚，可能使训练不稳定甚至崩溃。
AI.method:
1. **形式化问题**：定义"难题"为基模型在该问题下预期验证器奖励接近零的问题；定义引导策略 g(x)，对难题在 prompt 中加入解题前缀。
2. **核心算法 OC-GRPO**：保持标准 GRPO 框架不变，仅替换 per-token 重要性比率。将原 GRPO 的比率 ρ(θ) = π_θ(y|x,y_<t) / π_θ_old(y|x,y_<t) 替换为 OC 比率 ρ^oc(θ) = π_θ(y|x,y_<t) / π_θ_old(y|g(x),y_<t)，即在分子用无引导上下文、分母用引导上下文，从而通过重要性采样修正采样分布与目标分布的差异。
3. **理论性质**：证明响应级 OC-GRPO 对原目标 J(θ) 是无偏的（Theorem 3）；证明引导成功率 p(x)/q(x) < 1 而失败率 (1-p(x))/(1-q(x)) > 1，从而成功轨迹获得衰减的正向信用、失败轨迹获得放大的负向信用（Lemma 1 & Theorem 2）；证明离上下文修正项 γ 的方差与引导前缀长度 n 相关（而非 rollout 长度 T），给出"使用最短能打破悬崖的引导"的设计原则（Theorem 4）。
4. **两种变体**：OC-GRPO-Fixed（训练前用基模型预先确定每道题所需的最小引导层级，固定使用）和 OC-GRPO-Adaptive（训练中每步根据当前策略动态调整引导层级）。
5. **实验设置**：从 MATH 数据集 Level 3-5 中筛选 595 道难题（64 次 rollout 全失败的题目），使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct + LoRA 在 veRL 中训练，5 级解题前缀作为引导信号；在 AIME、Gaokao2023、OmniMath 等基准上评测 Pass@1 与 Pass@16。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，OC-GRPO-Fixed 平均 Pass@1 达 31.7%，相对 vanilla GRPO 提升 13.8%，绝对提升 3.9%，超过最强引导基线 POPE*（+8.7%）；在 Gaokao2023 和 OmniMath 上均居首位，AIME 上保持竞争力。在 3B 和 1.5B 规模上，OC-GRPO-Fixed 仍分别为 +7.2% 和 +10.2% 的相对增益，而引导基线方法（PrefixRL*、BREAD*、POPE*）在小模型上反而低于 vanilla GRPO（如 PrefixRL* 在 1.5B 下降 7.2%），表明反向泛化能力依赖于模型容量。无 IS 修正的"Masked no-IC"基线出现奖励坍缩和梯度范数飙升，验证了 IS 修正的必要性。提示（hints）作为替代引导信号同样有效，但效果略低于解题前缀。
AI.conclusion: OC-GRPO 通过 per-token 重要性采样修正，以极小的改动解决了引导 RLVR 中的"非上下文问题"，使训练可以在引导 prompt 下采样 rollout 同时仍准确估计无引导目标 J(θ)。该修正同时产生了行为感知的信用分配机制：折扣高度依赖引导的成功轨迹，保留对真正失败的惩罚。在 1.5B–7B 三个模型规模上均优于 vanilla GRPO 和现有引导方法，且小模型上的优势更加突出（因为反向泛化能力依赖于模型容量）。离上下文修正的方差与引导长度而非 rollout 长度相关，支持"用最短有效引导"的设计原则。该框架可推广至多轮/智能体 RLVR（如工具调用结果、环境状态等仅训练时可见的特权上下文）。

title: ISO: An RLVR-Native Optimization Stack
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is rapidly advancing the reasoning capabilities of language models, yet the optimization layer that converts reward feedback into weight-space updates remains poorly understood. Building on our prior analysis (Zhu et al., 2025), we study this missing layer through the singular structure of model weights and identify spectral inheritance: RLVR can reuse the base model's weight spectra while acquiring new behavior through changes in the associated input and output singular frames. We operationalize spectral inheritance as Isospectral Optimization (ISO), an RLVR-native, fixed-spectrum optimization framework with complementary offline and online instantiations. Offline, ISO-Merger combines the frame changes of shared-base specialists into a single fixed-spectrum model, requiring no post-merge data, rollouts, gradient updates, or on-policy distillation (OPD). It recovers complementary specialist capabilities and achieves the strongest aggregate performance among the compared data-free merging methods. Online, ISO-Optimizer applies a chosen base optimizer, including AdamW and Muon, to the frame variables while keeping the base spectra fixed. Across reasoning and coding tasks ranging from 1.5B to 8B parameters, ISO-Optimizer improves accuracy in the reported runs and reaches matched scores with substantially fewer training steps. On Qwen3-8B-Base, AdamW reaches an aggregate accuracy of 0.495 after 270 training steps. ISO-AdamW reaches the same accuracy after only 100 training steps and improves further to 0.509 after 210 training steps. Together, ISO offers a concrete answer to RLVR's missing optimization layer: rather than inheriting pre-training optimization wholesale, design post-training around the structure of reward-driven adaptation: inherit the spectrum, optimize the frames.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ISO（Isospectral Optimization），一种面向RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）的原生优化框架。其核心发现是RLVR训练中模型的奇异值谱可继承自基模型，而行为变化主要通过左右奇异向量帧（frames）实现。基于此，ISO包含两个互补实例：离线端ISO-Merger（无数据合并共享基模型的多个RL专家）和在线端ISO-Optimizer（在固定谱下对帧变量应用基础优化器）。实验表明ISO-Merger在数据无关合并方法中达到最优，ISO-Optimizer在1.5B–8B规模上以更少训练步数达到匹配或更优精度。
AI.motivation: 当前RLVR进展迅速，但其将奖励反馈转化为权重更新的优化层仍多直接继承自预训练范式。作者指出预训练（密集token级监督）与RLVR（稀疏结果级奖励）在结构上存在本质差异，因此需要一个RLVR原生、基于其自身动力学结构的优化设计原则。
AI.method: 作者首先在SVD坐标下分析RLVR的权重变化，提出并验证"谱继承"（spectral inheritance）现象：RLVR检查点始终接近基模型权重的固定谱族ℱ(W₀)。通过维度感知校准κ_spec排除高维几何假象，并通过（1）训练后恢复基谱、（2）训练全程固定基谱两种功能性干预，证明基谱可功能性重用。随后通过未解释更新比率u_h证明在固定谱下，左右两个奇异帧必须同时保持可调。基于此，提出ISO：固定谱、参数化为W(U,V)=UΣ₀V⊤，离线实例ISO-Merger对共享基专家的帧位移做project–mask–merge–retract合并（Gram矩阵单位自保留目标+岭稳定+截断），在线实例ISO-Optimizer将AdamW/Muon应用于帧变量并以polar retraction恢复Stiefel可行性。
AI.result: ISO-Merger：在Qwen2.5-7B合并3个RL专家（编码/工具使用/长上下文记忆）平均63.80，超过最强无数据基线62.88；在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B合并2个专家（编码/数学）平均44.38，超过最强基线43.52；worst@4分别提升1.62与1.36点。ISO-Optimizer：Qwen3-1.7B数学聚合28.74（AdamW 28.35/Muon 27.70）；Qwen3-4B聚合43.46（AdamW 41.69/Muon 42.23），约2.2×步数减少；Qwen3-8B以100步达到AdamW 270步的0.495聚合精度，210步进一步达0.509，约2.7×步数减少；编码任务LCB v5/v6同样超越AdamW；ISO-Muon在4B上亦匹配并超越最强Muon基线。极化回缩开销约7%端到端时间。
AI.conclusion: ISO将RLVR优化从沿用预训练范式转变为围绕奖励驱动适配的结构设计：通过识别并验证谱继承作为功能性重用规律，将"继承谱、优化帧"作为原则，统一离线和在线两阶段RLVR后训练流程，无需额外数据、回滚、梯度更新或在线蒸馏即可达到当前数据无关方法中最优，并显著降低在线RLVR训练步数。

title: Provable diffusion-based posterior sampling for linear inverse problems via DDIM
summary: Diffusion-based methods have achieved remarkable empirical success in solving inverse problems. However, many existing posterior samplers either lack rigorous theoretical guarantees or incur substantial computational overhead. We propose a simple and efficient algorithm, called \pddim, for solving linear inverse problems with diffusion priors via a DDIM-type sampler. Our method requires only lightweight, coordinate-wise modifications to the standard DDIM update, while explicitly incorporating the measurement model. The key idea is to perform posterior sampling separately along each singular direction of the measurement operator: for each direction, the sampler follows the learned diffusion prior when the observation signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is below the corresponding diffusion SNR, and switches to a calibrated measurement-based predictor otherwise. We prove that the proposed sampler converges to the Bayesian posterior conditioned on the measurements. Empirical results show that the proposed sampler performs favorably against existing diffusion-based posterior samplers across a range of image restoration tasks, achieving the best performance on the majority of evaluation metrics considered. Overall, our results convert posterior sampling for noisy linear inverse problems to simple coordinate-wise DDIM updates, yielding an efficient, easy-to-implement algorithm with provable posterior consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为πDDIM的简单高效算法，用于基于扩散先验求解线性逆问题。该方法仅需对标准DDIM更新进行轻量级的逐坐标修改，通过沿测量算子的每个奇异方向分别执行后验采样：当观测信噪比低于对应扩散SNR时遵循学习到的扩散先验，否则切换到基于测量的校准预测器。算法具有收敛到贝叶斯后验的理论保证，并在多种图像复原任务上优于现有扩散后验采样方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在求解逆问题方面取得显著实证成功，但现有后验采样器要么缺乏严格的理论保证，要么计算开销巨大。本文旨在设计一种既高效又具有严格理论保证的扩散后验采样算法。
AI.method: 提出πDDIM算法，其核心思想是将后验采样沿测量算子的每个奇异方向分别进行：1）对标准DDIM更新仅做轻量级、逐坐标的修改；2）显式纳入测量模型；3）针对每个奇异方向，根据观测信噪比（SNR）与扩散SNR的比较，灵活切换扩散先验采样与基于测量模型的校准预测器。
AI.result: 1）理论上证明了所提采样器收敛到条件于测量值的贝叶斯后验；2）实证上在多种图像复原任务中优于现有扩散后验采样器，在大多数评估指标上取得最佳性能；3）将噪声线性逆问题的后验采样转化为简单的逐坐标DDIM更新。
AI.conclusion: πDDIM提供了一种高效、易于实现且具有可证明后验一致性的算法，将复杂的后验采样问题简化为简单的逐坐标DDIM更新，兼具理论保证与实证性能优势。

title: Copy Less, Ground More: Overcoming Repetitive Copying in Long-Context Reasoning via Evidence-Aware Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models that generate step-by-step reasoning traces have achieved strong performance on complex tasks, and extending them to long-context settings has emerged as an important frontier. However, we identify a critical failure mode in this regime: \emph{repetitive copying}, where models extensively copy text from the input into their reasoning traces rather than productively solving the problem. We show that this behavior is pervasive across frontier long-context LLMs and intensifies with context length. By separating each prompt into task-relevant key evidence and irrelevant distractor context, we further show that the root cause is insufficient grounding: models copy from the prompt indiscriminately, and those that fail to focus on key evidence are far more likely to answer incorrectly. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose GEAR (Grounding Evidence-Aware Reward), a reward shaping method that augments the accuracy signal with a grounding reward for overlap with key evidence and a distractor penalty for overlap with irrelevant context. To enable GEAR on natural-language data, we develop an automated pipeline that constructs evidence-annotated training data from arbitrary documents. We validate GEAR across multiple model scales and benchmarks, showing consistent improvements of up to +4.6 average points over standard RL with accuracy-based rewards, with larger gains at longer contexts, while also reducing repetitive copying and thinking length. Our findings suggest that, even as long-context evaluation shifts from simple retrieval toward complex reasoning, accurate grounding in relevant evidence remains an indispensable capability with substantial room for improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文针对长上下文推理中思维模型普遍存在的"重复复制"失败模式（即模型大量照搬输入文本而非有效推理），提出根源在于"证据定位不足"。作者提出 GEAR（Grounding Evidence-Aware Reward）奖励塑形方法，在准确性奖励基础上增加对关键证据的 n-gram 重叠奖励和对干扰内容的惩罚，并构建了自动化的证据标注数据流水线。实验在三个模型规模、五个基准上验证，GEAR 相比纯准确性奖励的 RL 平均提升达 +4.6 分，且上下文越长增益越大，同时显著降低了重复复制率和思维链长度。
AI.motivation: 随着长上下文评估从简单检索转向复杂推理，思维模型在该场景下暴露出一个关键缺陷：模型倾向于将输入内容大规模复制到推理轨迹中，而非进行有效推理。这种"重复复制"行为在七个前沿长上下文 LLM 中普遍存在，且随上下文长度增加而加剧，同时显著降低准确率并膨胀推理长度。已有研究多关注短上下文推理的 RL 优化或粗粒度的分块级奖励，缺乏对这一具体失败模式的精细诊断与针对性解决方案。
AI.method: 1. **诊断分析**：定义 n-gram overlap rate 量化复制行为，在 GSM-Infinite（8k–64k）上系统测量七个模型的复制率；通过 grounding ratio（关键证据重叠率/干扰内容重叠率）区分"选择性复制"与"无差别复制"，证实答案正确的样本具有更高的 grounding ratio。2. **GEAR 奖励设计**：R = R_acc + α·Overlap_n(y‖x_key) − β·Overlap_n(y‖x_dist)，α=0.1, β=0.3, n=3；排除同时出现在 key 和 dist 中的 n-gram 以避免误罚。3. **数据构建流水线**：针对合成数据（GSM-Infinite、PhantomWiki）利用程序生成的支持索引；针对自然语言文档采用三阶段流水线（文档分析与过滤→证据约束 QA 生成→答案独立验证），从 RedPajama-v2 构造 1,200 个 QA 对，训练集共 3,200 条。4. **训练**：基于 GSPO 算法，训练 Qwen3.5-9B/27B/35B-A3B 三个模型，约 100 步优化，上下文长度 16k–32k。
AI.result: 在五个保持独立的长上下文基准（Ruler、LongBench-v2、BrowseComp-LC、GraphWalks、AA-LCR）上，GEAR 在全部六个模型-上下文组合中均取得最高平均分。32k 上下文下平均提升 +1.5 至 +2.8 分，128k 下提升 +2.1 至 +4.6 分，且训练仅在 16k–32k 上进行，泛化到 4 倍长度仍获更大增益。消融实验表明：(1) 单独加入 grounding 奖励反而会加剧复制并伤害性能（下降最多 8.3 分）；(2) 仅使用 distractor 惩罚也低于基线；(3) α=0.1, β=0.3 为最优系数配比，β 过小会失效；(4) n=3 优于 n=10，因更密集的奖励信号。GEAR 同时将 overlap rate 从 36.9%/24.9% 降至 27.0%/22.6%，思维链长度在 Ruler 上从 2808 降至 2066 tokens。案例分析显示 GEAR 既能避免因复制耗尽 token 预算，也能减少过度犹豫导致的"Wait"循环。
AI.conclusion: 重复复制是长上下文推理中普遍且有害的失败模式，其根源在于模型无法区分关键证据与干扰内容；GEAR 通过结合 grounding 奖励与 distractor 惩罚的简洁奖励塑形，在无需外部检索器或验证器的情况下显著改善了证据定位能力和推理效率，且增益随上下文长度增加而放大，表明在长上下文复杂推理中，准确锚定相关证据仍是不可或缺的核心能力，具有充分的提升空间。

title: Predictive RTO for CoAP using Lightweight Support Vector Regression in Internet of Things
summary: Internet of Things (IoT) networks require lightweight application layer messaging, and CoAP is an option because it supports REST-style interactions over UDP on constrained devices. However, CoAP congestion control still depends on fixed heuristics, including binary exponential backoff (BEB) and RTT-based mechanisms such as CoCoA and CoCoA+, which do not adapt well to dynamic and lossy wireless links. This paper proposes prCoAP, a lightweight data-driven approach that replaces heuristic Retransmission Timeout (RTO) selection with a per-attempt linear Support Vector Regression (SVR) ensemble for direct RTO prediction from node-observable features. The model runs on-device on low-end microcontrollers and operates within strict memory and energy budgets. The framework also includes a calibrated Random Forest drop classifier that identifies likely-to-fail transactions in later retransmission attempts and terminates them early to reduce channel occupancy. We evaluate the approach using a discrete-event simulator implementing IEEE 802.15.4 and RFC 7252 and validate it against the FIT IoT-LAB testbed. Our experiments confirm that the proposed linear SVR achieves 97.25% PDR, outperforming standard CoAP under the evaluated conditions. We also evaluate a kernel SVR variant; while it improves regression fit (R2 0.84 vs. 0.63), the linear SVR provides better system-level efficiency, achieving comparable PDR with lower energy overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 prCoAP，一种面向 IoT 资源受限设备的轻量级数据驱动 CoAP 重传超时（RTO）预测框架。其核心采用按重传尝试分层的线性 SVR 集成模型（仅 5 维特征、~768 字节参数）直接预测 RTO，并辅以校准的随机森林丢弃分类器在后期尝试时提前终止注定失败的事务，以节省信道与能耗。在 IEEE 802.15.4 仿真器与 FIT IoT-LAB 真实测试床验证下，线性 SVR 达到 97.25% PDR，在突发信道下获得 37% 良好吞吐提升；核 SVR 虽回归精度更高（R²=0.84 vs 0.63），但带来 84.6% 推理能耗开销，因而不适用于资源受限节点。
AI.motivation: CoAP 协议（RRC 7252）默认依赖静态启发式机制（2–3 s 随机初始 RTO 与二进制指数退避 BEB）来管理重传超时，无法区分拥塞丢包与无线链路误码，导致在动态、丢包的 IEEE 802.15.4 IoT 环境中利用率下降及重传突发。现有改进如 CoCoA/CoCoA+、FASOR、CACC 仍基于经验式调参，对过去 RTT 被动反应且未充分利用多维本地状态；ML 方法（如 ML-CoCoA）多仅调启发式参数，iCoCoA 等又计算代价过高，难以部署在低端 MCU 上。因此需要一个轻量、节点侧、可直接从可观测特征预测绝对 RTO 的数据驱动方案。
AI.method: prCoAP 在标准 CoAP CON/ACK 循环内嵌入了：（1）按尝试分层的线性 SVR 集成——对 7 个尝试档位（a=0..6）各自训练一个以 5 维特征向量 x=[SRTT, RTTVAR, a, IAT, SR]^T 为输入的 ε-不敏感 SVR；目标经 log(1+y) 变换以缓解右偏分布，推理为单次点积 O(d)，参数仅约 768 字节；（2）校准的随机森林丢弃分类器（100 棵树、最大深度 8、等权类平衡 + isotonic 校准），仅在 a≥3 触发，基于观测成功率 SR 自适应阈值 τ(SR) 提前终止高概率超时事务，并保留 0.01 残余误丢弃概率以注入部署不确定性。RTT 估计器沿用 α=0.125、β=0.25 指数更新，SR 基于 W=10 窗口并对空闲期以 0.90/2s 衰减。训练数据来自 300 场景参数扫描的离散事件仿真器，80/20 分层（按尝试与信道）划分，3 折网格搜索 {C∈0.01,0.1,1,10; ε∈0.01,0.05,0.1,0.2} 在 log 空间优化 R²。
AI.result: 仿真与 FIT IoT-LAB 硬件验证表明：（1）线性 SVR 在测试条件下达到 97.25% PDR，优于标准 CoAP；（2）突发信道下良好吞吐提升 37%；（3）按尝试分解的线性 SVR 在 attempt 0–4 验证 R² 介于 0.6384–0.7766，attempt 5+ 降至 0.2856（数据稀薄），整体 R²=0.6303，输出 RTO 从 attempt 0 的 610 ms 单调升至 attempt 3 的 4048 ms，与 BEB 上限对齐；（4）核 SVR 测试 R²=0.8429（MAE 80.97 ms），精度更优但带来 84.6% 能耗开销；（5）RF 丢弃分类器 ROC-AUC=0.7186，在选定阈值下达 0.957 精确度；（6）代价感知评估证实线性方案在 PDR、良好吞吐、能耗与延迟之间提供更优系统级权衡，尽管绝对延迟略高于启发式基线，但能更好应对突发劣化。
AI.conclusion: prCoAP 证明：基于按尝试分层的线性 SVR 集成与 RF 早期丢弃策略，可在 768 字节参数预算内为受限 IoT 节点提供可行的 on-device 数据驱动 RTO 预测，其线性设定在系统级效率上优于核 SVR。主要局限在于训练与评估高度依赖仿真数据，真实世界链路动态与硬件时序影响尚未充分覆盖。未来工作包括扩展丢弃分类器以覆盖更广拥塞条件、规模化物理硬件评估，以及引入 XGBoost 与 TinyML 量化以进一步权衡精度与效率。

title: What Governs Decode Throughput in Absolute-Offset GPU LZ77? A Work-Granularity Mechanism and an Encode-Time Min-Match-Length Lever
comment: 4 pages, 4 tables. Fourth paper in the ACEAPEX series (see arXiv:2606.04268 , 2606.18900 , 2606.24531 )
summary: The ACEAPEX line of work established a lossless LZ77 format whose back-references are absolute output positions, giving parallel, compressed-resident GPU decode with sub-millisecond region seek. What it did not establish is what governs the decode throughput of such a format, or how to improve it. This paper answers both. Through controlled ablations on an NVIDIA H100 we show that decode throughput is governed not by occupancy, compute, address scatter, or launch parallelism, but by work granularity: throughput is a function of the average match length, because a short match leaves most lanes of a cooperating warp idle. A synthetic copy kernel confirms a 3.5x throughput span (212 to 744 GB/s) as average match length grows from 32 to 1024 bytes. Real data sit at the low end (mean match length 6.5 on enwik9, 10.1 on FASTQ). We then show that this mechanism yields a practical, encode-side lever: raising the minimum match length by distance class (6/8/10/12 to 12/16/24/32) improves both compression ratio and decode throughput simultaneously on all eight tested datasets, with no exceptions and no change to the decode kernel. FASTQ decode rises from 142.6 to 178.6 GB/s while ratio improves 1.8%; enwik9 throughput rises 78%. This is not a trade-off: both gains follow from one cause, removing short matches whose far offsets cost more entropy than they save. All figures are bit-perfect (FNV on GPU paths, byte compare on CPU paths) and git-verifiable. Scope is explicit: figures are match-phase, device-resident; entropy and host transfer are outside the timer; seek is read/block-level, not coordinate-level; and we do not claim to exceed the hardware bandwidth ceiling.

AI.tldr: 本文针对ACEAPEX绝对偏移LZ77格式在NVIDIA H100上的GPU解码吞吐瓶颈进行研究，通过控制变量消融实验揭示：解码吞吐量并非由占用率、计算开销、地址分散度或启动并行度决定，而是由"工作粒度"（即平均匹配长度）主导。基于此发现，提出编码端的最小匹配长度调节杠杆（按距离分级从6/8/10/12提升至12/16/24/32），在全部8个测试数据集上同时提升压缩比与解码吞吐，无需修改解码内核。
AI.motivation: ACEAPEX系列工作（前3篇）已建立了具备压缩驻留、绝对偏移并行解码与亚毫秒级区域寻址能力的LZ77格式，但遗留两个未解问题：(1) 究竟什么因素支配该格式的解码吞吐量；(2) 如何对其进行优化。现有相关工作（如CODAG）虽研究并行度但未分析粒度对吞吐的支配机制，也未将熵与匹配粒度解耦；固定功能解压方案则不具备绝对偏移与可寻址性。本文旨在填补这一机制层面的空白，并提供一个工程上易用的优化手段。
AI.method: 方法分为两阶段：(1) 机制识别——在NVIDIA H100上通过联合扫描分块大小与合作宽度G∈{8,16,32}形成12点网格，以"有效工作负载"lanes = G × N_blocks为关键变量；通过四组对照消融依次排除计算/解析、占用率（使用launch_bounds(128,16)强制占用，39→32寄存器，maxblk 12→16却因寄存器溢出导致吞吐下降9%–14%）、地址分散度（有序vs分散源地址无差异）、启动并行度（双流仅约0.7×单流）作为支配因素；最后用1 GB合成copy kernel直接绘制吞吐-平均匹配长度曲线。(2) 编码端杠杆——按四个距离带（d<128、d<16384、d<2097152、d≥2097152）将最小匹配长度从6/8/10/12提升到12/16/24/32，ACEAPEX_BS=16384、G=32，端到端重编重解，在FASTQ 1GB、enwik9 256MB及12个Silesia文件中选取8个数据集对比基线与调优配置，所有数据点用FNV（GPU路径）/字节比较（CPU路径）验证比特精确性。
AI.result: 机制层面：合成copy kernel证实平均匹配长度从32增至1024字节时吞吐跨越3.5×（212→744 GB/s）；有效负载低于约32K lanes时设备饥饿，高于约1M lanes时饱和，三个不同(G,bs)配置在131K lanes下吞吐差距仅8%。杠杆层面：在全部8个数据集上同时实现压缩比与解码吞吐提升，无一例外。代表性数据：FASTQ 1GB解码由142.6→178.6 GB/s（+25.2%）、压缩比3.90→3.97（+1.8%）；enwik9 256MB解码由91.6→163.5 GB/s（+78%）、压缩比2.64→2.77（+4.9%）；samba吞吐+51%、xml吞吐+20%、dickens吞吐+45%。其根因统一：短匹配指向远距近随机偏移时，编码偏移消耗的熵超过替换字面量所节省的熵——消除这类匹配既降偏移熵又升平均匹配长度，一因两果，非权衡关系。继续推进至16/24/32/48虽提升吞吐但FASTQ全量压缩比由3.97降至3.93，故12/16/24/32为所测数据上的普适最优。
AI.conclusion: 绝对偏移GPU LZ77格式的解码吞吐由工作粒度（平均匹配长度）支配；基于此机制，在编码端按距离分级提高最小匹配长度即可同步改善压缩比与解码吞吐，且无需改动解码内核。本文明确划定作用域——计时仅覆盖匹配阶段、驻留设备端，熵编解码与主存传输在计时之外；寻址为读/块级而非坐标级；不声称突破硬件带宽上限（enwik9约217 GB/s为实测带宽平台）。代码与配置完全可复现（commit 640a7e5、701c624、fb27234，Zenodo存档），下一步工作是将该机制推广至完整设备驻留流水线并与生产级解码器做头对头评测。

title: Searching for Plans You Can Actually Build: A Realizability-Aware Full-Space Optimizer for MoE Training and Serving
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) systems split a program's plan space in two: the space a cost model can rank, and the smaller space a real toolchain can actually build. Automatic optimizers rank the first and silently assume the two coincide -- so they can return a plan that is optimal on paper and impossible to emit. We present moefs, a realizability-aware full-space optimizer for MoE training and serving that makes deployment realizability a first-class search constraint. moefs closes a three-tier search over parallelism, schedule, and kernels; it emits both a Megatron training stack and an SGLang serving stack from a single plan; and it prices, rather than forbids, the realization overheads it measures. We evaluate across two hardware generations. On 2x RTX4090, the searched training plan edges the strongest hand-tuned baseline by +0.9% (and clears the 0.98x acceptance bar by +2.9%); on 8x H800, the searched serving plan matches the hand-tuned configuration at a 1.0304 throughput ratio. We hold failures to the same standard: on 8x H800 training, the searched plan is a computable, honest FAIL at 0.9338 of the best hand-tuned throughput, losing on a single schedule flag. All predictions are pre-registered in a frozen, artifact-hashed adjudication file before the H800 runs, and every outcome is reported as-is.

AI.tldr: 提出 moefs：一个面向 MoE 训练与推理的可实现性感知全空间优化器，通过将发射器（emitter）本身作为干运行预言机，把"可构建性"作为搜索的一阶约束，从而闭合并行策略、通信调度与生成内核三轴搜索，并统一输出 Megatron 训练栈与 SGLang 推理栈。
AI.motivation: 当前 MoE 自动优化器在成本模型可排序的方案空间与真实工具链可构建的方案空间之间存在系统性鸿沟——经良好校准的成本模型所排出的第一名方案（如 DualPipe 训练计划）可能是不可发射的，从而在工具链层产生 NotImplementedError。该差距不是准确度问题，而是范畴错误：可实现性必须是搜索中的一阶约束，而非后置过滤器。
AI.method: 核心方法围绕四个设计原则：(P1) 发射器干运行作为可实现性谓词的单一事实来源——复用生产发射器而非并行规则库；(P2) 对实现开销进行"定价而非禁止"——将生成内核的补丁开销与 offload/overlap 竞争惩罚作为乘法因子纳入成本模型，保留负税表达；(P3) 启动探测（launch probe）作为必要不充分的后备——内存门可能过批准计划，需实测兜底；(P4) 域范围校准——每个校准常数附带适用域（GPU、token-per-expert 范围、dtype），域外查询标记为外推。系统由归一化 Plan IR、双保真成本模型（解析+模拟时间线）、三级搜索（并行度→调度→内核）、双栈发射器（Megatron+SGLang）和 Triton 内核生成器组成，谓词在并行度层剪枝并在调度细化中作一致性守卫。
AI.result: 在两代硬件上评估：本地 2×RTX4090 训练胜出最强手工基线 +0.9%（通过 0.98× 验收线 +2.9%），本地推理通过（0.9890）；8×H800 推理匹配手工配置（比例 1.0304，argv 相同）；8×H800 训练为可计算的诚实 FAIL（0.9338），仅因一个 overlap 调度标志落败。H800 训练前 5 名方案在良好校准下 0/6 可构建——证明差距是可实现性问题而非准确度问题。将可实现性纳入搜索（而非事后过滤）相比朴素回退获 +10.8% 预测吞吐。预注册的 10 次修订均为仅追加修订，预测在测量前哈希冻结，诚实负向结果（含 22 项索引条目）原样报告。
AI.conclusion: MoE 全空间优化器应将构建性纳入目标函数，而非作为后置过滤器。可实现性预言机（复用发射器干运行）+ 内存门 + 启动探测 + 实现税定价四层组合闭合了排序空间与构建空间之间的鸿沟；预注册、artifact 哈希、仅追加修订的裁决流程使诚实的负向结果可审计而非可否认。在所有现有自动并行与 MoE 系统中，部署可实现性维度均未被独立处理，moefs 沿五个轴（策略搜索、通信重叠、内核生成、训练+推理统一、可实现性）均给出完整覆盖，是首个同时闭合策略搜索与 GPU 内核生成两端的系统。

title: Unstructured Hydrodynamics on Spatial Dataflow Architectures: A Joint Code and Data Decomposition Approach
summary: Spatial Dataflow Architectures are an emerging hardware pattern in high-performance computing, whose mesh-connected fixed-memory processing elements are tailored for structured grid kernels with two-dimensional neighborhoods. However, practical multiphysics codes are often computed on unstructured grids, which induce indirect memory accesses and high-dimensional communication patterns, making them infeasible to directly map onto said architectures. This work takes a principled, model-centric approach to partitioning unstructured problems onto spatial dataflow architectures. Through communication and memory modeling, we propose a joint decomposition that considers both the size of the application's fields and its subroutines. In particular, we automate the analysis process of the original code, define a high-dimensional decomposition that minimizes communication via space-filling curves, and apply memory optimization techniques, crucial in this memory-limited environment. We demonstrate mapping the Livermore Unstructured Lagrangian Explicit Shock Hydrodynamics (LULESH) application to the Cerebras Wafer-Scale Engine, showing that larger, unstructured grid codes can still outperform GPUs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模型驱动的方法，将非结构化网格科学应用（以LULESH冲击流体动力学程序为代表）映射到Cerebras晶圆级引擎（WSE）这类空间数据流架构上。通过联合考虑代码与数据的分解、基于空间填充曲线的通信优化以及自动代码生成，在32位精度下，相较于NVIDIA A100 GPU实现了最高4.8倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 空间数据流架构（如Cerebras WSE）虽然具备大规模并行能力，但其处理单元（PE）的内存有限（48KB），且通信成本高度依赖物理距离。现有工作多局限于结构化网格或特定内核的手工汇编移植，缺乏一套系统化、可推广的方法将大型非结构化网格科学应用映射到此类架构上。LULESH作为非结构化六面体网格的拉格朗日流体力学代理程序，存在间接内存访问和高维通信模式，难以直接映射到以2D网格邻域为核心的空间数据流架构上。
AI.method: 1. **本地计算与内存模型**：基于Stateful Dataflow Multigraph (SDFG)中间表示，为每个tasklet推导性能T(t)和指令数I(t)，区分是否支持DSD SIMD操作，自动化估算整个SDFG的计算开销与代码大小。2. **代码感知内存模型**：比较三种代码溢出处理策略——代码交换（Code Swapping）、控制系统（Control System）、子程序PE（Subprogram PEs），通过解析模型评估各自的周期开销，为不同代码大小和本地域尺寸选择最优策略。3. **通信模型**：基于Spatial Computer模型，使用蛇形空间填充曲线对Z维瓦片进行3D分解，将逻辑邻居映射为物理邻居，分别推导XY（片内）和Z（跨片）方向的allreduce、面交换的依赖距离L、聚合距离E、链路竞争C和深度D。4. **联合优化**：结合T_Seq、T_Comm、T_Map三个分量，在48KB内存约束下枚举(e_x, e_y, e_z, k_p)组合求解约束优化问题。5. **自动代码生成**：扩展DaCe的SDFG IR，通过水平Map合并、数组合并、Tasklet堆叠三种变换将多个独立map融合为单一DSD操作，并定义DSDReuse pass复用DSD声明。6. **通信库**：为LULESH的面邻居交换实现可复用的库，采用控制wavelet+过滤器机制管理跨片通信，避免相同颜色的wavelet冲突。
AI.result: 将LULESH完整应用映射到Cerebras CS-2上，编译使用CSL Compiler v1.4.0，与运行CUDA 13.1的NVIDIA A100 40GB GPU对比。结果显示：(1)通信库XY元素交换在小域时存在常数设置开销，但随问题规模增大模型预测与实测偏差保持稳定；(2)Lagrange Nodal和Lagrange Element内核的实测运行时间均不超过模型预测值的2倍；(3)端到端性能在多种域规模下相较A100实现最高4.8倍加速，且实测WSE运行时间与模型预测偏差稳定在50.5%~50.9%以内，验证了模型指导分解决策的有效性。模型在指导分解决策时具有恒定的运行时开销。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过解析建模与自动化代码生成的结合，建立了一套将完整科学应用系统化映射到Cerebras WSE等空间数据流架构的方法论。尽管WSE存在内存高度受限和长距离通信的挑战，基于SDFG的建模框架和代码生成器能够指导域分解与代码布局的系统化决策，在32位精度下实现超越同代GPU的加速比。通过将映射过程形式化、自动化大部分实现工作并提供可复用的通信库，本工作为将更多完整科学应用移植到空间数据流架构奠定了实践基础。论文也指出，若能进一步降低指令内存占用以消除子程序PE开销，可获得更大加速。

title: Mapping Without Graphs: Learning Coherence Traffic for Task Placement
summary: Cache coherence is essential for communication in many-core Network-on-Chip (NoC)-based systems. As application scale and complexity increase, efficiently managing communication becomes increasingly challenging, making task mapping a key optimization technique. However, existing task mapping approaches suffer from two major limitations. First, they rely on predefined task graphs whose dependencies are typically derived from program structure or runtime information, such as dataflow, synchronization, traces, or profiling, without explicitly capturing coherence-induced interactions arising from shared data accesses. Consequently, these graphs provide only a partial representation of inter-task relationships, limiting mapping effectiveness. Second, they generally overlook cache coherence, even though coherence traffic constitutes a significant portion of NoC communication. This mismatch between modeled communication behavior and actual runtime interactions often leads to suboptimal mappings and degraded system performance. To address these limitations, we propose CoTM, a coherence-aware task mapping framework that constructs task graphs by inferring inter-task dependencies from dynamic coherence behavior. CoTM employs a lightweight heuristic with a multi-start optimization strategy to iteratively refine task placement, guided by a coherence-aware penalty function that jointly considers coherence traffic and NoC performance metrics. Experimental results demonstrate that CoTM reduces average link utilization by up to 47.85% and total energy consumption by up to 10.30% compared with existing approaches. These results highlight the importance of incorporating cache coherence into task mapping and demonstrate the potential of coherence-aware optimization for future many-core NoC systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoTM框架，一种面向片上网络（NoC）多核系统的**一致性感知任务映射**方法，通过从运行时一致性行为中动态推断任务间依赖关系来构建任务图，并采用轻量级启发式与多起点优化策略迭代优化任务放置。实验表明，CoTM相比现有方法可降低平均链路利用率最高达47.85%、总能耗最高达10.30%。
AI.motivation: 现有任务映射方法存在两大局限：（1）依赖预定义任务图，其依赖关系通常来源于程序结构或运行时信息（数据流、同步、追踪或剖析），但未显式捕获由共享数据访问引发的一致性交互，导致任务间关系表示不完整；（2）普遍忽视缓存一致性，即使一致性流量占NoC通信的很大比例。建模通信行为与实际运行时交互之间的不匹配导致次优映射和性能下降。
AI.method: CoTM框架包含两大核心模块：(1) **一致性感知依赖图构建**：基于每核运行时指标（一致性时间、L1间消息数、私有缓存命中率、忙碌时间、执行时间），通过活动建模（activity level，基于特征向量幅值的平均值）和交互建模（interaction level，基于余弦相似度）计算任务间依赖分数D(t_i,t_j)=α·A+β·I，设置强/弱一致性阈值T_strong=0.65和T_weak=0.25分类依赖等级；(2) **一致性感知任务映射**：基于依赖图按强依赖邻居数量定义任务优先级，采用贪心策略将强耦合任务迁移到相邻核，通过复合惩罚函数P=Σ(γ_cm+h_cm)·T_cm（联合一致性时间与平均跳数）评估映射质量，并引入多起点优化策略在每次迭代中生成多个候选映射以增强鲁棒性。映射复杂度为O(S·(E+N log N+P))。
AI.result: 使用Gem5模拟器和PARSEC 2.1基准测试套件（Vips、Canneal、Fluidanimate、Blackscholes）在8×8 mesh 64核系统上评估，对比Tabu-based（MARCO）、Communication-aware和HyDra方法：平均链路利用率分别降低47.85%、39.16%和47.55%；平均数据包延迟降低13.76%、15.33%和13.47%；一致性时间降低5.63%、7.70%和10.06%；总执行时间降低5.15%、8.91%和7.06%；总能耗降低7.06%、10.30%和8.66%。在4×4和12×12 mesh系统上验证了可扩展性（偏差<0.1%），且对不同任务粒度具有鲁棒性（性能波动<2%）。依赖图构建相比TP-PARSEC减少15.74%执行时间。
AI.conclusion: 一致性行为是多核系统应用执行的关键决定因素。CoTM通过从运行时一致性行为构建依赖图并迭代优化任务放置，有效解决了现有方法中任务图不完整和忽视一致性效应的问题，显著提升了NoC链路利用率和能效，验证了将一致性纳入任务映射设计的重要性，并展示了与先进NoC架构集成的潜力。

title: A User-oriented Portable, Reproducible, and Scalable Software Ecosystem
summary: It is normal for scientists to perform their research on a diverse set of hardware, ranging from laptops and workstations to supercomputers and cloud resources. The standard scenario requires a mix of these resources. In this paper we describe a software ecosystem that enables users to rely on the same development environment for running their workflows across the different computational resources. We describe a modular, unified command-line interface that allows for the interaction with a user-workflow across diverse hardware platform. The software ecosystem has been successfully tested as part of the plan4res EU H2020 project. It can be extended to other projects with similar requirements, so that they can benefit from the same approach for executing computational workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个统一的软件生态系统，允许科学家在不同的计算资源（从笔记本电脑到超级计算机和云资源）上使用相同的开发环境运行工作流。该系统通过模块化的统一命令行接口实现跨硬件平台的工作流交互，并在plan4res欧盟H2020项目中成功测试。
AI.motivation: 科学家通常需要在多样化的硬件平台上开展研究工作，从笔记本、工作站到超级计算机和云资源等。典型的研究场景需要混合使用这些计算资源。然而，不同硬件平台之间的开发环境差异给科学家的工作流执行带来了挑战，亟需一个统一的解决方案以简化跨平台工作流的部署与执行。
AI.method: 作者设计并实现了一个模块化的软件生态系统，其核心是一个统一的命令行接口（CLI）。该方法的关键要素包括：(1) 模块化设计，便于扩展和定制；(2) 统一接口层，抽象底层硬件差异；(3) 用户工作流可在不同计算资源间无缝迁移；(4) 在plan4res欧盟H2020项目实际应用环境中进行验证测试。
AI.result: 该软件生态系统作为plan4res欧盟H2020项目的组成部分，已成功通过测试验证。具体成果包括：用户能够依赖同一开发环境在不同计算资源上执行工作流；模块化架构支持灵活扩展；统一的命令行接口实现了对跨平台工作流的便捷交互。
AI.conclusion: 该软件生态系统为跨异构计算资源执行科学计算工作流提供了可行的统一解决方案。其模块化特性使其可被具有类似需求的其他项目复用和扩展，从而推动科学研究中计算工作流管理方法的一致性和标准化。

title: InstantInfer: Enabling Fast LLM Cold Start with Communicating Finite Automata
summary: Cold starts in large language model (LLM) inference services significantly affect user experience, yet they remain inefficient due to sequential initialization and a massive number of fine-grained I/O requests issued by complex software components. Although refactoring the program can yield advantages such as concurrent execution and I/O merging, this approach is error-prone and carries correctness risks when dealing with massive, heterogeneous components. We propose the Communicating Finite Automata (CFA) abstraction to systematically analyze cross-component optimization opportunities, and design a programming framework to enable CFA-based component program refactoring. This framework preserves the original sequential program structure while enabling safe concurrent component execution. We prove the correctness of the program refactoring. We apply the CFA abstraction and framework to refactor process tree creation, tensor loading, and model switching in vLLM, forming a new cold-start system named InstantInfer. Extensive experiments demonstrate that InstantInfer substantially accelerates LLM cold starts (achieving up to 7.2 times speedup) and exhibits robustness across diverse GPUs, workloads, and scales.

AI.tldr: InstantInfer 是一种针对大语言模型（LLM）推理服务的冷启动加速系统。它提出了一种称为"通信有限自动机"（Communicating Finite Automata, CFA）的抽象，将冷启动过程中的异构组件建模为单调状态转换与显式状态依赖关系，从而系统化地揭示跨组件优化机会。基于该抽象，作者设计了一个编程框架，将 vLLM 中的进程树创建、张量加载和模型切换三个关键过程重构为可安全并发执行的形式，最多实现 7.2 倍的冷启动加速。
