We start with the bare-bones essentials, namely just a training objective and a model. We purposefully make both simple. For the training objective, we choose Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE), and eschew more complicated alternatives such as variational inference, adversarial training and numerical integration. For the model, we eschew transformers and instead choose a moderately sized convolutional network. Then we judiciously added elements that are truly essential, which surprisingly do not include iterative denoising. The result is a single-step parameter-efficient generative model that produces high quality samples at fast speed: it achieves an FID of 2.56 on ImageNet 256 and simultaneously attains good precision and recall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种极简主义的生成模型设计思路，挑战了"通过多次小变换逐步从噪声分布变换到数据分布"这一普遍信念。研究表明，仅使用隐式最大似然估计（IMLE）作为训练目标，加上一个中等规模的卷积网络，就能构建出高性能的单步生成模型，无需迭代去噪过程。
AI.motivation: 当前生成模型领域普遍认为"渐进式去噪"（即通过多次小变换将噪声分布逐步转化为数据分布）是获得强性能的关键。本文质疑这一信念的必要性，探讨能否用最简化的方法设计出具有竞争力的生成模型。
AI.method: 本文采用极简主义设计方法：(1) 训练目标选择隐式最大似然估计（IMLE），避免使用变分推断、对抗训练和数值积分等复杂方法；(2) 模型架构选择中等规模的卷积网络，而非目前流行的Transformer；(3) 审慎地添加真正必要的元素，但出人意料的是迭代去噪并不在其中。最终实现了一个单步、参数高效的生成模型。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256数据集上，该方法取得了FID 2.56的优异成绩，同时在精度（precision）和召回率（recall）上均表现良好，证明了单步生成模型能够产生高质量样本并具备快速采样速度。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，迭代去噪并非实现高性能生成模型的必要条件。通过简化的训练目标（IMLE）和适度的卷积网络架构，可以构建出具有竞争力的单步生成模型，这一发现挑战了当前生成模型设计中"渐进式变换"的普遍范式。

title: A Classifier That Teaches Itself: Self-Improving, Frozen-gate Training (SIFT) for Dynamic Document Classification
summary: Document classification is a solved problem in the laboratory and an unsolved one in the enterprise. The blocker is rarely model architecture; it is the labeling project that must precede a model and the institutional fear of letting a model retrain itself once one exists. We present SIFT (Self-Improving, Frozen-gate Training), a dynamic classifier service, which attacks both. SIFT serves classification from a deliberately cheap, CPU-bound pipeline, a SPLADE sparse encoder feeding a LightGBM head, and escalates only the low-confidence minority of pages to an LLM judge. The judge's verdicts are written back into a labeled corpus, so the expensive model continuously teaches the cheap one: the escalation rate falls, the corpus grows from production traffic rather than from an up-front annotation effort, and accuracy compounds with use. Onboarding a new document family requires only a declarative bundle, label space, anchor phrases, and a judge glossary, not a labeling project. The harder problem is safety: an autonomously retraining classifier can silently regress. SIFT resolves this with a two-part promote gate, a critical-label F1 regression check plus a frozen golden regression set the model is never trained on, either of which vetoes promotion. This turns "retrain monthly without a human" from reckless into routine. We describe the architecture, the self-feeding corpus loop, the frozen-gate promotion mechanism, and an illustrative multi-domain deployment, and we discuss the economics of a classifier whose marginal labeling cost trends toward zero.

AI.tldr: SIFT（Self-Improving, Frozen-gate Training）是一个动态文档分类服务，通过廉价的 SPLADE + LightGBM 流水线承担大部分推理，仅将低置信度样本升级到 LLM 法官进行裁决，并将判决回写为训练语料，使轻量模型随生产流量持续自我改进；其"冻结门控"机制通过关键标签 F1 检查与永不参与训练的黄金回归集双重把关，保证自主重训不会静默回退。
AI.motivation: 企业场景中，文档分类的瓶颈并非模型架构，而是前置的人工标注项目以及既有模型上线后组织上对模型自主重训的恐惧；论文试图同时消除这两个障碍，使"月度自动重训"成为可治理的常规流程而非冒险行为。
AI.method: 系统采用四层设计：(1) 廉价 CPU 路径——SPLADE 稀疏编码器生成稀疏向量，LightGBM 头产出概率分布；(2) 置信度驱动的升级路由，仅将低置信度少数页面交由 LLM 法官裁决；(3) 自喂养语料闭环，法官判决回流为标签，使升级率随使用而下降；(4) 双段冻结门控——关键标签 F1 回归检查 + 永不训练的黄金回归集，任一否决即阻止模型晋升。新增文档族只需声明标签空间、锚点短语和法官术语表，无需启动标注项目。
AI.result: 论文给出架构、语料自循环、晋升机制与多领域部署示例；定性结论包括：升级率随生产流量持续下降、语料来自真实流量而非前置标注、准确率随使用复利式累积，以及在关键标签 F1 与黄金回归集双重否决下，自主重训的回退风险被约束为可控事件。
AI.conclusion: SIFT 把文档分类从"实验室已解、企业未解"的命题转化为可治理的服务：经济上，分类器的边际标注成本趋近于零；治理上，冻结门控将"无人工重训"由鲁莽变为常规；新增类目仅需声明式配置而非标注项目，使企业级文档分类具备随业务演进而持续自改进的可行性。

title: Decentralized Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for Resilient Critical Infrastructures
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Autonomic Computing and Self-Organizing Systems (ACSOS 2026)
summary: Critical infrastructures are increasingly distributed, interdependent, and exposed to evolving disruptions, making resilience a central requirement for their operation and control. This paper argues that decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) should be understood not merely as a distributed alternative to centralized training with decentralized execution but as a paradigm structurally aligned with the requirements of resilient critical infrastructures. This perspective is grounded in an analysis of the properties of decentralized MARL and the requirements of critical infrastructures, including scalability to large numbers of agents, support for privacy and local autonomy, robustness to failures, and interaction-driven adaptation among interdependent components. However, structural alignment alone is insufficient for practical deployment. This paper identifies credit assignment and communication as two central conditions for its practical feasibility. Credit assignment determines whether local learning remains aligned with system-level objectives, while communication determines whether coordination can be learned and maintained under realistic operational constraints. Building on these challenges, this paper proposes a research agenda focused on structure-aware, causality-aware, and resilience-aware credit assignment; communication for both coordination and credit assignment; and safe, timely, and recoverable decentralized learning under deployment constraints. Overall, this paper reframes decentralized MARL as a promising but conditional foundation for resilient critical infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了去中心化多智能体强化学习（Decentralized MARL）作为弹性关键基础设施（critical infrastructures）管理与控制的结构适配范式，系统分析了其在可扩展性、隐私保护、故障鲁棒性和交互驱动适应等方面与基础设施需求的内在契合，并指出信用分配（credit assignment）和通信（communication）是实际部署的两大核心瓶颈，据此提出了包含结构感知/因果感知/弹性感知信用分配、双重通信机制以及安全-及时-可恢复去中心化学习三个方向的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 关键基础设施（如交通系统、智能电网、水网、工业控制系统）日益分布式化、互联化，并面临不断演化的扰动，韧性（resilience）成为其运行与控制的核心需求。现有MARL研究多采用CTDE（集中训练-分散执行）范式，其依赖全局信息聚合的训练假设与关键基础设施中通信受限、数据敏感、跨组织等现实约束不兼容。因此，需要从范式层面重新审视去中心化MARL与弹性关键基础设施之间的结构性对应关系，并识别阻碍其实际部署的关键科学与工程问题。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性分析与系统性论证方法：（1）建立去中心化MARL的一般问题模型与学习过程框架，将其学习周期分解为局部交互学习、信息交换、聚合与适应三个阶段；（2）从运行兼容性（可扩展性、隐私/局部自治）、扰动下的鲁棒性、交互驱动适应三个维度，系统论证去中心化MARL核心性质与关键基础设施需求之间的结构对应；（3）将去中心化MARL与去中心化联邦学习进行对比，明确其交互驱动学习结构在弹性场景中的独特价值；（4）以去中心化交通信号控制为贯穿性示例；（5）基于信用分配与通信两大瓶颈分析，提出三方向研究议程。
AI.result: （1）论证了去中心化MARL在结构层面与弹性关键基础设施需求高度契合：分布式学习天然支持大规模扩展、选择性信息交换兼顾隐私与局部自治、训练与执行均不依赖全局信息因而对部分故障和通信退化具有优雅降级能力、其交互驱动学习机制能捕捉组件间互适应过程（区别于去中心化联邦学习的孤立局部优化）。（2）识别出实际部署的两大核心条件——信用分配（局部学习能否对齐系统级弹性目标）和通信（带宽、延迟、可靠性约束下能否学习并维持协调），并分析其在弹性基础设施场景中的特殊重要性。（3）提出三方向研究议程：结构感知/因果感知/弹性感知的信用分配、兼顾协调与信用分配双重角色的通信设计、在部署约束下保持安全、及时、可恢复的去中心化学习及其评估基准。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化MARL不应仅被视为CTDE的分布式替代方案，而应被理解为一种与弹性关键基础设施需求结构适配的范式。该范式具有理论合理性，但其实际价值取决于是否解决信用分配与通信两大核心瓶颈。未来研究应聚焦于结构感知、因果感知与弹性感知的信用分配机制，服务于协调与信用分配双重目标的通信协议，以及在部署约束下保持安全、及时、可恢复的去中心化学习系统。总体而言，去中心化MARL是研究弹性系统级行为如何从局部学习、有限信息和去中心化协调中涌现的有前景但有条件的基础框架。

title: Scalable Policy Optimization for Networked Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Continuous State-Action Spaces
summary: We develop the Continuous Distributed Coupled Policy Gradient (CDCPG) algorithm for cooperative reinforcement learning in networked Markov decision processes with continuous state and action spaces. Each agent maintains a local actor over a bounded graph neighborhood, and a localized least-squares temporal-difference critic evaluates a truncated action-value function through a spectral random-feature representation of the local transition kernel. The analysis makes four contributions. First, the truncated action-value function is constructed as a conditional expectation over the neighborhood, yielding a well-posed localized Bellman theory that removes the continuation-kernel mismatch of naive truncation arguments. Second, we expose a dimensional obstruction to temporal-difference stability for normalized random features and prove an unconditional excitation bound that reduces stability to a symmetric persistence-of-excitation condition, monitorable through an online matrix-concentration certificate. Third, under exponential spatial decay of agent interactions, the excitation condition, and smoothness of the objective, CDCPG drives an averaged per-agent stationarity measure to within any excess $\epsilon$ of an explicitly characterized approximation floor using $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ shared-oracle samples, and the excess dependence matches the smooth nonconvex first-order rate; per-agent computation and communication are governed by the neighborhood size rather than the network size. Fourth, an adaptive-locality rule selects the radius that balances truncation and graph-decay residuals against the target accuracy. Experiments on a networked linear-quadratic benchmark corroborate the locality and feature-dimension predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CDCPG算法，用于连续状态-动作空间的网络化多智能体强化学习。该算法结合了条件期望截断的Q函数、谱随机特征近似和分布式耦合策略梯度。核心贡献包括：消除朴素截断的Bellman残差核不匹配问题；证明归一化随机特征下TD稳定性的维度障碍并给出无条件激励界；建立样本复杂度上界$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$至结构化精度下界；提供自适应局部性诊断规则。
AI.motivation: 网络化多智能体系统的核心挑战是可扩展性：联合状态-动作空间随智能体数量指数增长，中心化方法不可行；纯分散方法又往往无法协调。已有方法主要针对离散状态-动作空间，而将衰减驱动框架扩展到连续域面临截断与核逼近误差交互等新困难。此外，现有谱方法对TD矩阵条件数的维度无关性假设缺乏理论支撑。本文旨在填补这一空白，为连续域网络化MARL提供具有显式结构化精度下界的有限样本保证。
AI.method: CDCPG算法包含三个核心组件：(1) 截断Q函数定义为局部邻域上的条件期望，构造辅助局部Bellman算子，其固定点残差有显式界；(2) 谱随机特征（RFF）近似局部转移核，通过Bochner分解和张量积Hilbert空间实现，全局L1控制有显式包络和维度常数；(3) 正则化LSTD评估器结合分布式耦合策略梯度估计器。每个智能体通过$\kappa$-跳邻域内的局部参与者进行策略更新，并使用邻域$\kappa_c = \kappa + \kappa_\pi$内的critic进行信用分配。分析工具包括：Rahimi-Recht随机相位界、矩阵Bernstein不等式、Pinelis维数无关Hoeffding型不等式、可预测事件分解的停止过程下降论证。
AI.result: 主要定理结果包括：定理1给出RFF近似的$\epsilon_P$级$\mathcal{L}^1$一致界；命题2证明归一化随机特征下$\sigma_{\min}(\mathbf{M}_i^\theta) = \mathcal{O}(m^{-1/2})$，排除维度无关常数；引理3将TD稳定性简化为对称激励条件；定理4给出局部参数选择使critic误差至$\epsilon_Q + R(\kappa, m) + C'E_{\text{out}}$；定理6建立共享oracle复杂度$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$至显式四分量结构化下界$\epsilon_{\text{floor}}(\kappa, m)$；定理7给出轨迹条件版本的停止过程界。实验在LCQ基准测试上验证了局部性预测和特征维度趋势（拟合斜率$-0.46$，与$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(m^{-1/2})$一致）。每个智能体的计算复杂度为$\mathcal{O}(M_s(m D_\kappa d_S + m^2) + m^3 + M_g D_{\kappa_c} m D_\kappa d_S)$，通信由邻域大小而非网络大小控制。
AI.conclusion: 本文为连续网络化MDP的谱局部策略梯度分析提供了四个结构性贡献：(1) 条件期望Q函数截断，避免了Bellman截断的延续核不匹配问题；(2) 特征维度感知的TD稳定性假设，通过无条件激励界归约为对称激励条件，配备轨迹条件伴生定理和矩阵Bernstein诊断；(3) 在固定$(\kappa, m)$下，$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$的共享oracle复杂度达到匹配光滑非凸随机优化下界的指数阶；(4) 自适应局部性偏差平衡诊断选择半径$\kappa^*(\epsilon)$。泛在bin内项的证书级增长至少线性于$m$（在泛在包络下）是当前原始特征LSTD证书的上界伪影；$\kappa_\pi = 0$时有专门简化。本文的精度下界显式表征为截断、RFF近似的四分量结构。开放问题包括：抑制bin内惩罚的特征构造、bin内项的下界示例、验证激励界和差异衰减正则性(D3)的具体耦合连续模型类、以及向独立轨迹采样的扩展。

title: Stochastic Meta-Unlearning: Bridging Language Backbone and Multimodal Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning for vision-language models (VLMs) remains underexplored. Unlike language models, VLMs combine a language backbone with visual components, which makes unlearning more complex. There is a surprising phenomenon when moving from single-modality unlearning to VLM unlearning: a target forgotten by the standalone language backbone can still be recovered when image information is given to the full VLM. This shows that text-only feedback is not enough for reliable VLM unlearning. Motivated by this observation, we propose Stochastic Meta-Unlearning (SMU), a bilevel framework that uses VLM-level feedback to learn an unlearning-ready initialization. In the inner loop, SMU applies a few unlearning steps to the language backbone using text data. In the outer loop, SMU recomposes the updated backbone with the frozen VLM and evaluates forgetting and utility at the VLM level. This design makes the unlearning update aware of the final multimodal behavior, while still keeping the update local to the language backbone. Experiments on two VLMs, two multimodal meme datasets, and three baselines show that SMU achieves the best overall forget-retain trade-off. Compared with the strongest baseline for each metric, SMU reduces average Forget accuracy by 10.52 points and improves average Retain and Test accuracy by 20.10 and 17.01 points, respectively. More importantly, SMU also transfers to new forgetting targets and to different meta-test unlearning methods. These results suggest that VLM-level feedback can make language-backbone unlearning more reliable and more transferable for VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机元遗忘（Stochastic Meta-Unlearning, SMU），一种双层元学习框架，用于解决视觉-语言模型（VLM）的遗忘问题。其核心发现是：仅对语言骨干进行文本侧遗忘的目标，在重新组合到完整VLM后仍可通过图像信息被恢复。SMU通过在内部循环执行文本侧遗忘更新、在外部循环利用冻结的VLM组件提供多模态遗忘-保留反馈来学习一个"遗忘就绪"的初始化，从而弥合了组件级更新与系统级遗忘验证之间的错位。
AI.motivation: VLM由视觉编码器、投影模块和语言骨干组成，结构紧密耦合。当前方法存在两类缺陷：（1）直接在完整VLM上优化遗忘会损害与目标无关的多模态能力；（2）仅在语言骨干上执行遗忘虽能保持文本侧性能，但遗忘行为可能在VLM重组后被图像信息恢复。作者通过实验在Qwen和InternVL上证实了这一"文本侧遗忘但多模态可恢复"的失效现象，揭示了组件级干预与系统级遗忘验证之间的根本错位。
AI.method: SMU采用双层元优化框架：内部循环对语言骨干参数θ_T执行K步文本侧遗忘更新（使用GradDiff/NPO/RMU等算子）；外部循环将更新后的骨干与冻结的视觉组件φ重组，通过VLM前向计算多模态遗忘损失和保留损失，元梯度回传穿过内部K步更新以优化骨干的预遗忘初始化θ_T*。为提升泛化能力，SMU从环境分布p(E)中随机采样遗忘目标z、内部遗忘算子m和查询条件c，使初始化暴露于多样化的遗忘场景而非过拟合于单一目标。元测试时，仅执行语言骨干侧的K_test步文本遗忘更新即可部署。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B和InternVL3-8B上，使用Hateful Memes和COVID Memes数据集，与GradDiff、NPO、RMU三种VLM侧直接遗忘基线对比：SMU在四种模型-数据集组合下取得最优遗忘-保留权衡，平均Forget准确率最低（9.16%），Retain（75.23%）和Test（68.45%）准确率最高。相比各指标最强基线，Forget降低10.52点，Retain提升20.10点，Test提升17.01点。SMU的初始化可迁移到新的遗忘目标，且在元测试中更换内部遗忘算子（GradDiff→RMU/NPO）后仍保持有效。附录实验还表明图像侧遗忘同样不稳定。
AI.conclusion: SMU通过将语言骨干侧的遗忘更新与VLM级多模态反馈对齐，学习到一种可迁移的"遗忘就绪"初始化，解决了VLM遗忘中组件-系统错位的核心难题。实验证明其在遗忘-保留权衡、目标迁移性和算子迁移性方面均优于直接VLM侧遗忘方法。然而该方法存在局限：元训练因需展开内部循环而计算成本较高；冻结视觉组件可能限制对存储于视觉侧的目标信息的遗忘；缺乏对更强对抗性提示或多模态上下文的正式遗忘保证。

title: Translation as Augmentation: Effect of Translated Data on Assessment of Difficulty
summary: Reliable Text Difficulty Assessment is a prerequisite for valid text simplification workflows and personalized learning applications. However, the development of robust assessment models is severely hindered by a critical bottleneck: the scarcity of expert-annotated corpora containing fine-grained difficulty levels (e.g., CEFR), particularly for lower-resource languages. This paper addresses this data scarcity problem in the context of a low-resource European language. We propose a cross-lingual data augmentation strategy that leverages machine translation to transfer labeled resources from high-resource languages to the target low-resource language. We train BERT-based regression models to predict difficulty scores and investigate whether synthetic, translated data can effectively supplement native training sets. Our experiments demonstrate that augmenting scarce native data with machine-translated corpora significantly improves the accuracy of difficulty estimation, offering a viable solution for languages lacking extensive expert annotations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种跨语言数据增强策略，通过将高资源语言（俄语）的带难度标注语料经机器翻译后用于补充低资源语言（芬兰语）的训练数据，从而显著提升芬兰语文本难度评估（CEFR分级）模型的准确性。
AI.motivation: 可靠的文本难度评估是文本简化和个性化语言学习应用的基础，但低资源语言（如芬兰语）缺乏专家标注的细粒度难度语料，成为构建鲁棒难度评估模型的关键瓶颈。本文旨在解决低资源语言场景下的标注数据稀缺问题。
AI.method: 采用跨语言数据增强策略：将俄语带CEFR标注的语料库（RuFoLa和RuAdapt）通过OpusMT（Tatoeba斯拉夫语-芬兰语模型）翻译成芬兰语，与芬兰语母语语料（Easy Language、TextBook、Helsingin Sanomat、YLE、YLE Selko等）合并；使用基于BERT的回归模型（芬兰语用TurkuNLP/bert-base-finnish-cased-v1，俄语用ruBert-large）预测连续难度分数（1-6映射到CEFR等级）；设计多组实验对比纯母语、纯MT、混合训练的效果，并进行标签注入（按CEFR子集注入）和按比例采样（20%-100%MT数据）的消融实验。
AI.result: 1) 仅用母语芬兰语数据训练并在母语测试集上评估，R²达97.30%；2) 母语+MT混合训练在母语测试集上R²为96.01%，在MT测试集上R²为94.26%；3) 仅用MT数据训练效果较差（R²=66.93%在MT测试，R²=18.24%在母语测试）；4) 标签注入中B1-B2级别MT数据贡献最大（R²=96.68%），两端级别（A1-A2、C1-C2）效果有限；5) 按比例采样的最佳比例为40%MT数据（R²=96.20%），过度增强反而略有下降。总体结论：MT数据增强显著提升低资源难度评估性能，且经过适当的级别平衡效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 经过精心筛选的机器翻译数据可以作为低资源语言原生标注数据的有效替代，跨语言数据增强是解决低资源文本难度评估数据稀缺问题的可行方案；但关键前提是MT模型必须较好地保留原始文本的难度等级，许多现代LLM在翻译时会"改善"文本（简化或标准化），因此需要谨慎选择MT模型并开发系统性方法来保证难度级别的保留。未来工作将探索特征与Transformer结合的混合模型、多语言难度模型以及保证MT保持难度级别的技术。

title: Decoding EEG Signals to Explore Next-Word Predictability in the Human Brain
summary: Humans invented reading and have passed down this complex skill across generations through language. This study provides empirical evidence of the neural mechanisms underlying bottom-up (related to high-order linguistic structure) and top-down (related to next-word predictability) processes, which interact to guide comprehension during reading. While previous studies have focused on either the N400 effects of predictability or lexical categories, research on how predictability influences N400 responses across different lexical categories is limited, mainly due to constraints in publicly available datasets. Here, we examine how predictability influences brain responses, recorded at millisecond resolution using electroencephalography (EEG), with a focus on the N400 time window (300-500 ms post-stimulus) across different lexical and grammatical categories. Our results indicate that significant differences in N400 responses between high and low cloze probability levels were more pronounced for content words than function words. Among the two primary content categories, verbs exhibited greater N400 differences than nouns, while nouns carried more distinct information about their predictability than verbs. Moreover, we demonstrate that the decoding technique is more effective than the event-related potential (ERP) traditional analysis in capturing more detailed and distinct representations of cognitive processes over time.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用EEG数据,通过传统ERP分析和SVM多元解码技术,探讨阅读过程中下一词可预测性(cloze probability)对N400成分(300-500ms)在不同词汇类别(内容词vs功能词、名词vs动词)中的影响,发现内容词比功能词的N400预测效应更显著,且多元解码方法在捕获神经表征方面优于传统ERP分析。
AI.motivation: 阅读理解涉及自下而上(词汇类别)和自上而下(下一词预测)两个过程的交互。先前研究多分别考察N400的预测效应或词汇类别效应,但由于公开EEG数据集的局限,关于可预测性如何在不同词汇类别中调节N400响应的研究尚不充分。此外,研究旨在验证多元解码技术相对于传统ERP分析在捕获神经认知信息方面的优势。
AI.method: 使用DERCo数据集(22名英语母语者阅读格林童话的32通道EEG数据,排除2名被试后保留20名),通过Mechanical Turk众包获取逐词cloze值。采用两种分析:(1)传统单变量分析——基于聚类的置换检验(10,000次),使用FDR校正多重比较,识别N400时间窗内的最优电极簇;(2)SVM-RBF核解码——将单试次EEG以15个试次为一组进行平均以提高SNR,采用分层K折交叉验证,在每个时间点独立训练,每位被试迭代100次。通过Cohen's dz效应量比较两种方法的统计功效。
AI.result: 1)内容词在高/低cloze条件间N400差异显著(150-500ms),功能词无显著差异;2)单变量分析中动词N400差异较名词更显著(在p<0.1阈值下),但SVM解码显示名词携带更多关于可预测性的独特神经信息(解码准确率高出10%以上);3)在所有四个比较案例中,SVM解码的Cohen's dz效应量均大于传统ERP分析,无论使用全部32通道还是最优电极簇,均显示解码方法具有更高的统计灵敏度。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了下一词预测在阅读理解中的自上而下神经机制:内容词因携带更多语义信息而表现出更强的N400预测效应,而功能词主要承担句法结构功能。值得注意的是,虽然动词在N400振幅差异上比名词更显著,但名词在神经信号中携带更独特的可预测性信息,这一差异揭示了传统ERP与多元解码方法的不同视角。本研究强调了多元解码技术在神经认知语言研究中的优势——能够捕获传统单变量方法遗漏的细微神经差异。未来工作将扩展至P600等ERP成分及其他解码技术,以更全面理解阅读理解的神经机制。

title: Convolution for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) largely rely on Transformers, where self-attention provides global token interaction but does not explicitly encode the locality of natural language. We study whether lightweight depthwise convolutions can supply this local inductive bias without materially increasing model size. Our macro-level ablation compares convolution at 17 locations in a Qwen3 Transformer block and finds the best results when convolution is applied to the projected queries, keys, and values before attention. A subsequent micro-level study favors a residual depthwise convolution with kernel size $k=3$, without additional normalization or activation. Across Qwen3 models and several pre-training data budgets, this design improves the average accuracy on seven downstream benchmarks while adding less than $0.01\%$ parameters. A representation-level case study further suggests that the convolution makes repeated token IDs more sensitive to their immediate context. These results support depthwise convolution as a lightweight complement to self-attention for modeling short-range token interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在Transformer大语言模型中插入轻量级深度可分离卷积(Depthwise Conv1D)以补充自注意力缺失的局部归纳偏置。通过在Qwen3 Transformer块中17个候选位置的宏级消融,确定在QKV投影后、注意力前应用卷积最优;在微级设计中,采用核大小k=3的残差深度可分离卷积(无额外归一化与激活)。该方案仅增加不到0.01%参数,即可在多种模型规模和训练数据量下提升7个下游基准的平均准确率,并使重复token的表示对局部上下文更敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型(如DeepSeek、Llama)主要基于Transformer架构,其自注意力机制提供全局token交互,但并未显式编码自然语言的局部结构(如同现词、短语等短程组合)。标准的Transformer架构对这类局部模式没有显式的偏好,只能通过自注意力隐式学习。这一空白促使研究者探索一种轻量级的局部算子,以构造性地引入局部感受野来补充注意力机制。
AI.method: 研究方法分为宏级与微级两个层次:(1)宏级位置消融——在Qwen3 Transformer块中的17个候选位置插入深度可分离Conv1D,以Qwen3-1.7B为骨干,在FineWeb-100B上从头训练,通过训练损失和WikiText-103困惑度进行评估,确定最优位置为P5(QKV投影输出后、注意力前)。(2)微级模块设计——比较四种内部结构(普通卷积、带shortcut的卷积、Pre-Norm、Sandwich Norm)、核大小k∈{2,3,4}、初始化方式、激活函数(SiLU/LeakyReLU/sigmoid)以及多分支重参数化。(3)采用因果深度可分离卷积(左侧填充k−1)以保持自回归因果性,推理时维护长度为k−1的卷积缓存。(4)在Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B上,以30B/60B/100B token预算进行预训练,并在7个下游基准上进行评估。(5)通过一个WSC示例分析QKV表示的余弦相似度,以考察重复token的上下文区分度。
AI.result: (1)位置消融:P5(QKV投影后卷积)取得最低平均损失2.4818与困惑度12.85,优于所有16个其他位置及无卷积基线(2.5144/13.42)。(2)模块设计:Conv+Shortcut取得最低困惑度12.79;Sandwich Norm最差(13.33);核大小k=3最优(12.79),k=4未带来进一步提升;权重与偏置均随机初始化最优;无激活函数优于SiLU/LeakyReLU/sigmoid;多分支重参数化未带来增益。(3)下游任务:Qwen3-1.7B@30B平均准确率从52.71提升至54.70(+1.99);Qwen3-4B@30B/+60B/+100B分别提升+1.57/+1.91/+3.76。100B数据下增益最大,提示数据量增加时收益可能扩大。(4)表示分析:WSC示例显示,加入Conv1D后,重复token在不同位置处的QKV表示余弦相似度降低,表明卷积使表示对局部上下文更敏感。(5)参数开销:相比标准Conv1D约增加13.5%参数,深度可分离设计仅增加约0.006%参数(不到0.01%)。
AI.conclusion: 深度可分离Conv1D可作为Transformer自注意力机制的轻量级局部归纳偏置补充。在17个插入位置中,QKV投影后、注意力前的位置最优;最佳模块设计为核大小k=3的残差深度可分离卷积,无需额外归一化或激活函数。在Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B不同训练数据量下,该方案均能以极小的参数开销(小于0.01%)提升下游任务平均准确率,并使token表示更好地反映局部上下文。然而,该结论基于Qwen3配置得出,尚需更多模型家族与训练设置的验证以确认其泛化性。

title: Building a European Multilingual Evaluation Dataset: The MMLU Localisation Project within the EMT Network
summary: This paper reports on a collaboration between the Directorate-General for Translation (DGT) and the European Master's in Translation (EMT) to localise the MMLU dataset into 11 European languages. Beyond creating a more inclusive benchmark for LLM evaluation, the project offers master's students authentic, project-based professional training in translation, revision, project management, and multilingual coordination, while highlighting key methodological, administrative, and workflow challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了欧盟翻译总司（DGT）与欧洲翻译硕士（EMT）合作，将MMLU数据集本地化为11种欧洲语言的项目，旨在创建更具包容性的大语言模型评估基准，同时为翻译硕士生提供真实的项目化专业培训。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）评估基准（如MMLU）主要以英语为主，缺乏对欧洲多种语言的覆盖，无法公平评估LLM在多语言环境下的表现。此外，翻译硕士教育需要与真实行业实践对接的实训机会。
AI.method: 通过DGT与EMT的合作框架，组织翻译硕士学生参与MMLU数据集的本地化翻译工作，涵盖翻译、审校、项目管理和多语言协调等环节，对11种欧洲语言进行专业翻译。
AI.result: 产出了一个覆盖11种欧洲语言的MMLU本地化版本，为LLM多语言评估提供了更具包容性的基准；同时学生在翻译、修订、项目管理、多语言协调等方面获得了真实的项目化专业训练。
AI.conclusion: 该合作模式成功地将学术教育与专业翻译实践相结合，既推进了多语言NLP评估资源的建设，又为翻译人才培养提供了创新路径；论文还指出了该过程中在方法论、行政管理和工作流程方面面临的关键挑战。

title: Computational models of pragmatic reasoning with flexible generation of meaning and expression alternatives
comment: 27 pages main text, 9 figures; 25 pages supplementary materials
summary: Pragmatic language use requires reasoning about alternatives: the alternative expressions a speaker might have chosen, or the alternative interpretations a listener might entertain. Formal and computational models of pragmatics must therefore specify the sets of alternatives that interlocutors reason over, which is often done through manual specification. Here we propose a framework, ScAffolded Generative models for Explanation (SAGE), that combines the explanatory transparency of cognitive models with the generative flexibility of language models (LMs). SAGE decomposes a pragmatic process into three kinds of modules: proposers, which use LMs to generate an open-ended space of candidate alternatives; evaluators, which assess those alternatives (e.g., their semantics, complexity, or typicality); and selectors, which implement the rule-based computational steps of a cognitively motivated task analysis. We assess SAGE in three case studies spanning pragmatic generation and interpretation-referential expression generation, manner (M-)implicatures, and Gricean conversational implicatures. SAGE models are evaluated critically using established methods from computational cognitive modeling, including ablations, baseline comparisons, and quantitative fit to human data. Across studies, SAGE models achieved high accuracy and often outperformed baselines, but component-level analyses reveal an asymmetry: LM proposers reliably generated alternatives well-suited to pragmatic modeling, whereas LM evaluators are better at providing intuitive judgements rather than judgements of theoretical or formal measures. We discuss the promise and the limitations of neuro-symbolic models as candidate explanatory accounts of human pragmatic language use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SAGE（ScAffolded Generative models for Explanation）框架，将认知模型的可解释性与语言模型（LMs）的生成灵活性相结合，用于建模语用推理。该框架通过三类模块（proposers 提议候选替代项、evaluators 评估替代项、selectors 执行规则化计算步骤）来灵活处理开放式语用推理所需的替代空间。通过三个案例研究（指称表达生成、M-蕴涵、Gricean 会话蕴涵）的系统评估，发现 SAGE 模型整体准确率高且常优于基线，但模块层面呈现不对称性：LM proposer 表现稳健，而 LM evaluator 更擅长直观判断而非理论性判断。
AI.motivation: 语用语言使用需要推理关于"替代项"的内容（如说话人可能选择的替代表达、听话人考虑的替代解释），但现有形式化和计算模型通常需要手动指定这些替代集合，这限制了模型在开放式语境中的可扩展性和泛化能力。需要一种既能保持认知模型透明度又能处理开放性语言的方法。
AI.method: 提出 SAGE 神经-符号混合框架，将语用过程分解为三类模块：(1) **Proposers**：用语言模型生成开放性的候选替代项（表达或解释）；(2) **Evaluators**：用语言模型评估替代项的语义、复杂性或典型性等；(3) **Selectors**：基于认知动机任务分析实现规则化计算步骤。三个案例研究：(1) 基于 Incremental Algorithm 的指称表达迭代生成（参考博弈任务）；(2) 基于双向最优理论的标记性阻塞模型解释 M-蕴涵；(3) 基于 Gricean 准则的假设评估（AE）模型解释会话蕴涵。使用消融实验、基线比较、与人类数据定量拟合等计算认知建模方法进行评估。使用 GPT-3.5-turbo、GPT-4o、Llama-3.1-8b-Instruct 作为后端 LM。
AI.result: 三个案例研究均显示 SAGE 模型达到高准确率并常优于单遍（SP）LM 基线。案例研究 1：迭代模型在多干扰物条件下产生高对比度的指称表达；案例研究 2：标记性阻塞模型对 M-蕴涵解释准确率约 80%，而基线几乎总是偏向字面解释；案例研究 3：Gricean AE 模型在准确率和人类数据拟合上均优于基线（β=0.76 [0.68, 0.85]）。然而组件层面分析揭示关键不对称：**LM proposer**（包括表达提议和解释提议）经人类评估表现稳健，能生成与人类编写的替代项质量相当的内容；而 **LM evaluator** 在涉及字面语义、复杂度比较、Gricean 准则违反等理论性判断上表现较差且对 prompt 敏感，但在直观典型性判断上准确率高（0.925）。无假设的 AE 消融模型也显著优于 SP 基线，表明改进可能主要来自 InterpretationProposer 而非 AssumptionEvaluator。
AI.conclusion: SAGE 框架作为神经-符号认知建模方法具有前景，能将传统上仅停留在口头/理论层面的语用理论（如 Gricean 推理）转化为可与人类数据定量比较的计算模型。该框架的关键贡献是使替代项的开放式生成成为可能。研究指出了明确的改进方向：(1) LM proposer 表现已较为成熟，可复用；(2) LM evaluator 需更稳健的方法（如使用条件对数概率而非 prompt 询问）；(3) 应为常见子任务开发专门的、可复用的小型 LM 模块工具箱；(4) 应采用公平的、面向直观而非抽象理论的任务设计。该框架体现了结合神经与符号方法优势的"刺激兼容"认知建模方向，是解释开放语境下人类语用语言使用的一种有前景的方法论工具，但仍需更多工作才能达到完全的认知解释标准。

title: Using Fine-Tuned LLMs to Identify Indicators of Vulnerability in UK Police Incident Logs
summary: Purpose: Understanding how much of routine policing involves vulnerable people could inform resourcing, training, and multi-agency response, yet administrative data provide limited insight. We explore whether an LLM-based classification pipeline, developed on open-source US police data, can be adapted to estimate the prevalence of four vulnerability indicators - mental ill health, substance misuse, alcohol dependence, and homelessness - in UK police incident narratives, and when outputs can be treated as defensible measurements. Methods: We analyse nearly 3,000 de-identified incident logs from a UK police force, using a multi-stage pipeline combining repeated model inference, label aggregation, structured human review, and statistical correction. The pipeline runs on a locally hosted open-weight LLM, reflecting the secure environments police must work in. Results: LLMs can produce meaningful, if imperfect, prevalence estimates at scale. Mental ill health indicators are present in approximately one in five incidents, with lower prevalence for other indicators. However, naive LLM deployment is unreliable: single-pass classifications are unstable, and aggregated outputs systematically over-assign indicators relative to human judgement. Correcting these biases required substantial human input and statistical adjustment, leaving considerable uncertainty. Conclusions: While LLMs can extract information from unstructured police data, their outputs cannot be treated as valid measurements without careful methodological support. At the population level, defensible estimates are achievable but resource-intensive; at the individual level, errors remain frequent and unpredictable, limiting suitability for operational decisions. This study highlights both the potential and the constraints of LLM-based measurement in applied settings.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨将基于LLM的分类流程（最初在美国公开警察数据上开发）适配至英国警务事件记录，用于估算四类弱势指标（精神疾病、药物滥用、酒精依赖、无家可归者）的群体层面患病率。研究采用知识蒸馏后的Llama 3 8B模型进行两步分类，配合重复推理、人工审核与蒙特卡洛校正，最终得出可防御的群体估计，但在个体层面分类仍不可靠。
AI.motivation: 警务工作中大量涉及弱势人群（占比据报40%–75%），但现有结构化行政数据（qualifier flags、incident categories等）记录不完整、不一致，无法支撑资源调配、培训与跨机构响应决策。事件记录中含有大量非结构化叙述文本，蕴含丰富信息，但手动编码难以规模化，传统NLP又缺乏语境敏感的判别能力。本文旨在探索LLM是否能在满足英国警务数据安全约束的前提下，从非结构化叙述中提取有意义的弱势指标患病率，并明确何时其输出可被视为可靠测量。
AI.method: 1) 数据：来自英国某非都市警察局单个BCU三个月的STORM事件记录（2,977份日志，经白名单匿名化后保留93.1%的词token），清洗后按400词阈值切分为3,850个文本段。2) 两步分类流程：先抽取证据引文（最多两条），再按NONE/WEAK/MODERATE/STRONG四级评估证据强度。3) 知识蒸馏：使用GPT-4o-mini在Boston FIO数据上生成10,000条训练样本，通过LoRA（rank 16, alpha 32）微调Llama 3 8B模型（4-bit NF4量化）。4) 每段重复分类5次（temperature=0.7），聚合形成"No Evidence / Uncertain / Strong Evidence"三类别。5) 人工审核250个段以构建转换概率，通过10,000次蒙特卡洛模拟生成分类校正后的患病率估计与95%置信区间。6) 与警务系统的qualifier字段交叉比较。
AI.result: 1) 标签变异性：NONE标签高度稳定（绝大多数全票一致），STRONG标签稳定性中等，MODERATE标签最不稳定且频次极低（仅84例）。2) 分类精度：作为"负面过滤器"表现出色——No Evidence的人工一致率均超96%；但不确定类别噪声大，模型存在系统性过度敏感偏差（如将住院误判为精神疾病、将酒店住宿误判为无家可归者）。3) 经校正的患病率估计：精神疾病22.9%（95% CI: 19.4–26.7%）、酒精依赖8.2%（6.3–10.3%）、药物滥用5.0%（3.7–6.5%）、无家可归者2.9%（2.1–4.0%）。原始估计因"Uncertain"类别过度敏感而显著高估。4) 模型分类与警务qualifier字段一致性极低，两者捕获的几乎是不同的事件集合。
AI.conclusion: LLM可在严格方法论支撑下从非结构化警务数据中提取有意义的群体层面患病率信息，且这一能力是其他可扩展方法无法替代的；但原始模型输出不能直接作为有效测量——单次分类不稳定、聚合输出系统性高估，必须通过重复推理、人工审核与统计校正的完整流程才能产出可防御的估计。在个体层面，分类错误仍频繁且不可预测，不适用于运营决策（如案件分诊或优先级排序）。警务领域行政性qualifier字段无法取代基于叙述文本的分析。本文强调了在敏感领域负责任地部署LLM所需的严谨方法论基础设施，其价值在于可扩展至多年期、全警局、多警局的比较研究，为资源配置与跨机构协作提供量化依据。

title: PathReportEval: A Systematic Benchmark for Pathology Report Generation
summary: Pathology report generation from whole-slide images (WSIs) is a rapidly growing multimodal learning problem, yet progress is difficult to measure because existing studies use heterogeneous datasets, model settings, visual encoders, and evaluation protocols. Moreover, commonly used natural language generation metrics, including BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR, primarily reward lexical similarity and often fail to detect clinically consequential errors such as omitted diagnoses, hallucinated findings, or discordant tumor attributes. We present a standardized benchmark and evaluation framework for pathology report generation. The benchmark evaluates four representative methods across three datasets (TCGA, HistAI, and REG 2025) using three pathology foundation encoders (CONCHv1.5, UNI2-h, and H-Optimus-1). Our framework standardizes preprocessing, feature extraction, training, decoding, and evaluation, enabling fair comparison across models while providing a modular platform for integrating new methods, datasets, and encoders. A central contribution is the Clinical Report Quality Score (CRQS), a clinically grounded metric for evaluating factual correctness. CRQS maps reference and generated reports into structured clinical attributes and measures four complementary dimensions: clinical fact coverage, key information recall, hallucination rate, and clinical discordance, producing both an overall score and interpretable sub-scores. Experiments demonstrate that conventional language-generation metrics are weakly aligned with clinical correctness and frequently overestimate report quality. In contrast, CRQS reveals clinically meaningful differences between models and encoders that lexical metrics fail to capture. Together, the benchmark, public plug-and-play framework, and CRQS establish a reproducible foundation for rigorous evaluation of pathology report generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 PathReportEval，一个针对全幅切片图像（WSI）病理报告生成任务的标准化基准与评估框架，核心贡献是提出了一种临床导向的评价指标 CRQS（Clinical Report Quality Score），用于弥补 BLEU/ROUGE/METEOR 等词法指标无法捕捉临床事实错误的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 病理报告生成作为快速发展的多模态学习任务，面临两大核心挑战：（1）现有研究在数据集、预处理、视觉编码器、模型实现、解码策略和评估协议上高度异质，导致不同方法间的性能差异难以归因；（2）广泛使用的 NLG 指标（BLEU、ROUGE、METEOR）仅衡量词面相似度，无法识别遗漏诊断、幻觉发现或肿瘤属性不一致等临床关键错误，可能高估报告质量，误导研究方向。
AI.method:
1. 构建标准化基准：在 TCGA、HistAI、REG 2025 三个数据集上，统一数据划分、TRIDENT 预处理管线、tokenization、特征提取、训练与解码流程，评估 4 种代表性报告生成方法（WSI-Caption/MI-Gen、HistGen、BiGen、SCOUT）与 3 种病理基础编码器（CONCHv1.5、UNI2-h、H-Optimus-1）的组合。
2. 提供模块化"即插即用"PyTorch Lightning 框架，支持新模型/数据集/编码器的快速集成。
3. 提出 CRQS 指标：基于 College of American Pathologists 综合报告实践，将参考报告与生成报告映射为结构化临床属性，从四个互补维度评估——临床事实覆盖率（CFC）、关键信息召回率（KIR，强调诊断、分级、分期、切缘等关键字段）、幻觉率（HR，惩罚无依据生成事实）、临床不一致性评分（CDS，捕获直接矛盾），并通过加权（w₁=0.30, w₂=0.40, w₃=0.20, w₄=0.40）整合为 [0,1] 区间的综合分数，同时提供可解释的子分数以支持细粒度错误分析。
AI.result:
1. 词法指标与临床正确性弱相关：在 TCGA 上 BLEU/ROUGE 相近的模型在 CRQS 上差异显著；CRQS 揭示出 METEOR 等指标所掩盖的临床有意义差异。
2. 数据集与编码器敏感性强：TCGA 因报告长且噪声高，CRQS 较低、HR≈0.5；REG 2025 报告短且半结构化，词法与 CRQS 一致性最佳、幻觉率最低；HistAI 居中。无单一编码器在所有数据集和方法上占优（如 TCGA 上 UNI2-h 综合最优，HistAI 上 H-Optimus-1 最优，REG 2025 上 UNI2-h 最优）。
3. 方法层面：SCOUT 在 NLG 指标上通常最强，BiGen 在 CRQS 上具有竞争力，WSI-Caption 在统一管线后表现优于原始报告。
4. 定性分析：METEOR 对 HSIL→LSIL 的诊断降级错误给出中等分（0.43），而 CRQS 给出 -0.07 的极低分；反之，METEOR 对"reactive lymph node"与"reactive lymph node hyperplasia"给出 0.01 的极低分，CRQS 则给出 0.91，验证了 CRQS 对临床语义保真度的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 标准 NLG 指标不构成临床正确性的可靠代理；以临床事实正确性（而非词面相似度）作为病理报告生成系统的主要评估准则至关重要。PathReportEval 通过提供标准化基准、公开框架与 CRQS 指标，为可复现、可比较的临床导向评估奠定基础，并推动评估范式从词法相似度向临床保真度转变。未来工作应扩展数据集、纳入新架构，并将 CRQS 拓展至更广泛的临床概念范围。

title: Search-on-Graph-R1: Training Large Language Models to Search Knowledge Graphs with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires navigating from topic entities to an answer several relations away. Recent methods prompt a frontier LLM to explore the graph through a retrieval tool, but their reliance on frontier-scale inference makes them costly to deploy. We present Search-on-Graph-R1 (\sogrone{}), which internalizes this navigation into a compact 8B model through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL). Our central idea is to scaffold a frontier teacher with each question's gold SPARQL query, so the teacher traverses a known answer-bearing path with a live \texttt{Search} tool rather than having to discover the path itself. Since every call executes against a live Freebase server, the resulting trajectories are grounded in the knowledge graph by construction. On WebQSP, CWQ, and GrailQA, \sogrone{} at 8B surpasses every frozen frontier-LLM system in our comparison and posts the strongest results on CWQ of any system we compare against. It does so using no auxiliary module at inference and no LLM judge during training. Isolating each training stage shows that SFT and RL contribute complementary gains, our approach transfers across model families, and RL learns to reach answers in fewer \texttt{Search} calls than its SFT initialization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Search-on-Graph-R1（SoG-R1），通过"SPARQL 引导的冷启动 SFT + GRPO 强化学习"两阶段后训练流程，将知识图谱导航能力内化到一个 8B 紧凑模型中，无需推理时的辅助模块或训练时的 LLM 评判器，在 WebQSP、CWQ、GrailQA 上超越所有冻结的前沿大模型系统，并在 CWQ 上取得对比中最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有 KGQA 方法普遍依赖 GPT-4 级冻结前沿大模型通过检索工具探索图谱，存在延迟高、成本贵、可访问性受限等部署难题。语义解析方法一次性提交完整逻辑形式，难以处理未见过的 schema 元素；其他方法要么将检索与推理分离（EoG 使用静态子图），要么依赖 LLM 评判器提供奖励（KG-Hopper），且允许模型回退到参数化记忆，无法保证答案真正来自知识图谱。本文旨在用单一紧凑模型实现实时检索与推理的融合，把导航能力内化进模型权重。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：（1）SPARQL 引导的冷启动轨迹生成——利用每个训练问题附带的 gold SPARQL 查询作为脚手架，让 Qwen3-235B 教师模型沿着已知答案路径通过同一个 Search 工具调用 Freebase Virtuoso 服务器（确保每条事实来自真实图谱查询）；（2）LoRA SFT——把多轮轨迹序列化，学生仅在 assistant 轮计算 next-token 损失；（3）GRPO 强化学习——奖励 r(τ)=g(τ)·r_em(τ)·f(n_t)，其中格式门 g 要求至少一次 Search 调用且答案以"Final answer:"干净终止，r_em 为精确匹配，f(n_t) 为轮次效率乘性因子（仅在正确轨迹间起 tie-breaker 作用）；关键改进包括将 Search 工具批量化（一次查询多实体）以解决小规模下"丢实体"失败模式。推理时学生只接收问题与主题实体，无 SPARQL 与任何辅助模块。
AI.result: 在三个 Freebase KGQA 基准上：WebQSP 91.7 / CWQ 88.7 / GrailQA 90.0（Hits@1）。CWQ 超越所有冻结前沿系统（包括 LMP 82.2 与 SoG 75.1）和所有后训练系统（包括 ChatKBQA 86.0、Explore-on-Graph 82.6）；WebQSP 与 GrailQA 仅略低于 EoG（92.8/92.1），但 EoG 依赖离线条子图预处理且无法动态查询。消融显示：Base → SoG-SFT 提升 +41.7/+54.1/+34.7，SFT+RL 再加 +0.8/+2.4/+1.2；RL-only（SoG-R1-Zero）仅 80.9/63.0/60.7，证实冷启动必要性；RL 阶段使 Search 调用数在三个基准上分别减少 15%/4%/10%，同时准确率上升；数据规模消融显示 RL 增益在数据稀缺时最大；Qwen3-4B 上结果趋势一致，证明方法跨模型家族可迁移。
AI.conclusion: SoG-R1 证明可以通过 SFT+GRPO 将实时知识图谱导航能力压缩到一个紧凑 8B 模型中，且无需任何 LLM 评判器或辅助模块；SPARQL 引导的冷启动轨迹是保证训练信号 KG-grounded 的关键；SFT 提供强先验、RL 在此基础上做精炼并压缩路径长度；方法在不同模型家族与规模上均可迁移，在 CWQ 这一多跳推理最难基准上取得最佳成绩。局限性：仅在 Freebase 上验证且依赖训练集的 gold SPARQL 与 oracle 主题实体链接，未测试 Wikidata 等无 SPARQL 标注或自链接场景。

title: Reasoning Fine-Tuning Induces Persistent Latent Policy States
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026. 45 pages, including appendices; 24 figures and 12 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Reasoning-specialized language models show large performance gains over base models, yet the internal changes responsible for improved multi-step reasoning remain poorly understood. It is unclear whether reasoning fine-tuning improves local token-level competence or globally reorganizes how models structure inference over time. We address this question by modeling Chain-of-Thought reasoning as a switching dynamical system (SDS), in which internal representations evolve under discrete latent policy states. Our framework combines time-aware contrastive representation learning with discrete regime discovery to recover latent policies from activation trajectories. Across four benchmarks and model scales from 1.5B to 32B parameters, reasoning-fine-tuned models exhibit richer latent-policy organization than their base counterparts, characterized by more differentiated transition structure and model-dependent changes in state utilization, persistence, and mixing. The recovered regimes exhibit functional specialization aligned with distinct reasoning stages, and extensive controls confirm that their structure is not explained by correctness, representation learning, or modeling priors, but depends on the coherent temporal organization of reasoning trajectories. Causal interventions further show that the regimes are functionally meaningful: state-swap ablations reduce one-step predictive fit, while transplanting reasoning dynamics into base models improves performance on challenging reasoning problems. Finally, SDS-guided pruning of failure-prone reasoning prefixes outperforms self-consistency in 11 of 12 model-dataset settings, with gains of up to 12.5 percentage points. Together, our results suggest that reasoning fine-tuning globally reorganizes latent dynamics, offering a new lens for mechanistic analysis and process-level control of reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将思维链推理建模为切换动态系统（SDS），结合CEBRA对比表征学习，在4个基准、1.5B–32B四个模型规模上系统比较基础模型与推理微调模型的内部动态结构。研究发现推理微调全局性地重组了潜在策略状态——产生了更丰富、差异化程度更高的转移结构，且这些状态具有因果功能意义和实用价值。
AI.motivation: 推理微调（如DeepSeek-R1类方法）虽带来显著性能提升，但其内部机制仍不清楚：是仅仅提升了局部token级能力，还是全局性地重组了模型在长程推理中的计算动态？由于CoT推理是涉及随机采样与分支轨迹的时序过程，建立可解释的内部结构面临挑战。本研究旨在回答这一根本问题。
AI.method: 1) **框架**：将CoT推理建模为切换动态系统（SDS），离散潜在策略状态 s_t ∈ {1,…,K} 调控连续表征 z_t 的演化（z_{t+1}=A_k z_t + b_k + ε）；2) **表征**：采用CEBRA时间感知对比编码器将残差流激活投影到低维嵌入空间；3) **估计**：EM算法（前向-后向平滑）拟合参数，BIC选择模型阶数K；4) **理论**：建立CEBRA优于PCA的Bhattacharyya距离准则，证明SDS的可识别性、MLE一致性，并刻画"状态分裂悬崖"现象；5) **评估指标**：有效状态数K_eff、持续性p_stay、转移结构TVD、谱间隙；6) **因果干预**：状态交换消融、策略移植到基础模型残差流、PrefixGuard（前缀剪枝）；7) **对照实验**：配对正确轨迹、时间打乱、随机化CEBRA正样本对、Dirichlet先验敏感性。
AI.result: 1) **结构差异**：四组模型对在所有基准上，推理微调一致提升TVD（最稳健指标），K_eff、p_stay、谱间隙的变化则因模型而异；2) **BIC分析**：推理模型偏好更大的K*，表明具有更丰富的多策略结构；3) **功能专化**：恢复的regime与人工定义的推理阶段（计划生成、事实检索、计算、自检、最终答案发射等）显著对应；4) **因果验证**：状态交换消融显著降低单步预测R²，策略移植在base pass@8=0的难题上使pass@8提升至0.24–0.60；5) **实用性**：PrefixGuard在12个模型-数据集设置中的11个上超过自一致性，平均提升4.5pp，最大12.5pp；6) **鲁棒性**：所有差异在配对正确子集、时间打乱使ΔR²变为负值、CEBRA正样本随机化、Dirichlet先验变化的控制实验下均保持。
AI.conclusion: 推理微调诱导持续性潜在策略状态的全局性重组，而非仅提升局部token能力。SDS框架提供了机制分析和过程级控制的新视角：理论上阐明了RLVR为何强化已有潜在结构（持续优势函数边界），实践上PrefixGuard已展示了直接部署价值。局限：仅适用于有显式CoT的数学/符号/多步推理，未涵盖检索、工具使用、智能体或多模态推理。

title: Fusion Embedding: A Unified Embedding Space for Text, Image, Video, and Audio
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures. Models: this https URL and this https URL . Code: this https URL
summary: A single embedding space that covers text, images, video, and audio lets one index serve every query a user can pose. Embedding models built on vision-language backbones now lead text/image/video retrieval benchmarks but lack audio entirely, while audio-text retrieval is led by specialist systems that serve no other modality. We present the Fusion Embedding family, which adds audio to a frozen vision-language embedding base whose parameters are never updated: generation 1 (fusion-embedding-1) trains only a 16.4M-parameter connector between a frozen audio tower and the frozen base, and generation 2 (fusion-embedding-2) adds modality-gated deep adapters (44.2M parameters) whose branch never executes on text, image, or video inputs: their outputs are bit-for-bit those of the released base, verified after every training run. Because the base already binds text, images, and video, aligning audio to text alone makes audio-image retrieval emerge, with zero paired audio-visual training data. Alongside the recipe we map its design space with controlled negative results (rewriting training captions with an LLM, substituting a leaderboard-stronger audio tower, and widening the connector each reduce retrieval) and with training-protocol findings that we expect to transfer to any frozen decoder-LM embedding backbone. Both generations train in hours on a single GPU. Weights, code, and the evaluation harness are openly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Fusion Embedding 系列模型，通过冻结视觉-语言嵌入基座（Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B）并在外部添加 16.4M 连接器（Gen-1）或 60.6M 模态门控深度适配器（Gen-2），在不修改基座任何参数的前提下将音频模态纳入统一嵌入空间，实现文本/图像/视频/音频四模态共享同一向量空间，且非音频输入的输出与基座逐比特一致。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入模型存在两类痛点：（1）基于视觉-语言骨干的嵌入模型（如 Qwen3-VL-Embedding）在文本/图像/视频检索基准上领先但完全不支持音频；（2）音频-文本检索由专用系统（CLAP 系列、OEA、AuroLA）主导，但仅服务单一模态对，无法扩展到多模态统一空间。传统添加新模态的方法（如 LoRA）会改动骨干内部参数，导致已部署索引失效、基座基准性能不再保留。本文追求的目标是：在不损失基座已有能力（bit-for-bit 保留）的前提下，将音频作为一等模态加入已有视觉-语言检索器的统一空间，并保留对四个模态的覆盖能力。
AI.method: 核心设计是"冻结基座融合"（frozen-base fusion）：基座（Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B，2B 参数）和音频塔（Qwen2.5-Omni 的 Whisper-derived 编码器，约 640M）均冻结不更新。Generation 1 仅训练一个 16.4M 的 FusionResampler（Flamingo 风格的 perceiver resampler，瓶颈宽度 384、64 个潜在查询、6 个预归一化块），将音频帧映射为占位符 token 注入基座输入嵌入。Generation 2 在此基础上为基座 28 个解码器层的残差流添加瓶颈适配器（LayerNorm→2048×384→SiLU→384×2048，共 44.2M 参数），并通过模态门控使适配器仅在音频输入时执行，文本/图像/视频前向保持比特级恒等。训练采用对称 InfoNCE（在每个 Matryoshka 层级上计算）+ CORAL 协方差惩罚（λ=0.05），使用全语料库冻结文本负样本银行（484K 句嵌入缓存，零陈旧性），并采用基座原生聊天模板格式（关键发现：较裸格式提升 +14.5 R@10），对冻结文本侧进行对角化白化以兼容 Matryoshka 嵌套；50 万条以上启用软标签（β=0.3）与假阴性掩码（τ=0.98）。最终还进行 400 步领域内微调（AudioCaps 训练集），并设置两道预注册门控（AudioCaps R@10 至少 +2，Clotho 零样本 R@10 损失不超过 2）。
AI.result: Generation 1（v0.3）AudioCaps A→T R@10 达 0.741（R@1 0.332），T→A R@10 达 0.746；Clotho 严格零样本 R@10 0.433/0.460；Generation 2 进一步在 T→A 方向领先（Audiocaps 0.775、Clotho 0.482）并保持 A→T R@10 0.743；涌现式音频→图像检索在 VGGSound-696 上达 R@10 0.418（机会率 0.014 的 29 倍），全程零音频-图像配对训练。负向结果揭示三个反直觉发现：（1）LLM 重写训练字幕反而使检索下降 2.5 R@10（风格漂移主导）；（2）排行榜更强的音频塔（Dasheng-base）在冻结 LLM 拼接设置下落后 Qwen2.5-Omni 塔 16 个 R@10 点（浅投影排名不可迁移）；（3）连接器宽度 512 出现过拟合，不如 384。MAEB 声音事件子集在 UrbanSound8K 等任务上排名 #3-#6。逐比特不变性经单元测试验证，最大绝对差为 0。基座参数漂移断言（base_drift=0）在所有训练运行后严格成立。与全参数训练的 CLAP 系列相比仍存在 16-19 R@10 差距，但以"能力换不变性"换取单卡数小时训练、零重嵌入、四模态统一空间。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明冻结视觉-语言嵌入基座可在完全不动基座参数的前提下扩展到音频，且能以比特级精确方式保持原有基座基准性能不变。两代模型均开源发布（Apache-2.0 代码、约 60MB 连接器检查点）。训练协议效应（+14.5 R@10）有望推广至任何冻结的解码器 LM 嵌入骨干；全语料库负样本银行在 50 万条以上存在拥挤效应（需软标签/假阴性掩码缓解）。未来方向：扩展语音与音乐语料使指令分类法完整、利用未饱和的适配器秩维度、以及将同一配方应用于 8B 基座层。

title: Rationale-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Cross-Lingual Stance Detection
summary: Stance detection aims to identify whether a text expresses a favorable or opposing attitude toward a given target, and serves as an important task for various downstream applications. Although existing studies have achieved strong performance in monolingual settings, especially in English, many low-resource languages such as Catalan still lack sufficient annotated data for training effective models. Cross-lingual stance detection alleviates this problem by transferring stance knowledge from resource-rich languages to low-resource languages. However, most existing methods mainly rely on semantic alignment between texts and targets, while ignoring the reasoning process required for reliable stance inference. Although Large Language Models provide strong reasoning ability, their high computational cost and inference latency limit practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose a rationale-guided knowledge distillation framework for cross-lingual stance detection. Specifically, we use Chain-of-Thought prompting to guide Large Language Models in generating informative rationales, and distill the resulting reasoning knowledge into a compact student model. We further design a dual-path distillation mechanism to align rationale-enhanced and rationale-free representations, together with their prediction distributions. In addition, two contrastive learning strategies are introduced to improve stance discrimination. Experiments on multilingual benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms competitive baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于推理机理引导的知识蒸馏框架，用于跨语言立场检测。该方法通过思维链（CoT）提示引导大型语言模型（Qwen）生成信息丰富的推理机理，并将其提炼为轻量级的多语言BERT（mBERT）学生模型，同时设计了双路径蒸馏机制和两种对比学习策略，以缓解低资源语言数据稀缺的问题。
AI.motivation: 动机源于跨语言立场检测中的两大核心难题：（1）大多数现有方法仅依赖文本与目标的语义对齐，忽略了立场推断所需的中间推理过程；（2）大型语言模型虽然具备强大的推理能力，但推理延迟和高计算成本限制了其实际部署。因此，亟需一种能够将LLM的推理知识高效迁移到紧凑模型的方法。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心模块：（1）利用上下文学习（ICL，8个示例）和思维链提示从冻结的Qwen LLM中生成推理机理；（2）双分支层次蒸馏框架：推理增强路径接受(target, text, rationale)作为输入，标准路径仅接受(target, text)，通过对齐两路径的隐藏表示和预测分布实现知识迁移；（3）两种对比学习策略：源语言阶段基于类原型（类内均值向量）与查询样本相似度构建对比损失；目标语言阶段在低资源条件下采用InfoNCE式的双约束对比对齐，拉近同一样本的两路径表示、推开不同样本。整体损失由交叉熵损失、KL散度损失和对比损失加权和组成。
AI.result: 在X-stance、CIC和VaxxStance三个多语言基准数据集上的实验表明，所提方法持续优于TAN、CrossNet、JointCL、CLKD、mBERT-FT和CCSD等基线，相较于最强基线CCSD在准确率和F1分数上均提升约1%–3%。消融实验证实了推理机理路径的有效性（去除后性能下降1%–1.5%），并验证了8个ICL示例、8支持样本/类+4查询样本的构建设置以及对比损失权重α=0.03、β=0.05为最优超参数配置。Qwen思考模式因生成更高质量的推理机理而优于非思考模式。Integrated Gradients定性分析表明该方法能够关注整体短语推理而非孤立关键词。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种融合LLM推理与知识蒸馏的跨语言立场检测框架，有效缓解了低资源语言场景下数据稀缺和架构鸿沟（decoder-only LLM与encoder-only mBERT）两大挑战。方法在多个多语言数据集上取得稳定的性能提升，验证了推理机理引导蒸馏策略的有效性。未来工作将向真正的零样本场景、更紧凑的架构（如XLM-RoBERTa）、多类立场检测以及基于主题复杂度的动态ICL示例数量调整等方向拓展。

title: Dual Attention Residuals
summary: Recent work extends Transformer residual pathways along two complementary axes: historical retrieval selects information from earlier depths, whereas multi-stream methods maintain multiple residual trajectories. These capabilities have largely been studied in isolation, and assigning an independent retriever to each stream still prevents one trajectory from influencing depth selection in another. We propose Dual Attention Residuals (DAR), which brings multi-stream interaction into historical retrieval through reciprocal cross-stream addressing. For each target stream, DAR computes depth weights from normalized states in the opposite stream and applies them to values from the target stream's own history. The retrieved states are combined for an unchanged Transformer branch and updated through constrained gated writes; a block-form variant operates on block-level histories to control overhead. Across dense models from 0.1B to 1B parameters and a 7B sparse-MoE model, DAR consistently improves validation loss over standard residual Transformers and Attention Residuals. Routing ablations show that the gain cannot be explained by an additional stream or value projection alone. Representation and intervention analyses further show that reciprocal cross-stream selection preserves depth-wise diversity and avoids the redundancy or functional imbalance observed in alternative two-stream designs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双注意力残差（Dual Attention Residuals, DAR），通过跨流（cross-stream）相互寻址将多流残差与历史检索结合，在不改变Transformer分支的前提下，用对侧流的状态计算深度权重、聚合自身流的历史值，从而在0.1B–1B密集模型及7B稀疏MoE模型上一致地降低验证损失。
AI.motivation: Transformer的残差通路沿两个正交方向扩展：历史检索（如Attention Residuals）控制选择哪一深度，多流残差（如Hyper-Connections、mHC）控制维护哪几条轨迹。两者此前被孤立研究，给每条流配独立检索器仍无法让一条轨迹影响另一条的深度选择，形成"地址-内容耦合"。论文旨在解除这一耦合，让多流成为深度选择的互补信号。
AI.method: DAR为每条目标流j：(1) 用对侧流(1-j)的RMSNorm后状态作key、自身流状态作value，经softmax得到深度权重并加权求和得到h_ℓ^j；(2) 两个流状态混合后送入不变Transformer分支得f_ℓ(h_ℓ)；(3) 通过门控α_ℓ、β_ℓ和约束混合矩阵M(ρ)（来自mHC）更新两条流的部分块状态P_b^i。Block DAR以K层为单位检索粗粒度历史以控开销；Full DAR取K=1。完整算法包含双流检索、块内门控写与附录A.1中的融合前缀核与在线softmax合并。
AI.result: 在FineWeb-Edu上：1B密集模型DAR-Block 2.684 vs Residual 2.716、AttnRes-Block 2.704；7B稀疏MoE DAR 2.739 vs 2.785（AttnRes）；0.1/0.3/0.5B DAR相对基线分别降低2.03%/2.22%/5.12%，且优于mHC。0.5B参数匹配消融显示DAR(2.653)显著优于AttnRes(2.708)、AttnRes+SepV(2.757,说明价值投影非增益来源)、DAR-SelfKV(2.678)、DAR-CrossV(2.664)、DAR-FixedKV(2.690)。CKA与干预分析表明DAR保持局部跨深度对齐与双向流均衡使用，而SelfKV/FixedKV/mHC-2出现冗余或流失衡。训练开销：DAR相对AttnRes吞吐降9.23%、峰值显存增加3.1 GiB。
AI.conclusion: DAR将深度检索重新表述为深度与流角色的联合选择：跨流key、自流value在不修改Transformer分支的前提下，让两条轨迹对深度选择和历史内容做出互惠贡献。在密集与稀疏MoE模型上DAR均降低验证损失；消融与表征分析排除了"多一条流"或"多一个价值投影"作为增益来源，并证明双向相互路由避免了替代设计中观察到的冗余与功能失衡。

title: RF-Agent: A Practical Framework for Building Language Agents for RFIC Design
comment: Accepted at ICLAD (IEEE International Conference on LLM-Aided Design), 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have driven rapid progress in electronic design automation (EDA), yet their application to radio-frequency (RF) circuit design remains limited by the scarcity of domain-specific datasets and standardized benchmarks. We present RF-Agent, which addresses this gap through textbook-driven knowledge distillation. A multi-agent Question-Thinking-Solution-Answer (QTSA) pipeline converts a subsection-level corpus from seven canonical RF textbooks into the first-of-its-kind RF-domain reasoning dataset (over 11,000 samples) with a dedicated multiple-choice benchmark. On this benchmark we study two adaptation strategies: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and three retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) configurations (semantic, keyword, hybrid). Across multiple LLM families, domain-specific SFT significantly improves RF reasoning, especially for small and medium-sized models; among RAG configurations, semantic retrieval performs best, indicating embedding-based context alignment suits RF reasoning better than naive fusion. The dataset and benchmark provide a reusable foundation for future work on LLM-aided RF circuit design.

AI.tldr: RF-Agent提出了一套基于教科书驱动知识蒸馏的框架，通过多智能体QTSA（Question-Thinking-Solution-Answer）流水线从7本经典RF教科书中构建了首个RF领域推理数据集（超过11,000个样本）及配套多选题基准，系统比较了监督微调（SFT）与三种检索增强生成（RAG）配置在RF电路推理任务上的效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在电子设计自动化（EDA）领域取得快速进展，但其在射频（RF）电路设计中的应用受限于三大瓶颈：(1) RF领域知识集中在专业教科书与专有设计笔记中，缺乏开源策划的数据集；(2) RF推理需要拓扑识别、S参数分析、阻抗匹配等多步结构化推导，超出通用预训练能力；(3) 缺乏标准化的RF基准数据集，无法客观评估领域适应策略。该工作旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 方法包含两大策略：(1) **数据构建**：采用三智能体QTSA蒸馏流水线——Question Agent（GPT-4.1-mini）从1,108个子节级语料单元中以五种推理视角生成mcQTSA（四选一多选题）和ndQTSA（开放式问答）样本；Answer Agent（GPT-5-mini，推理导向）生成CoT思维链监督；Process Agent进行JSON规范化与字段校验。数据集超过11,000个样本。(2) **模型适应**：在LLaMA-3.2和Qwen3（0.6B–4B）系列上进行SFT；构建包含950篇RF论文和7本教科书的向量知识库（基于BGE-M3嵌入+ChromaDB），对比语义检索、关键词（BM25）检索与混合检索（RRF融合+BGE重排）三种RAG配置，并在GPT-4o、Qwen3-235B、DeepSeek-V3.2等SOTA模型上验证。
AI.result: **SFT结果**：跨模型家族均有一致提升，小模型增益尤为显著——Llama3.2-3B-Base从37.1%提升至70.5%（+33.4pp），Llama3.2-1B-Base从24.7%提升至54.4%；混合mcQTSA+ndQTSA训练效果最佳（59.0%，优于单一格式）；Qwen3-4B等大模型增益边际（<2.5%）。Thinking模式精度更高，且SFT后推理延迟反而下降（Qwen3-1.7B-T从68.47s降至41.61s），表明领域监督收敛了内部推理过程。**RAG结果**：语义检索最优，将GPT-4o从89.6%提升至93.0%，DeepSeek-V3.2-T从89.1%提升至93.7%；Hit-and-Miss实验证实增益来源于检索质量（语义检索Hit-Miss差距+10.3%）；关键词检索在概念性、推导级相关性任务上表现欠佳，混合检索因RRF融合前引入BM25噪声候选而精度受限。
AI.conclusion: RF-Agent为RF电路设计中的LLM领域适应提供了首个可复用的数据基础和系统化的方法论框架：SFT与RAG在不同模型规模和应用场景下具有互补价值——小模型通过SFT可逼近大模型性能，大模型通过RAG获得领域知识锚定。未来工作方向包括：构建超越多选题的智能体设计任务、引入RLHF与领域专家反馈、以及对模型生成推理进行专家级人工评估。

title: CASE: Causal Alignment and Structural Enforcement for Improving Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is widely used to improve both the performance and interpretability of large language models (LLMs), yet the generated reasoning may not faithfully support the final answer. We study this problem from a causal perspective, where a faithful CoT process should follow the chain $Z\rightarrow X\rightarrow Y$, with $Z$, $X$, and $Y$ denoting the instruction, reasoning chain, and final answer, respectively. In this process, the instruction should affect the answer only through the reasoning chain. However, conventional autoregressive LLMs condition answer generation on both the instruction and the CoT, which still allows a direct instruction-to-answer shortcut. To address this issue, we propose CASE, a framework that combines training-time causal alignment and inference-time structural enforcement. During training, CASE builds counterfactual-CoT, biased-instruction, and empty-instruction datasets, and applies selective-loss fine-tuning to strengthen CoT-to-answer dependence while suppressing instruction shortcuts. During inference, CASE masks direct attention from instruction tokens to answer tokens, preventing the model from bypassing the generated CoT. We provide an information-theoretic analysis showing how these components promote faithful chains. Experiments on three models and four benchmarks show that CASE achieves a 37\% average per-setting relative improvement in overall CoT faithfulness over the strongest baselines, exhibits stronger cross-dataset faithfulness transfer, and maintains competitive average accuracy. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出CASE框架，通过训练时的因果对齐（构造反事实CoT、偏置指令和空指令数据集并进行选择性损失微调）和推理时的结构化约束（掩码指令到答案的直接注意力路径），增强大语言模型思维链（CoT）推理的忠实性，使答案生成遵循 Z→X→Y 的因果链。在3个模型和4个基准上的实验表明，CASE在CoT忠实性上比最强基线平均提升37%，且具有良好的跨数据集泛化能力，同时保持有竞争力的准确率。
AI.motivation: 链式思维（CoT）推理虽能提升大语言模型的性能和可解释性，但生成的推理链未必忠实支撑最终答案——模型可能通过指令到答案的快捷路径绕过CoT直接得出结论。现有方法（后选候选选择、忠实CoT监督微调、双模型架构等）要么仅在输出层面干预，要么未显式消除指令到答案的直接捷径，CoT忠实性提升有限且难以跨数据集迁移。
AI.method: 将忠实CoT形式化为因果链 Z→X→Y（指令→推理链→答案），需强化 X→Y 并抑制 Z→Y 快捷路径。CASE包含两个互补阶段：(1) 训练时因果对齐：构造四个数据集——标准数据集 D_A（同时监督CoT和答案token）、反事实CoT数据集 D_B（同一指令配不同CoT-答案对）、偏置指令数据集 D_C（加入误导性上下文）和空指令数据集 D_C（移除指令内容），仅对辅助数据集施加答案token级别的选择性损失；(2) 推理时结构化约束：在答案token生成时将所有指令token位置的预softmax注意力logits设为−∞，阻断直接注意力路径，同时保留CoT介导的路径。从信息论角度，训练目标对应最大化 I(X;Y) 和 I(X;Y|Z)、最小化 I(Y;Z|X) 三个互补标准。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B三个模型上，对ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、StrategyQA和LogiQA四个基准进行全面评估：CASE在12个模型-数据集设置中均取得最佳 G-mean_Faith 整体忠实性分数，相比各设置中最强基线平均相对提升37%（排除双模型FRODO后为65%），排名首位占67%、次位占21%；在跨数据集迁移（ARC-Challenge→OpenBookQA、StrategyQA→ARC-Easy）中表现尤为突出，平均比基线提升61%；平均准确率74.88%，与最强基线74.80%相当；推理速度约为FRODO的3倍，与其他单模型方法相当。消融实验表明训练时因果对齐（TCA）和推理时结构化约束（ISE）互补——TCA主要改善CIE/CDE因果忠实性指标，ISE主要提升FT/EA指标。
AI.conclusion: CASE通过因果视角统一了训练和推理两个阶段，显式强化CoT到答案的依赖、消除指令到答案的直接捷径，是首个在单LLM框架内同时进行因果对齐和结构化推理约束以提升CoT忠实性的方法，在忠实性、跨数据集泛化、准确率和推理效率间取得了良好平衡。

title: HPD-Parsing: Hierarchical Parallel Document Parsing
summary: Efficient teamwork typically combines global coordination with parallel execution, a principle not yet fully reflected in unified Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based document parsers. Existing unified parsers process an entire page jointly but generate its output through a single token-by-token autoregressive trajectory, creating a sequential bottleneck that grows with document length. Such full-page sequential generation overlooks a key property of document parsing: layout must be analyzed globally, whereas block content can be parsed in parallel. Based on this observation, we introduce HPD-Parsing, which replaces full-page autoregressive generation with a Hierarchical Parallel Decoding paradigm. A main layout branch organizes the overall document structure and dynamically assigns block-level content decoding to concurrent branches, while progressive multi-token prediction (P-MTP) further reduces the decoding steps within each branch. Experiments on public benchmarks show that HPD-Parsing achieves 4,752 tokens per second, delivering $2.62\times$ the throughput of the fastest existing document parsing model and $3.06\times$ that of the vanilla autoregressive baseline, while maintaining competitive parsing accuracy. These results establish hierarchical parallel decoding as an effective alternative to full-page autoregressive generation, opening a new direction for efficient unified document parsing.

AI.tldr: 提出HPD-Parsing，一种基于层次并行解码范式的轻量级文档解析器，通过将单条全页自回归轨迹拆分为全局布局主分支与并发区域内容分支，并结合渐进式多令牌预测（P-MTP），在OmniDocBench v1.6上以仅1B参数实现4,752 TPS吞吐量（为最快现有模型的2.62×、自回归基线的3.06×）和94.91的Overall综合分，刷新端到端统一解析器精度纪录。
AI.motivation: 基于VLM的统一文档解析器沿单一token-by-token自回归轨迹生成整页输出，随输出长度增长产生严重顺序瓶颈。论文观察到：文档布局需全局协调，但各区域内容具有局部性，可并行解码；同时局部内容对视觉证据强约束，生成轨迹高度可预测，适合多令牌预测。这一"全局布局+局部内容"的性质被现有自回归范式忽视，亟需新的解码范式。
AI.method: 1) 层次并行解码（HPD）：主布局分支按阅读顺序生成结构序列，预测到<FORK>时动态fork出内容分支，通过共享前缀KV缓存零拷贝复用与局部上下文隔离实现并发解码；2) P-MTP集成：基于轻量级残差MLP在每个分支进行多步前瞻预测，采用渐进损失加权稳定远距离预测；3) 三阶段训练策略：Stage 1全页序列初始化（2.8M样本）→ Stage 2分支特定监督的范式迁移与困难样本优化（100K样本）→ Stage 3任务感知奖励的强化学习（600样本）；4) 自动化难度感知数据管线：特征聚类采样→多模型标注与难度估计→VLM迭代精炼→分布平衡。推理端在vLLM 0.17.1框架内扩展FCFS调度，支持动态分支fork、KV共享与推测解码验证。
AI.result: OmniDocBench v1.6：Overall 94.91分（端到端统一解析器SOTA，优于Qianfan-OCR、Logics-Parsing-v2、FireRed-OCR等更大模型）；TextEdit 0.039、FormulaCDM 97.28、TableTEDS 91.35、TableTEDS-S 94.11、ReadOrderEdit 0.124。吞吐量：4,752.1 TPS / 2.68 PPS（BS=512），分别为自回归基线1,554.8 TPS的3.06×、最快现有模型DeepSeek-OCR-2的1.62×。随输出长度增长，加速优势扩大：最长输出桶内解码步数减少18.04×、请求吞吐提升3.67×（BS=512）、单请求延迟降低5.80×（BS=1）。P-MTP平均每步接受6.6个token。
AI.conclusion: 层次并行解码可作为全页自回归生成的可行替代方案，在保持竞争力的解析精度的同时显著提升吞吐。文档"全局协调+局部可分解"的结构特性表明，该范式可推广至关键信息抽取、多页文档理解等结构化生成任务。未来工作将扩充训练数据覆盖更广泛文档场景，并探索结构感知注意力设计以进一步压缩每步解码的注意力开销。

title: From a Multilingual Streaming ASR Backbone to Kenyan-Language Systems: Data-Centric Adaptation of Nemotron 3.5 for Kikuyu, Dholuo, and Kalenjin
comment: 56 pages, 2 figures. Extended appendices on corpus construction, streaming evaluation, reproducibility, and deployment
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) for African languages is constrained by orthographic inconsistency, annotation artifacts, missing audio, speaker and domain imbalance, and evaluation procedures that differ from deployment. We present an end-to-end engineering study adapting NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B to Kikuyu, Dholuo, and Kalenjin. Starting from a Kenyan Swahili-adapted checkpoint, we retain its cache-aware FastConformer RNN-T, prompt conditioning, and streaming decoder during full-parameter fine-tuning. The study covers corpus auditing, Unicode normalization, split checks, duration filtering, low-rate continuation, validation-based checkpoint selection, true-streaming evaluation, artifact preservation, and isolated serving. On internal, adaptively consulted evaluation sets excluded from gradient updates at context [56,13], selected Kikuyu and Dholuo models achieve 42.97% and 33.98% WER, respectively. Dholuo records 9.59% CER and 8.13% no-space CER under its frozen historical label policy; Kikuyu records 7.79% no-space CER. Kalenjin remains a work in progress: v1-v reaches 68.74% WER on a 2,411-row clean-v3 diagnostic subset excluding long-pause annotations, digit-bearing references, and targets shorter than three tokens. Its checkpoint selection used a mixed-source validation manifest containing test-origin rows, so the score is not an independent generalization estimate. We also report negative findings involving non-speech labels, short-utterance over-generation, boundary-sensitive WER, and cloud job-lifecycle failures. We make no state-of-the-art claim because the internal sets, repeated consultation, and normalization differ from public benchmarks. This work provides an auditable account of adapting a multilingual streaming model into language-specific systems without discarding streaming constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项端到端工程研究，将 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B 模型（经斯瓦希里语桥接检查点初始化）全参数微调适配到肯尼亚的基库尤语（Kikuyu）、丁卢奥语（Dholuo）和卡伦金语（Kalenjin），重点保留了缓存感知的 FastConformer RNN-T 流式架构。研究覆盖了语料审计、Unicode 归一化、分割完整性检查、时长过滤、低学习率分阶段续训、验证驱动的检查点选择、真实流式评估以及隔离部署等全流程。
AI.motivation: 非洲语言的 ASR 系统面临正字法不一致、标注伪影、缺失音频、说话人/领域不平衡以及评估与实际部署脱节等多重问题，仅靠"数据稀缺"难以概括其工程复杂性。本研究旨在探索：在保留原始流式架构的前提下，多语言流式基础模型能否被适配、评估、保留并部署为针对特定肯尼亚语言的真正流式系统，并将数据审计与评估纪律作为与模型规模同等重要的研究变量。
AI.method: 采用 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B（24 层缓存感知 FastConformer 编码器，d=1024，约 6.37 亿参数）作为基础模型，以 Tony Kipkemboi 发布的肯尼亚斯瓦希里语适配检查点为桥接初始化；保留 sw-KE 提示符与 [56,13] 注意力上下文（≈1.04s 未来上下文，1.12s 块跨度）进行全参数 AdamW 微调；学习率 5×10⁻⁷，基于时长（200s 训练 / 120s 验证）的批构造，每 1000 步验证；RNN-T + FastEmit（λ=0.005）；语料来自 African Next Voices 的 Kikuyu、Dholuo、Kalenjin 三语数据；构建了基库尤语的正字法纠正（å→ũ, ä→ĩ 等映射）以及卡伦金语 clean-v1→clean-v2→clean-v3 三代语料清洗策略（含 [cs]/(cs)/[pause]/(pause) 标注符去除、长停顿行剔除、数字行剔除、<3 token 行剔除）；通过 NeMo 缓存感知真实流式评估器而非离线 WER；最终通过 Supabase OAuth + FastAPI WebSocket 实现隔离的语言专属部署。
AI.result: 在内部适应式查询的真实流式评估集上：基库尤语 v13 冠军检查点达到 42.97% WER 和 7.79% 无空格 CER（13 代续训从 v4 的 53.35% WER 累计下降 10.38 个绝对百分点）；丁卢奥语 v7 达到 33.98% WER、9.59% 标准 CER、8.13% 无空格 CER（在冻结的 cs 标签策略下，从 v3-i 的 49.59% 验证 WER 累计下降约 15.6 个百分点）；卡伦金语仍处于研究阶段，v1-v 在 2,411 行的 clean-v3 诊断子集上达到 68.74% WER，但其检查点选择使用了混合来源的 validation manifest（含测试来源行），因此该分数不能视为独立的泛化估计。错误分析揭示了脚本化 vs 非脚本化、长 utterance、代码切换词以及短 utterance 过生成等系统性差异。研究明确否认 SOTA 声明，并因内部测试集被反复查阅而拒绝将其视为一次性基准。
AI.conclusion: 本研究展示了从多语言流式 ASR 基础模型到肯尼亚语言语音系统的完整工程路径，主要贡献在于数据审计、桥接初始化、受控全参数适配、真实流式评估、检查点晋升、隔离部署与可追溯性保存的完整链条；并明确指出低资源 ASR 的核心问题与有效监督、评估纪律、部署保真度密切相关，而不仅仅是模型规模问题。基库尤语和丁卢奥语冠军已保留并部署为隔离的流式服务，卡伦金语作为持续研究案例公开发布其迭代失败模式，为后续冻结的外部基准评估、社区治理与受控消融（基模型对比、tokenizer 消融、多 seed 报告）提供了透明的工程基础。

title: Reasoning Error from Known Fact: Step-Level Self-Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization for LLM
summary: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), modern systems not only possess strong foundational capabilities and extensive knowledge, but can also solve complex problems via long, multi-step reasoning. However, as reasoning traces become longer, LLMs may produce a substantial amount of hallucinated content during the reasoning process, which is often difficult to detect. In this work, we conduct a fine-grained analysis of hallucinations arising in LLM reasoning and find that the reasoning traces are particularly prone to Context-Sensitive Factual Hallucinations: cases where the model actually has the relevant knowledge, yet makes factual errors due to contextual interference during reasoning. To address this issue, we propose Step-level Self-Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization (SSC-GRPO), which assigns step-level rewards to reasoning traces by computing self-consistency scores of individual steps across multiple rollouts. Compared with prior methods, SSC-GRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both mathematical reasoning benchmarks and hallucination leaderboards. Our results offer a new perspective for detecting and mitigating hallucinations in the reasoning process of large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）在多步推理过程中产生的"上下文敏感型事实幻觉"（Context-Sensitive Factual Hallucination）问题，提出了一种基于强化学习的方法——SSC-GRPO（Step-Level Self-Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization）。该方法通过在多次rollout间计算每个推理步骤的自一致性分数，将其作为步骤级奖励并重新分配优势（advantage），无需依赖外部知识即可有效缓解推理过程中的幻觉。在数学推理和幻觉评测基准上均达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 随着推理模型采用test-time scaling生成长链思维（CoT），推理过程中的幻觉问题日益突出。传统幻觉检测方法面向最终输出，对长推理链中嵌入的错误无能为力。作者通过细粒度案例分析发现：模型推理过程中的幻觉大多是"上下文敏感型事实幻觉"——即模型本身具备相关知识，但因上下文干扰而在推理时产生事实错误，且此类幻觉在所有推理幻觉中占主导地位（~70%）。现有方法（如FSPO）依赖外部知识提供步骤级奖励，限制了其应用。
AI.method: 1. **幻觉分析框架**：使用更强的参考模型（Qwen3-235B-A22B）定位推理链中的错误步骤并分类为三类：上下文冲突、知识缺失、上下文敏感型事实幻觉。判定方法为：将幻觉步骤改写为独立问题喂给原模型，若能正确回答则归为上下文敏感型。2. **SSC-GRPO方法**：（a）对每个问题进行G次rollout采样；（b）将每次rollout分解为多个推理步骤；（c）用SelfCheckGPT式的NLI提示让模型自身判断每个步骤与其他rollout的一致性（entailment/neutral/contradiction → +1/0/-1）；（d）以正确rollout（α+）与错误rollout（α-）为权重加权聚合得到步骤级一致性奖励r^sc；（e）基于该奖励计算每步的优势系数w_{i,k}（含sgn(A_i)对齐方向、缩放因子λ、裁剪ε_c），重新分配rollout级优势，保持总优势不变；（f）以重分配后的步骤优势训练PPO式clip目标+KL正则。3. **评估**：在Qwen3-4B-Base、Qwen3-4B-Instruct、Llama3-8B-Instruct上对比GRPO、FSPO、SEED-GRPO，覆盖GSM8K、MATH-500、AIME24/25数学基准及HaluEval、TruthfulQA、HotpotQA幻觉基准。
AI.result: **主要结果**（表1）：SSC-GRPO在三种基模型上一致达到SOTA，平均超过GRPO基线1.80%（Qwen3-4B-Base）、1.01%（Qwen3-4B-Instruct）、1.50%（Llama3-8B-Instruct）。Qwen3-4B-Base在AIME25上从26.67%→43.33%，提升显著。**幻觉归因变化**（表2）：SSC-GRPO训练后，上下文敏感型事实幻觉占比从22.76%降至16.90%，正确率从66.32%升至72.24%。**训练动态**（图4）：随训练进行，一致步比例上升、不一致步比例下降。**NLI评判可靠性**（表3、表9）：Qwen3-4B-Instruct在MathNLI准确率92.18%，SNLI准确率87.45%，确保了自一致性评判的有效性。**上下文增强评测**（表7、8）：在加入无关干扰条件后模型准确率下降约6–14%，证明上下文干扰影响真实存在；SSC-GRPO训练后的模型下降幅度更小（11.53% vs 14.35%）。**消融实验**（表5）：λ=0.05、ε_c=0.2为最优；移除两者则训练崩溃。**分类稳健性**（表6）：更换评判模型为GPT-OSS-120B后，定性结论不变。**局限**：仅在4B/8B规模验证；自一致性计算引入额外训练开销。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统识别并验证了LLM多步推理中的"上下文敏感型事实幻觉"现象——模型具备知识但因上下文干扰而犯错，且该现象在推理幻觉中占主导。提出的SSC-GRPO方法通过self-consistency提供无需外部知识的步骤级奖励，有效缓解此类幻觉，并在数学与幻觉评测上同时取得SOTA，为推理过程幻觉的检测与抑制提供了新视角。

title: Transcription Policy as a Latent Variable: Activating Controllable Verbatim ASR with Word-Level Timing
summary: Modern ASR models trained on heterogeneously annotated data treat transcription style (verbatim vs. intended) as an uncontrolled latent variable, causing measurable decoding instability, evaluation confounding (up to 60% of reported WER attributable to style mismatch), and unreliable word-level timing. We show that models already encode both styles; the challenge is controlled activation. Using coverage-aware decoder task tokens trained on parallel verbatim/intended transcript pairs, we raise German disfluency F1 from 10% to 79% zero-shot, despite English-only training. Full English-only fine-tuning surpasses all baselines in verbatim accuracy, disfluency detection, and intended-mode quality across both languages. We further introduce supervised cross-attention fine-tuning that improves word-level timestamps on disfluent speech beyond forced-alignment baselines. Finally, we propose verbatimize, a new task enabling scalable creation and enrichment of speech corpora with high-quality canonical verbatim transcriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将"转录策略"（逐字 vs. 意图）作为可控潜变量处理，通过在 Whisper 解码器中引入离散模式标签（mode tags）实现显式的转录风格控制，从而解决大规模 ASR 系统因混合标注数据导致的解码不稳定、评估混淆和词级时间戳不可靠三大问题。同时提出监督式跨注意力微调以提升词级时间戳精度，以及 "verbatimize" 任务用于规模化生成高质量逐字转录语料。
AI.motivation: 当前大规模 ASR 模型（如 Whisper）在异构标注数据上训练时，将转录风格（逐字 vs. 意图）视为未受控的潜变量，由此引发三个可度量的失败：(1) 解码不稳定——同一音频不同 beam 假设的 CER 差异可达 15%；(2) 评估混淆——AMI 基准上高达 60% 的 WER 反映的是风格差异而非识别错误；(3) 词级时间戳在重复词等不流畅语音上概念上无法定义。核心动机是：模型已具备两种风格的能力，问题在于"可控激活"而非"能力获取"。
AI.method: 提出三大互补机制：(1) 模式标签（Mode Tags）——在解码器前缀中加入离散 token 参数化转录策略（verbatim/intended），并按标注覆盖率分区（[verbatim_1..3] 控制不流畅，[sound_1,2] 控制声音事件），通过配对训练解耦"说了什么"与"输出什么"；(2) 监督式跨注意力词级时间戳——选取 k=10 个注意力头，对平均后的注意力分布与词边界目标之间最小化余弦距离，并引入基于 mel 能量的虚拟静音模型与 Viterbi 解码实现无需架构修改的时间戳提取；(3) Verbatimize 任务——给定音频和意图转录，模型重建规范逐字版本，插入声学基础的不流畅标记，通过大小写扰动强制模型关注 prompt。训练分两阶段：Stage 1 仅训练新嵌入；Stage 2 解码器全量微调。
AI.result: (1) 风格控制：Stage 1（仅训练 27 个嵌入，冻结全部 764M 参数）即令德语不流畅事件 F1 从 10% 升至 79%；FT₀（仅英语全量微调）实现零样本德语事件 F1 94%、英语 91%，且模式标签使德语 F1 较无标签版本提升 34 个百分点；意图模式 iIR 从无标签的 15% 降至 3–4%；(2) 词级时间戳：TIMIT（朗读）MAE 36 ms、FluencyBank（不流畅）MAE 102 ms，首次在注意力方法上超越 MFA（142 ms）与 WhisperX（200 ms），跨语言 Thorsten（德语）MAE 55 ms；(3) Verbatimize：ICSI 罕见词召回率从 6.8% 提至 96.1%，CLR 从 9.4% 降至 1.3%，vWER/vCER 接近说明残余误差多为截断歧义。解码不稳定方面，beam 散度从 15.1% 降至 8.1%（降 46%）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明预训练 ASR 模型已具备所需能力，核心挑战是"激活"而非"获取"——离散模式标签将转录策略从潜变量转为显式接口；监督式跨注意力在策略稳定后即可超越强制对齐；verbatimize 打破了高质量逐字语料稀缺的瓶颈，解耦了意图转录准确性与逐字转录质量。10%→94% 零样本德语 F1 与 27 个嵌入实现 10%→79% 的跳跃，共同支撑"模式特定转录主要需要激活"的观点。局限：跨语言评估限于德语（与英语类型学接近），德语评估集由作者自录（口音不自然），时间戳监督依赖 MFA 自动对齐；未来工作可联合说话人日志、训练专用对齐头、以及利用 verbatimize 大规模引导弱监督语料生成。

title: Constrained CTC Decoding for Efficient Diacritic Restoration
summary: In this work, we address diacritic restoration for Arabic speech transcripts. Most speech data are undiacritized, limiting the ability of modeling fine-grained phonological distinctions. The speech modality has recently been explored as a way to complement text-based diacritic restoration efforts. We propose an efficient non-autoregressive approach for speech-to-text diacritization based on Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC). Our method incorporates hard constraints during decoding by constructing a character-level diacritization lattice from an undiacritized transcript and restricting hypotheses to valid diacritized realizations. We evaluate on Classical Arabic and Modern Standard Arabic test sets (namely, ArVoice and ClArTTS) against a more computationally-complex multi-modal diacritic restoration baseline, and show statistically significant reductions in diacritic error rates in both, demonstrating that the proposed approach offers both performance and efficiency gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于CTC的非自回归阿拉伯语语音到文本音标恢复方法，通过在解码阶段构建字符级音标化lattice并施加硬约束，实现了一种无需多模态训练的高效音标恢复方案，在古典阿拉伯语（ClArTTS）和现代标准阿拉伯语（ArVoice）测试集上均取得了统计显著的音标错误率（DER）降低。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语书写通常省略变音符号（diacritics），导致文本存在歧义，影响TTS和ASR系统的表现。纯文本的音标恢复方法即使在上下文中仍存在词义歧义问题，而语音信号中包含元音质量/长度、叠音、语法格位等声学线索可有效消歧。现有的语音辅助音标恢复方法采用多模态融合架构，计算复杂且在MSA和方言阿拉伯语上泛化能力较差，亟需一种更高效、更鲁棒的方案。
AI.method: 1) 采用Wav2vec2-XLSR作为声学模型，基于CTC目标进行微调，预测包含字母及其对应音标的完整字符序列；2) 设计字符级音标化lattice G_char(u)：从无音标转录构建线性链WFST，每个阿拉伯字母后插入通配符状态用于音标预测；3) 推理时将CTC解码图与G_char(u)进行组合，仅允许在通配符位置选择有效音标或CTC blank（表示无音标），实现部分强制对齐；4) 多音标组合被合并为单一字符token以保持1-to-1字符级表示；5) 附录中引入<no_diac>和<unk_diac>两个特殊token以处理部分音标化的训练数据。
AI.result: 在ClArTTS和ArVoice上均取得统计显著的DER降低（95%置信区间通过2000次bootstrap重采样验证）：匹配训练条件下ClArTTS DER为3.53（baseline Text+ASR为3.54），ArVoice为12.04（baseline为19.21）；跨数据集测试中本方法展现更强的鲁棒性（ClArTTS→ArVoice: 12.04 vs 19.21；ArVoice→ClArTTS: 11.86 vs 76.61）；联合训练设置下两个测试集均达到最优（ClArTTS DER 3.80 vs 9.05；ArVoice DER 8.69 vs 9.93）。附录实验表明，特殊token机制可在不降低DER的前提下，将部分音标化训练下的音标覆盖率从约54-60%提升至71-73%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的约束CTC解码方法在阿拉伯语音标恢复任务上取得了优于多模态基线的性能和泛化能力，同时保持了CTC解码的简洁性和效率优势，无需额外的文本编码器或多模态训练。该方法既可作为完整的音标化ASR模型使用，也可作为基于无音标参考文本的约束音标恢复模型，特别适合用于辅助阿拉伯语语音数据标注与整理工作。特殊token扩展进一步增强了模型在实际混合音标覆盖场景中的实用性。

title: Disentangling Curriculum Learning in NLP: Towards a Unifying Taxonomy
summary: Despite more than a decade of curriculum learning (CL) research in NLP, the field lacks a principled account of which difficulty function or scheduler to use for a given problem. To understand what has hindered progress towards this account, we propose a fine-grained taxonomy separating difficulty evaluation from training scheduling to enable systematic analysis of CL strategies. For difficulty evaluation, we distinguish attribution source and task dependence, revealing difficulty as a perspectival concept encoding different assumptions about what makes an instance hard to learn. For scheduling, we provide the first formalisation of CL schedulers in terms of expected training contribution, enabling comparison across implementations by introducing retention regimes and monotonicity properties. Applied in a dedicated analysis of CL works in NLP, our taxonomy reveals a systematic incomparability problem: prior works conflate distinct notions of difficulty and scheduling, often pursuing different objectives under the same CL label -- hindering comparison and the accumulation of a coherent evidence base. Beyond diagnosis, the taxonomy supports the design, analysis, and comparison of CL strategies, and motivates evaluation practices that disentangle the sources of observed improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自然语言处理（NLP）领域课程学习（CL）研究缺乏统一分析框架的问题，提出了一个将难度评估与训练调度相分离的细粒度双部分分类法，揭示了现有文献中因概念混淆而导致的系统性不可比性问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管课程学习在NLP领域已有十余年研究，但学界尚未就如何针对特定问题选择难度函数或调度器达成共识。本文认为这一困境并非源于实证工作的匮乏，而是缺乏足够精确的共享框架来界定CL策略实际实现的内容。许多冠以CL名义的工作实际混淆了不同的难度概念、调度机制与训练目标，导致结果难以归因，阻碍了可比的、累积性的证据基础的形成。
AI.method:
1. 提出双部分分类法：
（a）难度评估部分：沿两个正交轴——**归因来源**（人类中心 vs 模型中心）与**任务依赖性**（任务无关 vs 任务依赖）——划分出四个象限（TA-H、TA-M、TD-H、TD-M）；
（b）训练调度部分：基于**期望训练贡献**π_t对调度器进行首次形式化定义，提出两个机制无关的比较轴——**保留机制**（五类：无约束、不可重入、无保留、完全保留、全程保留）与**单调性属性**（三类：选择单调性、前沿单调性、暴露单调性）。
2. 利用该分类法对NLP领域的CL文献进行系统性的论文级分析。
AI.result:
1. 识别出NLP中CL研究的系统性**不可比性问题**：难度函数对"何为难学"持有不同假设，调度器虽实现从易到难的进展却不必以相同方式单调推进，且许多课程实际追求的是数据质量或领域过滤等超越纯难度排序的目标；
2. 揭示了局部难度评估下的**归因问题**：观察到的单调性可能源于调度逻辑、难度函数演化或两者共同作用；
3. 提供了覆盖四个难度象限与五种保留机制的具体文献归类框架（如TD-M象限最常见且多采用局部评估，TA-H和TA-M多为全局评估，全保留为NLP中主流保留机制）；
4. 提出了改进报告、消融实验与评估实践的具体建议。
AI.conclusion: 该分类法通过解构CL中长期混淆的概念，促进了CL策略的设计、分析与比较，使不同实现之间的结构性差异变得显式可识别，为未来研究的结果报告、消融设计及有效解释提供了可操作的框架支持。

title: Content is What Remains: Invariant Speech Tokenization from Parallel Utterances
summary: Discrete speech tokenizers aim to disentangle semantic from acoustic information, yet targets from self-supervised learning (SSL) models like HuBERT retain non-linguistic variation: speaker identity, prosody, and channel conditions leak into the tokens, inflating entropy. Our key insight is that when enough speakers utter the same words under varying conditions, linguistic content is the only shared factor. We propose PINT (Parallel INvariant Tokenization), which fine-tunes an SSL encoder with alignment losses across parallel utterances and augmentations to distill this shared residual. PINT collapses identical words onto consistent token sequences, drastically reducing conditional entropy. Unlike ASR text, PINT tokens preserve frame-level temporal grounding and serve as drop-in semantic targets for audio codecs. Experiments show a 98.7% relative reduction in speaker probe accuracy (93.1% to 1.2%), a 42% lower ABX error rate, and 27-30% lower LM perplexity versus baselines, confirming that the right invariance is key to efficient learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PINT（Parallel INvariant Tokenization），通过在平行语料（同一文本的多说话人/多条件录音）上微调HuBERT编码器，将语义内容与说话人身份、韵律、声道等干扰因素解耦。PINT在说话人探针准确率上相对降低98.7%（93.1%→1.2%），ABX错误率降低42%，下游语言模型困惑度降低27–30%，验证了"不变性"是语音token质量的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有语音tokenizer（如基于HuBERT/WavLM蒸馏的方法）生成的离散token仍泄漏说话人身份、韵律和信道等非语言变化，导致条件熵H(z|c)>0，损害压缩性和下游任务（如语音转换、口音转换、表达性合成）。已有方法（ContentVec、DC-Spin、StableToken等）分别针对说话人、增强或噪声的某一种不变性，且都继承SSL特征中已有的干扰泄漏，缺乏统一的"语义"定义和实现方案。
AI.method: PINT以HuBERT-base为骨架，分两阶段训练：（1）Stage A在平行数据（真实平行语料ARCTIC/CSTR-VCTK/ESD等+伪平行对通过噪声/混响/变速等增强生成）上联合优化三项损失——序列级soft-DTW对齐损失（迫使平行对编码一致）、词级对比损失（Jaccard门控正负样本，防止平凡坍缩）、Transformer解码器的音素交叉熵损失（保证内容捕获）；（2）Stage B引入学生-教师框架，通过EMA教师对每个平行组生成共享argmax token序列，学生以CTC对齐到该共享序列，联合优化离散一致性，配合边际均匀损失和正交损失防止码本坍缩。噪声作为"空文本平行数据"参与训练以提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 内容捕获：PINT在LibriSpeech上连续/离散模式的CER（3.84/4.65）和WER（9.79/12.13）均优于HuBERT、WavLM基线，跨说话人ABX错误率0.042。 不变性：CSTR-VCTK说话人探针准确率从93.1%降至1.2%（-98.7%），DTW组内/组间距离比降至0.0092（约20×改进）；噪声下token熵为0、RMS SD<0.02，近乎完全鲁棒。 压缩性：去重率74.8%（vs HuBERT 50.7%），RLE后152 bits/s（vs 基线246–273），BPE-8k去重后56 bits/s，逼近文本BPE的48 bits/s。 下游LM：相同85M参数Transformer在LibriLight上PINT测试困惑度1.95 vs HuBERT 2.78 / WavLM 2.67，仅需约1400步即匹配WavLM最终困惑度（23×加速）。 消融显示sDTW单独使用会坍缩，需对比损失配合；synth-only（仅合成数据）已能获得低说话人泄漏但离散一致性较差；合成增广的synth-aug接近全量性能，为低资源语言扩展提供可行性。
AI.conclusion: PINT证明"正确的语义不变性"是语音token质量的决定性瓶颈，而非模型架构或容量。通过平行监督与增强蒸馏的简单框架即可获得近乎完全说话人无关、噪声鲁棒、帧对齐且高度可压缩的语义token，可作为现有语音编解码器（SpeechTokenizer、Moshi/Mimi、DualCodec等）的即插即用语义目标。未来工作包括通过合成数据扩展至多语言、编解码器集成，以及利用PINT的RLE可压缩性进行时长分解生成。

title: Benchmarking Human and Automatic Speech Recognition of Diverse Speech: Initial Results
summary: Humans are often considered to be the best listeners and seen as the upper-bound performance of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. We present a preliminary comparison of the performances of state-of-the-art ASR systems and Dutch native listeners on the recognition of "diverse" speech, specifically Dutch child and older adults' speech and Flemish. Google Telephony outperformed the other ASR systems. Importantly, the ASR systems showed similar performance to the listeners, and in specific cases even outperformed them. Slight performance differences between the listeners and ASR systems were found related to speaker's age and regional accents and utterance length. Future research should focus on making ASR systems more robust to acoustic variability related to aging and regional accents. A comparison of ASR recognition performances on the test stimuli and the full Jasmin-CGN test sets showed the influence of the specific test sets on the conclusions regarding benchmarking human and ASR performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究初步比较了先进ASR系统（Google Telephony、Whisper-large-v3、定制Conformer）与荷兰语母语者在识别"多样化"语音（儿童语音、老年语音、弗拉芒语）上的表现。结果显示Google Telephony最优，且在某些情况下ASR系统甚至优于人类听者，挑战了"人类是ASR性能上限"的传统观点。
AI.motivation: 尽管人类听者通常被视为ASR性能的上限，但近期研究表明ASR在标准语音上已达到或超过人类水平。然而，对于偏离"标准"的语音（如儿童、老年人、非母语者及方言口音），ASR性能显著下降。该研究旨在探索ASR系统在多样化语音上与人类听者的实际差距，识别ASR系统需要改进的方向，以推动更具包容性的语音技术。
AI.method: 从Jasmin-CGN语料库选取120个激励（儿童、老年人、弗拉芒语各40个），运行三次独立听音实验（45名荷兰语母语者），与三个ASR系统（Google Telephony、Whisper-large-v3、基于XLSR-53特征训练的Conformer）的转录结果进行比较。以词错误率（WER）为指标，采用配对bootstrap检验（10000次重采样）和多因素线性模型分析说话人年龄、性别、地区口音及语句长度对识别的影响。
AI.result: 1) Google Telephony在所有说话人组中均表现最佳；2) ASR系统在儿童语音上与人类无显著差异，但Google Telephony和Whisper在老年人语音上显著优于人类；3) 所有三个ASR系统平均而言在弗拉芒青少年语音上优于人类；4) 错误类型以替换为主，人类在不理解时倾向不书写（较高删除率），而ASR总会输出内容；5) Whisper和Conformer在弗拉芒语中存在显著性别差异；6) 人类听者在老年人语音上表现出地区口音效应（西部比南部识别更好），ASR则无此效应；7) ASR在更长语句上表现更好（尤其儿童语音），人类则无此趋势；8) 全测试集WER比实验刺激集平均高8.4%，但模型相对排序保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究将ASR与人类识别性能对等的结果从标准语音扩展到多样化语音，表明现代SotA ASR系统在特定条件下确实可以超越人类听者，对"人类是ASR上限"的传统观点提出挑战。然而，ASR在多样化语音上的整体性能仍不及典型语音。未来改进应聚焦于提升对年龄相关和地区口音相关声学变异建模的鲁棒性，以增强ASR系统的包容性。研究还指出，测试刺激的选择会显著影响人机比较的结论，需要更大、更具代表性的测试集进行进一步研究。

title: Automated Extraction of Techno-Economic Data from 76,000 Energy System Studies
summary: Energy system models guide societally important decisions, but their credibility rests on quantitative assumptions that are difficult to source and audit. Meta-analyses can improve transparency and modeling practices, but the rapid growth of publications makes manual information extraction increasingly impractical. Consequently, databases are updated infrequently and efforts are often duplicated across research groups. Here, we demonstrate the highly accurate automated extraction of quantitative information from 76,000 energy system studies published since 2010. We compile 3.2 million structured quantitative data points together with 20 million associated metadata entries, spanning a broad spectrum of technologies, methodological approaches and system characteristics. Beyond providing input data for models, the resulting FAIR database make the energy systems literature itself analysable. We show where academic assumptions diverge from empirical observed data, and how research priorities vary at scale across technologies, regions and time. To facilitate broad use within the community, the database is provided through an interactive dashboard, enabling users to filter, analyse and download data according to their specific research needs.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了从76,000篇能源系统研究文献中自动提取技术经济数据的工作，构建了包含320万个结构化定量数据点和2000万条元数据的FAIR数据库，并展示了其在能源建模、文献计量学分析和基准对比方面的应用价值。
AI.motivation: 能源系统模型对社会重要决策具有指导意义，但其可信度依赖于难以获取和审计的定量假设。手动信息提取耗时且难以跟上文献增长步伐，导致数据库更新不及时、研究重复。本文旨在利用大语言模型实现大规模、高精度的自动化数据提取，解决能源系统分析领域数据获取的瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 采用基于轻量级LLM（124M和783M参数）的领域无关框架Quinex进行定量信息提取，包括：1）使用编码器-仅Transformer识别数量跨度（F1>98%）；2）基于规则的量纲解析器将单位映射到QUDT本体；3）使用编码器-解码器Transformer以问答方式识别实体和属性（F1分别为87%和82%）；4）通过Scopus和Web of Science检索2010-2025年76,306篇英文出版物；5）使用正则表达式将提取的实体和属性映射到预定义类别；6）使用CuCoPy进行通胀调整和货币转换。
AI.result: 1）从76,306篇出版物中提取3,244,672个数据点，覆盖多种技术、方法论和系统特征；2）通过与IRENA基准对比验证了提取数据的准确性，CAPEX平均绝对误差为0.4-0.6美元/W；3）揭示了学术界CAPEX假设存在系统性偏差（年均降幅小于IRENA报告值）；4）发现中国论文数量增长最快（13.7%/年），欧洲则下降（6.2%/年）；5）发现建模空间粒度近十年增长79%，时间步数在2020年后趋于平稳；6）发现热泵COP存在广泛使用整数假设的现象（12%研究使用COP=3）；7）发现约12%的电池寿命数据异常可能是煤储量寿命而非电厂寿命被误提取。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了首个大规模能源系统分析数据库，具有自动化、透明、可重现的工作流，可持续更新。未来工作将聚焦于：1）集成到PyPSA、ETHOS.FINE等建模框架；2）通过Open Energy Ontology实现本体链接；3）整合新奇度指标辅助数据选择；4）扩展为包含持续溯源信息的专用数据库基础设施。数据库在可扩展性与人工策展之间取得了平衡，仍需人工参与进行数据验证和解读。

title: Selection Shapes the Boundary: A Preregistered Replication of Monotonicity and Label Agreement in Unselected NLI Populations
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Preregistered replication. Code, data, and audit trail: this https URL
summary: Prior work on human label variation (HLV) in natural language inference (NLI) has often relied on re-annotation resources that select items by disagreement level. An earlier study ( arXiv:2607.15870 ) found that hypotheses containing non-upward monotonicity operators showed lower label agreement in ChaosNLI (Cliff's delta = -0.284), which is restricted to items whose majority label carries exactly three of five votes. We preregistered a replication of this boundary in the unselected populations that ChaosNLI was drawn from: the SNLI and MultiNLI development sets, using the same operator tagger and a four-level ordinal agreement outcome. The registered prediction fails. All seven contrasts return a positive Cliff's delta (non-upward items agree slightly more, not less), the only significant confirmatory contrast has the opposite sign to the registration, and every effect is far below our smallest effect size of interest (0.10). Robustness checks support the measurement: simulated tagger misclassification shrinks the effects rather than manufacturing them, and a manual re-tagging audit reaches four-class agreement of 0.875 on a fresh 200-item sample.
